quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes and the Société d’habitation du Québec launch the next phase of their partnership to deliver thousands of affordable homes

quotes.quote_text: As Minister of Justice, I have the authority under the Criminal Code to order a new trial or appeal when new evidence shows a miscarriage of justice likely occurred. My decision does not decide guilt or innocence, as that will rest with the courts. Our responsibility is to make sure Canadians can trust their justice system, and that means, in rare cases, returning cases to the courts for new information to be considered.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Minister of Justice orders new trial in Quebec case following conviction review

quotes.quote_text: Mississauga is a very densely urbanized metropolitan area, meaning our green spaces and park spaces are important for the beauty and resilience of the community. Places like the Iggy Kaneff Park offer natural oases that reduce flooding and offer outdoor recreation. As the federal government works to build Canada strong, we will continue to invest in projects like wetland restoration that support the construction of more homes and increase the quality of life for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Charles Sousa
quotes.speaker_title: Member, on behalf of the Honourable Gregor Robertson, Minister
quotes.article_title: Canada supports restoration of park and watershed in Mississauga

quotes.quote_text: This federal investment is a meaningful step toward protecting and restoring one of Mississauga’s most important natural watersheds. By strengthening the Cooksville Creek watershed and enhancing Iggy Kaneff Park, we’re improving climate resilience, reducing flood risk and creating healthier, more enjoyable green spaces for our community.
quotes.speaker: Carolyn Parrish
quotes.article_title: Canada supports restoration of park and watershed in Mississauga

quotes.quote_text: Restoring wetlands and expanding forests along Cooksville Creek will have long term environmental and community benefits. This project supports healthier ecosystems and habitats, better stormwater management and advances the City’s broader climate and sustainability goals.
quotes.speaker: Raj Sheth
quotes.article_title: Canada supports restoration of park and watershed in Mississauga

quotes.quote_text: Our local businesses are developing innovative solutions, creating jobs and driving economic growth. Through today’s investment, including support for Accuenergy, we are helping nine businesses and organizations in Toronto, Scarborough and North York to strengthen their operations, embrace innovation and unlock new opportunities. This is how we build a stronger economy and ensure Canadian companies and organizations can compete and succeed.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment to support growth, innovation and competitiveness in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Scarborough is home to innovative companies like Accuenergy that are helping drive economic growth and strengthen our region’s reputation as a hub for innovation. I am proud to see a local company continue to grow and expand its reach in global markets.
quotes.speaker: Doly Begum
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment to support growth, innovation and competitiveness in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Today electricity demand is climbing everywhere you look - data centres, EV charging, electrified buildings - and our power meters, sub-metering systems, and current transformers are doing that measurement in over 150 countries. Our Canadian team has grown from 37 people in 2020 to more than 200 today. FedDev Ontario's investment helps us move faster on a $10 million expansion of our Scarborough facility, creating 30 permanent jobs and growing Canadian exports. This project keeps that growth, and that manufacturing capability, in Canada.
quotes.speaker: Howard Wang
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment to support growth, innovation and competitiveness in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: The service of Canadian Armed Forces members on these missions has made a real difference. Their contributions have strengthened partnerships, and advanced peace and security around the world. As the global security environment evolves, the Canadian Armed Forces must remain ready and focused where it can have the greatest impact. This rebalancing will help sustain our commitments and strengthen readiness, enabling Canada to continue to contribute effectively alongside allies and partners.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Canadian Armed Forces rebalances operations to strengthen global footprint

quotes.quote_text: For decades, our members have served with courage and commitment in some of the world's most challenging environments, making lasting contributions to international peace and stability. As the global strategic landscape evolves, we must adapt our operational posture to ensure the Canadian Armed Forces remains ready to meet the security challenges of today and tomorrow. By rebalancing where we employ our people and capabilities, we are strengthening Canada's ability to defend our country and contribute meaningfully alongside our allies and partners.
quotes.speaker: General Jennie Carignan
quotes.article_title: Canadian Armed Forces rebalances operations to strengthen global footprint

quotes.quote_text: Our people have made lasting contributions to peace and stability through these missions over many years. As we transition, we remain focused on ensuring the Canadian Armed Forces are ready, relevant, and positioned to meet current and future operational demands.
quotes.speaker: Major-General Tim Arsenault
quotes.speaker_title: Acting Commander Canadian Joint Operations Command
quotes.article_title: Canadian Armed Forces rebalances operations to strengthen global footprint

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing, and groceries. When we invest in kids, we're investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: The Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027 nearly 153,000 families in Manitoba benefiting from more generous payments starting this month

quotes.quote_text: Families are doing everything they can to give their children the best possible start in life, and they deserve support they can count on. The Canada Child Benefit helps with the everyday costs of raising children—from groceries and clothing to school supplies and child care. By increasing the benefit to keep pace with the cost of living, we're helping families in St. Boniface—St. Vital and across Canada navigate today's challenges while investing in the next generation.
quotes.speaker: Ginette Lavack
quotes.article_title: The Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027 nearly 153,000 families in Manitoba benefiting from more generous payments starting this month

quotes.quote_text: Today, federal, provincial and territorial governments are advancing a clear path forward for Canada’s next policy framework, one that is grounded in collaboration, informed by producers and partners, and focused on results. Together, we are working to ensure that Canada’s agriculture and agri-food sector remains a cornerstone of our economy and food security by helping farmers, producers and processors succeed in the face of any and all challenges.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Federal, Provincial and Territorial Ministers of Agriculture advance a shared vision for the Next Policy Framework

quotes.quote_text: Nova Scotia was proud to host agriculture ministers and officials from across Canada for these important discussions. The Next Policy Framework will help shape the future of Canadian agriculture through 2033. The Halifax Statement gives us a shared direction as we continue working together on responsive business risk management tools and strategic programs that support our producers and agri-food businesses.
quotes.speaker: Greg Morrow
quotes.article_title: Federal, Provincial and Territorial Ministers of Agriculture advance a shared vision for the Next Policy Framework

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing and groceries. When we invest in kids, we’re investing in our future and building Canada Strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026–2027

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Child Benefit has helped families in Alberta, including in Airdrie, build a stronger, brighter future for their kids. Nearly half a million Alberta families receive support from the Canada Child Benefit every year, and by increasing payments each year, we are ensuring families continue to receive the support they need when it matters most.
quotes.speaker: Corey Hogan
quotes.article_title: Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026–2027

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing, and groceries. When we invest in kids, we’re investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: The Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Child Benefit is providing support to families across British Columbia, and in my own community of Kelowna. The benefit is helping families to cover the costs of raising children and build a stronger future for their kids. By increasing payments each year to keep pace with inflation, we are ensuring families continue to receive the support they need when it matters most.
quotes.speaker: Stephen Fuhr
quotes.article_title: The Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027

quotes.quote_text: Strong partnerships with Indigenous communities strengthen maritime safety across Canada. By supporting Indigenous-led search and rescue capacity and recognizing the invaluable knowledge and leadership of Indigenous partners, we are helping build safer waterways and more resilient coastal communities for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Indigenous Community Boat Volunteer Program recipients announced

quotes.quote_text: Our collaboration with Indigenous communities is essential to marine safety and security from coast to coast to coast. Listening to, working with, and learning from First Nations, Inuit, and Métis partners keeps our waters and coasts safe and healthy, while simultaneously advancing reconciliation and bolstering Canada’s marine response system.
quotes.speaker: Kevin Brosseau
quotes.speaker_title: Commissioner of the Canadian Coast Guard
quotes.article_title: Indigenous Community Boat Volunteer Program recipients announced

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing, and groceries. When we invest in kids, we’re investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: The Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Child Benefit continues to give families the stability they need to thrive. By adjusting payments to keep pace with the cost of living, we are ensuring parents have more money in their pockets for essentials like groceries, clothing, and child care, helping build stronger, more resilient households across the country.
quotes.speaker: Annie Koutrakis
quotes.article_title: The Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing, and groceries. When we invest in kids, we’re investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: Minister Olszewski highlights increased Canada Child Benefit, delivering more support to Alberta families

quotes.quote_text: Raising a family comes with real costs, and the Canada Child Benefit helps nearly half a million Alberta families put more money back into their household budgets each month. Through the Canada Child Benefit, we are investing more than $4 billion each year in Albertan families. By increasing the benefit to keep pace with inflation, we're helping parents manage everyday expenses, support their children, and build a stronger future right here in Alberta.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Minister Olszewski highlights increased Canada Child Benefit, delivering more support to Alberta families

quotes.quote_text: Nearly half a million Alberta families receive support through the Canada Child Benefit every year. This investment helps parents manage household expenses, strengthens communities and gives children the opportunity to reach their full potential.
quotes.speaker: Corey Hogan
quotes.article_title: Minister Olszewski highlights increased Canada Child Benefit, delivering more support to Alberta families

quotes.quote_text: Camrose is a wonderful place to live and raise a family and supports like the Canada Child Benefit can help ease some of the everyday costs parents are facing. As our community continues to grow, we appreciate funding that helps families access reliable childcare and supports the services they need to build a good life here.
quotes.speaker: PJ Stasko
quotes.article_title: Minister Olszewski highlights increased Canada Child Benefit, delivering more support to Alberta families

quotes.quote_text: The Canadian government is committed to investing in the future of agriculture and agri-food, and supporting the producers and processors who drive innovation across the sector. This week’s conference showed how strong federal–provincial–territorial collaboration is helping deepen those investments, strengthen risk‑management tools, and open new opportunities for growth right here, in Canada. Through the National Food Security Strategy, we are also taking practical steps to support farmers and food businesses while maintaining Canada’s world‑class food safety system.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald concludes annual Federal, Provincial, and Territorial meeting with Ministers of Agriculture

quotes.quote_text: Nova Scotia was proud to host agriculture ministers and officials from across Canada for these important discussions. The Next Policy Framework will help shape the future of Canadian agriculture through 2033 . The Halifax Statement gives us a shared direction as we continue working together on responsive business risk management tools and strategic programs that support our producers and agri-food businesses.
quotes.speaker: Greg Morrow
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald concludes annual Federal, Provincial, and Territorial meeting with Ministers of Agriculture

quotes.quote_text: The investment announced today will help modernize key drinking water and wastewater infrastructure, which will help meet the needs of the people of Saint-Fortunat. Projects like this are essential to building a strong and resilient Canada, helping to strengthen municipal infrastructure in the communities that need it most.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: The governments of Canada and Quebec are providing over $9 million to Saint-Fortunat

quotes.quote_text: Our government is hard at work modernizing municipal infrastructure in Quebec. Our actions help improve the resilience of water systems, protect the environment, and maintain essential services for the public. Supporting municipalities in maintaining and replacing their outdated pipes is one of our priorities.
quotes.speaker: Samuel Poulin
quotes.article_title: The governments of Canada and Quebec are providing over $9 million to Saint-Fortunat

quotes.quote_text: I am pleased to see that more than $5 million in federal funding will be used to carry out a vital infrastructure project for the residents of Saint-Fortunat. Thanks to this project, the community’s drinking water supply, wastewater treatment, and stormwater management infrastructure will be improved and modernized to better meet current needs.
quotes.speaker: Caroline Desrochers
quotes.article_title: The governments of Canada and Quebec are providing over $9 million to Saint-Fortunat

quotes.quote_text: I am delighted with this investment in our community. By modernizing Saint-Fortunat’s drinking water and wastewater infrastructure, we are improving the reliability of the systems. Through careful planning in conjunction with roadwork, we are protecting the environment, minimizing the impact on residents, and ensuring sustainable, high-quality services for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Isabelle Lecours
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Assistant for the Chaudière-Appalaches region and Member
quotes.article_title: The governments of Canada and Quebec are providing over $9 million to Saint-Fortunat

quotes.quote_text: We welcome this announcement with tremendous relief. Thanks to this support, Saint-Fortunat will finally be able to move forward with a major project that includes bringing its drinking water and wastewater infrastructure up to current standards, as well as the reconstruction of Route 263. These long-awaited works will help remove significant constraints and make it possible to move forward with projects that had been put on hold, while improving the quality of life and safety of our citizens. I would like to sincerely thank everyone who contributed to this success, particularly our Member of the National Assembly, Isabelle Lecours, the ministère des Affaires municipales et de l’Habitation du Québec (MAMH), the MTMD, as well as the engineers and the MAMH regional director for their guidance and support.
quotes.speaker: Denis Fortier
quotes.article_title: The governments of Canada and Quebec are providing over $9 million to Saint-Fortunat

quotes.quote_text: Together, we will continue to advance the Sustainable Development Goals through meaningful partnership and collective action. Canada remains dedicated to working alongside our domestic and international partners to build a sustainable, inclusive, and resilient world. This shared commitment will foster prosperity, create new opportunities, and improve the quality of life for present and future generations.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Minister Robertson represents Canada at the United Nations High-Level Political Forum on Sustainable Development

quotes.quote_text: No country can achieve the Sustainable Development Goals alone. The UN High‑Level Political Forum reminds us that progress depends on strong multilateral cooperation and shared ambition. Canada is working with partners to deliver measurable global impact and ensure no one is left behind as we build a more sustainable global economy. We are proud to advance solutions that improve lives, protect our planet, and create opportunities for all.
quotes.speaker: Randeep Sarai
quotes.article_title: Minister Robertson represents Canada at the United Nations High-Level Political Forum on Sustainable Development

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s participation at the United Nations High-Level Political Forum demonstrates our commitment to working with partners around the world to advance the Sustainable Development Goals. Through a strong Team Canada approach, we are creating opportunities for young people, supporting inclusive economic growth, reducing poverty, and building stronger, more resilient communities. By working together at home and internationally, we are helping ensure that everyone has the opportunity to succeed while contributing to a more sustainable future for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Annie Koutrakis
quotes.article_title: Minister Robertson represents Canada at the United Nations High-Level Political Forum on Sustainable Development

quotes.quote_text: Building a stronger Canadian economy means investing in the sectors that drive innovation, strengthen our resilience and create good jobs across the country. Canada’s aerospace and defence industries are critical to our economic future and our national security. Through engagements at Farnborough and with business leaders in London, Canada is strengthening strategic partnerships, attracting investment and helping Canadian companies seize new opportunities in a changing global economy.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada’s delegation at the Farnborough International Airshow to advance Canada’s aerospace industry, boost competitiveness and strengthen the economy

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s transportation sector is a key driver of our economy. Our aerospace sector is at the forefront of innovation, creating good jobs, attracting investment and opening new opportunities for Canadian businesses. Being at the Farnborough International Airshow allows us to showcase the innovation, expertise and capacity that make Canada’s aerospace industry a trusted global partner.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada’s delegation at the Farnborough International Airshow to advance Canada’s aerospace industry, boost competitiveness and strengthen the economy

quotes.quote_text: Canada is moving with urgency to strengthen the Canadian Armed Forces and ensure we are prepared to defend North America while contributing to peace and stability alongside our allies. Our aerospace sector is a cornerstone of that effort, delivering the innovation, industrial capacity and highly skilled workforce that strengthen both our economy and our national security. Farnborough is an opportunity to demonstrate Canada’s leadership, deepen partnerships with trusted allies and showcase the world-class capabilities that Canadian industry brings to an increasingly complex security environment.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada’s delegation at the Farnborough International Airshow to advance Canada’s aerospace industry, boost competitiveness and strengthen the economy

quotes.quote_text: Canadian defence and aerospace companies are world-class innovators and key contributors to our economic growth and national security. Farnborough provides an important opportunity to showcase Canadian capabilities, strengthen relationships with allies and industry partners, and build a competitive and resilient defence industrial base. Through the Defence Industrial Strategy and renewed investments in defence, we are creating new opportunities for Canadian companies to grow, innovate, and compete on the global stage.
quotes.speaker: Stephen Fuhr
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada’s delegation at the Farnborough International Airshow to advance Canada’s aerospace industry, boost competitiveness and strengthen the economy

quotes.quote_text: A strong Canada depends on strong families. Starting this month, your government is delivering a more generous Canada Child Benefit that keeps up with the cost of living. This direct, tax-free support to parents is helping lower the costs of raising their kids, so that they can get the best start in life.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez highlights increased supports for Canadian families through the Canada Child Benefit

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Child Benefit has helped families in the province, including in my own community of Mississauga, cover the costs of raising children and build a stronger future for their kids. By increasing payments each year to keep pace with inflation, we are ensuring families continue to receive the support they need when it matters most.
quotes.speaker: Rechie Valdez
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez highlights increased supports for Canadian families through the Canada Child Benefit

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Child Benefit provides critical support to 1.4 million Ontario families, including 8,500 right here in Eglinton and St. Lawrence. I hear from parents in our community every day about how this funding helps them manage household expenses and ensure their children have every opportunity to succeed. I am incredibly proud that our government is increasing this benefit to deliver real relief to families in Toronto and across the country.
quotes.speaker: Vince Gasparro
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez highlights increased supports for Canadian families through the Canada Child Benefit

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Child Benefit is an investment in our children and in Canada’s future. By providing direct support to families, we are helping ensure that children have the opportunities they need to learn, grow and succeed, while making life more affordable for parents and communities across the country.
quotes.speaker: Chi Nguyen
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez highlights increased supports for Canadian families through the Canada Child Benefit

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing, and groceries. When we invest in kids, we’re investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: The Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Child Benefit has helped families in the province, including my own community of Cape Spear, cover the costs of raising children and build a stronger future for their kids. By increasing payments each year to keep pace with inflation, we are ensuring families continue to receive the support they need when it matters most.
quotes.speaker: Parliamentary Secretary to the
quotes.article_title: The Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027

quotes.quote_text: Raising kids is expensive, and families in Windsor and across Ontario are feeling it on every bill. The Canada Child Benefit puts money back in their pockets every month, tax-free, and starting this month that payment goes up again. That is up to $160 more per child under 6 and up to $135 more per child aged 6 to 17, going toward groceries and other life essentials.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Minister Dabrusin highlights increased Canada Child Benefit payments for families

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing, and groceries. When we invest in kids, we’re investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: Minister Dabrusin highlights increased Canada Child Benefit payments for families

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing and groceries. When we invest in kids, we’re investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: Minister Metlege Diab highlights Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026–2027

quotes.quote_text: Strong families are at the heart of strong communities and a strong Canada. The Canada Child Benefit provides meaningful support to parents, helping them with the costs of raising children and giving every child the opportunity to thrive. By ensuring payments keep pace with inflation, we’re continuing to invest in families and in Canada’s future.
quotes.speaker: Lena Metlege Diab
quotes.article_title: Minister Metlege Diab highlights Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026–2027

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement represents a significant leap forward in our collaborative effort with partners to designate a national urban park in the Windsor area. The acquisition of 19 hectares of the former Windsor Raceway, together with the lands being considered for inclusion by municipal, provincial, and federal partners, brings this vision closer to reality as we enter the final stages of designation. I am proud to work alongside our many community partners and First Nations to protect nature, advance reconciliation, and ensure that more Canadians—especially those living in urban areas—can experience the benefits of being outdoors and feeling connected to nature.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement demonstrates what is possible when we come together to protect nature and support thriving communities. Through Indigenous leadership, community action, and collaboration among governments and conservation partners, we are protecting important habitats, strengthening biodiversity, and creating new opportunities for people to connect with nature. The proposed national urban park in the Windsor area is a powerful example of how we can conserve the places that matter most while building a nature-positive future for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Nathalie Provost
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: Congratulations to the Ontario Conservation Accelerator on securing 19 hectares of land adjacent to Ojibway Prairie Nature Reserve for permanent protection and conservation. Our government is pleased to celebrate this achievement with our partners as we continue discussions on the establishment of a proposed National Urban Park in Windsor.
quotes.speaker: Andrew Dowie
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Assistant to the Minister, Conservation and Parks
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement is about more than protecting land, it is about restoring relationships. For Caldwell First Nation, these lands are part of a living landscape that connects our people to our history, culture, and responsibilities to future generations. As a Nation that experienced displacement from our traditional territory, we understand both the fragility and importance of these spaces. The protection of these lands reflects a shared commitment to conservation, reconciliation, and Indigenous stewardship. We are proud to stand alongside First Nation, municipal, conservation, provincial, and federal partners in ensuring one of Canada’s most biodiverse landscapes remains stewarded, protected, and accessible for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Chief Nikki van Oirschot
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: Honouring our ancestors reminds us that Treaties mattered then, they matter now, and they will matter for the generations yet to come. The national urban park reflects the 3 R’s that guide our work: Relationship , built through true partnership; Respect , grounded in our ancestors and the Treaties they signed; and Responsibilities , shared stewardship for the lands and waters we all depend on.
quotes.speaker: Chief Leela Thomas
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: Today marks a very important and meaningful part of history. It symbolizes unity, commitment and building relationships, with the common goal of preserving our land and protecting the land for everyone to enjoy today, tomorrow and the next seven generations. Our mother is hurting right now, she is telling us all to slow down and help everyone understand the important role of all creation and its connections; from the little critters, to the animals, plants, trees, land, water and air, that they all need each other to survive and maintain here on earth. We all can be stewards of the land! Miigwech/Thank you.
quotes.speaker: Chief Janelle Nahmabin - O'gimaa Mskwaanakwod Kwe
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: This opportunity represents an important step towards conservation and reconciliation. Our parks are more than protected lands - it’s our duty to care for them while honouring the history, rights, and responsibilities of Anishnaabe people. We need to ensure that our future generations can continue to connect with the lands, the water, and the teachings of our people. Together we are working towards a legacy that reflects the enduring strength of Anishnaabe knowledge and our shared commitment to protecting our sacred places for generations to come. Miigwetch.
quotes.speaker: Chief Kimberly Bressette
quotes.speaker_title: Chippewas of Kettle and Stony Point First Nation
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: Today's milestone reflects years of effort by First Nations, local residents, conservation organizations, governments and many community partners who have championed the vision of a national urban park and the protection of these particular lands. We are honoured that the Ontario Conservation Accelerator could play a role in that effort. The acquisition of the former Windsor Raceway lands demonstrates what is possible when local passion, strong partnerships, and timely conservation action come together around a common goal.
quotes.speaker: Kristyn Ferguson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: For decades, residents, naturalists, and community groups have worked to safeguard the Ojibway Prairie Complex. Securing this key parcel of the former Windsor Raceway marks a major milestone in the shared vision of bringing the broader Raceway lands into a National Urban Park. We are proud to celebrate this achievement with our partners and our community, who have long recognized the importance of protecting and restoring these irreplaceable habitats.
quotes.speaker: Mike Fisher
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: The City of Windsor has long been the proud steward of the lands that are helping to create this unique, important, and special place in our community. I, along with Council, have been champions and key supporters of the national urban park (NUP) since the possibility of the project and the process first began. We proudly bring our city-owned lands to the table as part of the once-in-a-generation initiative to create this new community space. From the start, we have expressed our unequivocal support for the establishment of the NUP in Windsor, along with barrier-free access for Windsorites in perpetuity, recognizing the immense value it will bring to our community. Today’s announcement represents another major project milestone, and we thank Parks Canada for responding to advocacy and securing these important lands. In addition to Parks Canada, we also thank the federal and provincial governments, the Ontario Conservation Accelerator, local First Nations, and all community stakeholders working together to realize the vision for the national urban park in Windsor.
quotes.speaker: Drew Dilkens
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: ERCA is proud to support the effort to create the Windsor area National Urban Park alongside many dedicated partners. We are pleased to contribute our conservation expertise and commitment to local watershed health to this effort. This milestone shows what collaboration can achieve for nature and future generations, and we extend our heartfelt appreciation to the Ontario Conservation Accelerator, Parks Canada and all partners for protecting this important land.
quotes.speaker: Molly Allaire
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and partners acquire 19 hectares of former Windsor Raceway to contribute to proposed national urban park in the Windsor area

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.6 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing, and groceries. When we invest in kids, we’re investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.article_title: Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027

quotes.quote_text: Supporting children means supporting the people who care for them every day. The Canada Child Benefit provides predictable, tax-free assistance that helps families navigate the rising cost of living and create brighter opportunities for the next generation.
quotes.speaker: Leslie Church
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Secretary to the Secretaries, for Seniors, and for Children and Youth, and to the Minister of Jobs and Families (Persons with Disabilities)
quotes.article_title: Canada Child Benefit payments increasing in 2026-2027

quotes.quote_text: Making life more affordable for families so that children have every opportunity to learn, grow, and reach their full potential is a critical part of our government's commitment to building stronger communities and a more prosperous Canada. By increasing the Canada Child Benefit, we're putting more money in the pockets of parents across the Northwest Territories to help pay for groceries, school supplies, and other everyday essentials.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Alty
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Alty highlights increased Canada Child Benefit support for families in the Northwest Territories

quotes.quote_text: Starting Monday, the Canada Child Benefit is going up for 3.5 million Canadian families. This increased monthly payment will help cover everyday expenses like school supplies, clothing, and groceries. When we invest in kids, we're investing in our future and building Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Alty highlights increased Canada Child Benefit support for families in the Northwest Territories

quotes.quote_text: Canada and Quebec share the same ambition: to do things better and faster. The draft agreement announced today and our new “one project, one review” approach will help reduce the duplication of regulatory authorization systems all the while strengthening environmental protection measures. In offering more predictability to proponents and to communities, we are creating conditions that are favourable to investments and the completion of new projects in Quebec.
quotes.speaker: Joël Lightbound
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Public Works and Procurement and Québec Lieutenant
quotes.article_title: Canada announces a draft agreement with Quebec to accelerate the construction of major projects in Quebec

quotes.quote_text: This draft agreement with Quebec reflects our commitment to working with provinces to ensure the implementation of a “one project, one review” approach for major projects. By reducing duplication and ensuring collaboration, we can move projects forward more efficiently while upholding our strong environmental standards and honouring our respective constitutional obligations to Indigenous Peoples.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Canada announces a draft agreement with Quebec to accelerate the construction of major projects in Quebec

quotes.quote_text: This agreement in principle illustrates cooperative federalism in action: we are working together with the government of Quebec to eliminate duplication while aligning our respective impact assessment processes all the while respecting each other’s jurisdictions. It will provide the kind of predictability that will benefit both to investors and to Indigenous rights holders, ensuring that major projects move forward efficiently and responsibly.
quotes.speaker: Dominic LeBlanc
quotes.speaker_title: President, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy
quotes.article_title: Canada announces a draft agreement with Quebec to accelerate the construction of major projects in Quebec

quotes.quote_text: The draft agreement is a major step forward for Quebec and will help accelerate economic and energy development across our entire territory, while protecting the environment in accordance with the highest standards. By having a single environmental assessment and a single government decision for the same project, we will make it easier to carry out major projects by reducing uncertainty for investors and providing them with greater predictability.
quotes.speaker: Pascale Déry
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, the Fight Against Climate Change, Wildlife and Parks
quotes.article_title: Canada announces a draft agreement with Quebec to accelerate the construction of major projects in Quebec

quotes.quote_text: I am very proud of the agreement in principle announced today. It demonstrates the shared commitment of the Government of Quebec and the federal government to fostering the development of projects that will drive economic growth. This agreement also underscores the importance that Quebec places on the decision-making and consultative processes set out in the James Bay and Northern Quebec Agreement, as well as in the Northeastern Quebec Agreement
quotes.speaker: Jean Boulet
quotes.article_title: Canada announces a draft agreement with Quebec to accelerate the construction of major projects in Quebec

quotes.quote_text: Companies need an efficient and predictable framework to carry out their projects. By adopting the principle of a single environmental assessment and a single government decision for each project, we are further streamlining processes procedures, reducing delays and lowering costs for proponents, while still maintaining some of the most stringent environmental standards. This is a concrete way to provide businesses with an even greater predictability, facilitate the delivery of major projects and support Quebec’s economic development.
quotes.speaker: Bernard Drainville
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Innovation and Energy and Minister Responsible for Maritime Strategy
quotes.article_title: Canada announces a draft agreement with Quebec to accelerate the construction of major projects in Quebec

quotes.quote_text: This federal investment in Green Hill’s wastewater system will improve essential services for residents while helping ensure the community is well positioned for the future.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in wastewater infrastructure in Green Hill

quotes.quote_text: The Municipality is appreciative for the sharing of the costs of installing this new wastewater system with federal government and provincial partners. I know the residents of Salem have waited a long time for this to happen and I am pleased for them that the day has finally come. This is also, good news for our whole county as infrastructure such as this will lead to more new home construction in this area of Pictou County.
quotes.speaker: Robert Parker
quotes.speaker_title: Warden of the Municipality of Pictou County
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in wastewater infrastructure in Green Hill

quotes.quote_text: From approval to groundbreaking in just three months, the Sunrise Expansion Program shows how Canada is getting major projects built. This expansion will provide reliable natural gas for homes, hospitals, schools and B.C.’s growing low-carbon energy sector while creating thousands of well-paying careers and new, diverse international trade opportunities. This is how we strengthen Canadian energy security, support affordability and prove once again what being an energy superpower looks like.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Construction begins on the Enbridge Sunrise Expansion Program

quotes.quote_text: Breaking ground on Enbridge’s Sunrise expansion is a big step forward for our economy, for good local jobs and for Indigenous communities. Through our government’s Look West strategy, we’re building the kind of lasting prosperity that keeps our hospitals, schools and communities strong for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Ravi Kahlon
quotes.speaker_title: B.C Minister of Jobs and Economic Growth
quotes.article_title: Construction begins on the Enbridge Sunrise Expansion Program

quotes.quote_text: The Sunrise Expansion project demonstrates what's possible when First Nations, industry and government work together with a shared commitment to building a stronger future. For Lheidli T'enneh, meaningful partnerships are about more than economic opportunity — they are about ensuring our Nation has a seat at the table in shaping projects that will benefit our people and region for generations to come. By working collaboratively, we can help build a reliable and secure energy future that supports growing communities, creates opportunities for First Nations participation and respects the lands and waters that have sustained for time immemorial. This is the kind of partnership that moves reconciliation from words to action while strengthening a shared future.
quotes.speaker: Chief Dolleen Logan
quotes.article_title: Construction begins on the Enbridge Sunrise Expansion Program

quotes.quote_text: Today marks an important milestone as construction begins on the Sunrise Expansion Program. We appreciate the ongoing support of the Government of Canada and the Government of British Columbia to advance this critical natural gas infrastructure project. This project will strengthen energy security, support economic growth, create jobs and help to ensure Canadians have access to reliable, affordable energy for decades to come. We’re proud to be working alongside Indigenous groups, local communities, contractors and labour across British Columbia as we move this project from approval to construction and deliver lasting benefits for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Greg Ebel
quotes.article_title: Construction begins on the Enbridge Sunrise Expansion Program

quotes.quote_text: The Sunrise Expansion Program will be built in Canada, with Canadian steel. InterPro Pipe + Steel is proud to supply steel that is 100 percent melted and poured in Canada for this nation-building project. By choosing Canadian steel, we are supporting skilled workers, strengthening domestic supply chains and ensuring Canada’s critical energy infrastructure is built with Canadian materials. This is how we create lasting jobs, resilient communities and long-term economic benefits across the country.
quotes.speaker: Doug Matthews
quotes.article_title: Construction begins on the Enbridge Sunrise Expansion Program

quotes.quote_text: The ties between Canada and Ireland have helped shape the history, culture and identity of our two countries. The signing of this Memorandum of Understanding marks an important milestone in the preparations for the Canada-Ireland 180 celebrations, which will highlight 180 years of shared history shaped by the arrival of more than 100,000 Irish people in Canada following the Great Famine. The year 2027 will celebrate this shared heritage while opening up new avenues for cultural, artistic and economic collaboration.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ireland strengthen their cultural cooperation to celebrate 180 years of historic ties in 2027

quotes.quote_text: It is extremely positive for Ireland and Canada to sign the Memorandum of Understanding on cultural cooperation today, signifying the deepening of the Ireland–Canada relationship in the context of the partnership agreed to by the Taoiseach and Prime Minister Carney in June.
quotes.speaker: Patrick O’Donovan
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ireland strengthen their cultural cooperation to celebrate 180 years of historic ties in 2027

quotes.quote_text: Our government is delivering on its plan to build a stronger Canadian and Quebec economy by investing in the industries that create well-paying jobs and that drive and strengthen Canada’s industrial capabilities. Through our engagement with Pratt & Whitney Canada, we are maintaining hundreds of high-value jobs, advancing our key sovereign capabilities, and positioning Canadian workers and businesses to succeed in an increasingly competitive global economy.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces engagement with Pratt & Whitney Canada to strengthen Canada’s aerospace sector

quotes.quote_text: Strengthening our industrial capabilities in Longueuil will enhance our ability to deliver world-class propulsion systems to customers around the globe while driving operational excellence through innovation and advanced manufacturing. This initiative underscores our commitment to supporting the growth of the Canadian aerospace industry and contributing to its global leadership.
quotes.speaker: Satheeshkumar Kumarasingam
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces engagement with Pratt & Whitney Canada to strengthen Canada’s aerospace sector

quotes.quote_text: Our government is firmly committed to working in partnership with Indigenous communities to create real economic opportunities. Today’s announcement of a contract to build a multi-residential project in Iqaluit will help address local housing pressures while supporting Canadian businesses and workers. Inuit-owned firm Arctic Fresh Projects is bringing their expertise to the project, and under our new Buy Canadian Policy, they will use Canadian materials to get the job done. It’s a perfect example of how we are using homegrown talent and materials to build more prosperous communities in Canada’s north.
quotes.speaker: Joël Lightbound
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Public Works and Procurement and Quebec Lieutenant
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada selects Inuit firm to construct a multi-residential complex in Iqaluit, Nunavut

quotes.quote_text: Building a new 23-unit housing complex here in Iqaluit is good news for Nunavummiut, and good news for the many Canadian builders and suppliers who will bring the project to life under the Buy Canadian Policy. The contract, awarded to Inuit-owned Arctic Fresh Projects, reflects our commitment to supporting Inuit entrepreneurs. Our government will continue working with local partners and Indigenous Peoples to advance projects that will build a more prosperous future for Canada’s north.
quotes.speaker: Lori Idlout
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada selects Inuit firm to construct a multi-residential complex in Iqaluit, Nunavut

quotes.quote_text: Housing is the foundation for health, safety and resilient communities. This new residential complex in Iqaluit is an important investment that will increase the supply of affordable housing, support local economic growth and create good jobs. Through partnerships with Inuit-owned businesses and our commitment to Canadian-made materials, we are addressing the housing crisis and improving living conditions for people, so we can build Nunavut strong.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada selects Inuit firm to construct a multi-residential complex in Iqaluit, Nunavut

quotes.quote_text: It is great to see that this 23-unit project not only falls within our government’s new Buy Canadian Policy, but also that the construction contract was awarded to an Inuit-owned business, Arctic Fresh Projects. With an Inuit Benefits Plan included, this project will help bolster Inuit business capacity and further contribute to strengthening the North, creating jobs and advancing prosperity. We will continue to work with local partners and Indigenous Peoples, strengthen economic relationships with Inuit entrepreneurs, and build the North strong, together.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Chartrand
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada selects Inuit firm to construct a multi-residential complex in Iqaluit, Nunavut

quotes.quote_text: Communities across Atlantic Canada need infrastructure that works, today and for the future. This targeted investment will help get federal dollars directly into rural Cape Breton to build and upgrade the places people rely on every day. Practical investments like this support for the Donkin Morien Community Association, will bring people together, strengthen families, and help ensure this essential community space remains safe, accessible, and sustainable for many years.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: $50,000 in federal funding will support upgrades at playground in Donkin

quotes.quote_text: Growing up in Cape Breton, we all know the importance of places where families gather, children make lifelong memories, and neighbours come together. This playground is more than just equipment—it is a place where community happens. I’m proud that our government is investing in the Donkin Morien Community Association to help create a safe, welcoming space that families can enjoy for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Mike Kelloway
quotes.article_title: $50,000 in federal funding will support upgrades at playground in Donkin

quotes.quote_text: Community spaces bring people together, encourage active living and help create a sense of belonging. By investing in accessible playground infrastructure, we are helping ensure everyone has the opportunity to learn, play and connect. We are proud to support this project in Donkin and the positive impact it will have on residents and visitors for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Brian Comer
quotes.speaker_title: Nova Scotia Minister of Addictions and Mental Health and MLA for Cape Breton East
quotes.article_title: $50,000 in federal funding will support upgrades at playground in Donkin

quotes.quote_text: Investments like this do more than upgrade a playground; they strengthen the heart of our community. When we create safe, accessible spaces for families to gather, play, and grow, we’re building a healthier, more connected Cape Breton for the next generation.
quotes.speaker: Cecil Clarke
quotes.article_title: $50,000 in federal funding will support upgrades at playground in Donkin

quotes.quote_text: The Donkin Morien Community Association is thrilled to receive this support in making our playground dreams a reality. We are so excited to see this project come to life in creating an inclusive space for kids to play for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Katherine Snow
quotes.article_title: $50,000 in federal funding will support upgrades at playground in Donkin

quotes.quote_text: Community organizations like IWK Health are key partners in connecting youth to mental health supports. They understand the unique needs of young people in their communities and the challenges that they face in accessing care. By investing in young Canadians today, we are building a stronger, healthier Canada for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.article_title: Improving access to community-based mental health services for Nova Scotia youth

quotes.quote_text: Every young person deserves to know that when they reach out for help, it will be there. This investment will expand Anchor Youth Space across Nova Scotia, bringing mental health care, primary care, peer support, and other services closer to where young people live. By making care easier to access and better connected, we're helping more youth and their families get the support they need, when they need it.
quotes.speaker: Maggie Chi
quotes.article_title: Improving access to community-based mental health services for Nova Scotia youth

quotes.quote_text: Early access to mental health and wellness supports can make a meaningful difference in a young person’s life. This investment will strengthen Nova Scotia’s Integrated Youth Services network, helping more youth and families connect with walk-in supports and services, closer to home. Together with IWK Health, government and partner investments, and community organizations, we are expanding access, reducing barriers and making it easier for young people to get help in places they feel comfortable, connected, and understood.
quotes.speaker: Brian Comer
quotes.speaker_title: Nova Scotia Minister of Addictions and Mental Health
quotes.article_title: Improving access to community-based mental health services for Nova Scotia youth

quotes.quote_text: Anchor Youth Space demonstrates what's possible when governments, healthcare, community organizations, donors, youth and families come together around a shared vision. This investment will strengthen our network of Integrated Youth Services sites, helping more young people access the care and supports they need, when and where they need them.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Krista Jangaard
quotes.speaker_title: President and CEO, Izaak Walton Killam Health
quotes.article_title: Improving access to community-based mental health services for Nova Scotia youth

quotes.quote_text: Healthy lakes and rivers are essential to the communities that rely on them. Through joint inspection efforts with the Government of Manitoba, we are working to protect those waters from aquatic invasive species and preserve Canada’s freshwater ecosystems for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Fisheries and Oceans Canada partners with Manitoba government to complete second aquatic invasive species roadside inspection blitz of the season on Highway 1

quotes.quote_text: Aquatic invasive species can easily cross provincial borders and Manitoba is proud to continue to work with the federal government to conduct joint inspections of watercraft to help protect our lakes and rivers. By working together, we’re preserving this precious natural resource for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Mike Moyes
quotes.speaker_title: Manitoba Environment and Climate Change Minister
quotes.article_title: Fisheries and Oceans Canada partners with Manitoba government to complete second aquatic invasive species roadside inspection blitz of the season on Highway 1

quotes.quote_text: Manitobans know how much our lakes and rivers matter to our economy, our environment, and our way of life. Stopping species like Zebra Mussels at the roadside is one of the smartest, most cost-effective ways to protect those waters. My thanks to everyone who took part in this blitz. This is hands-on prevention that keeps our freshwater healthy for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Hon. Terry Duguid
quotes.article_title: Fisheries and Oceans Canada partners with Manitoba government to complete second aquatic invasive species roadside inspection blitz of the season on Highway 1

quotes.quote_text: To build a stronger economy, Canada needs the knowledge, talent and partnerships that help industries adapt and compete in a rapidly changing world. These projects will generate new insights that support innovation, strengthen public and private sector decision-making, and create the conditions for economic growth and prosperity across Canada.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests more than $289 million to address social and economic challenges

quotes.quote_text: Research in the social sciences and humanities is the cornerstone of a resilient, forward-thinking society. This announcement reflects our deep commitment to Canadian research. By supporting these projects, we are empowering scholars to develop the vital insights and collaborative solutions needed to build a more resilient, equitable and innovative future for everyone.
quotes.speaker: Karim Bardeesy
quotes.dept_en: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests more than $289 million to address social and economic challenges

quotes.quote_text: The social sciences and humanities are essential for understanding people and our society, as well as addressing the domestic and global challenges of our time. By supporting these diverse research teams and their partners, we are ensuring Canadian insights continue to lead the way in creating a more inclusive and prosperous society.
quotes.speaker: Normand Labrie
quotes.speaker_title: Interim President of the Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council
quotes.dept_en: Social Sciences and Humanities Research Council of Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests more than $289 million to address social and economic challenges

quotes.quote_text: Canada recognizes that keeping the Canadian Armed Forces strong requires continuous innovation and deeper collaboration with trusted Allies. Observer status in the Global Combat Air Programme will strengthen Canada's understanding of next-generation capabilities while advancing the partnerships, industrial capacity and expertise needed to safeguard our sovereignty and contribute to our collective security.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Minister McGuinty concludes United Kingdom visit focused on strengthening defence cooperation

quotes.quote_text: When we support projects like the regional food hub, we are backing local entrepreneurs and building a stronger, more self-reliant food economy in Northwestern Ontario. Through this project, we are empowering Canadians businesses as they grow and adapt, because strong local economies are the building blocks of a more resilient Canada, one that can support its people and create lasting benefits.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investing nearly $500,000 in the agri-food industry of Northwestern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: The Northwestern Ontario Innovation Centre is very excited to launch the Food Enterprises Advancement and SME Transformation (FEAST) program with support from FEDNOR and our delivery partner, Seven Generations Education Institute. There are many great businesses in Northwestern Ontario tied to the Food and Agri-Tech sectors that just need a little support or access to a commercial kitchen space to get them to the next level. This program will provide that support and in turn help our communities and the sector as a whole across Northwestern Ontario grow and prosper.
quotes.speaker: Richard Gemmill
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investing nearly $500,000 in the agri-food industry of Northwestern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: We are proud to support lifelong learning for everyone across the Treaty 3 area. As a FEAST program partner, SGEI will empower local entrepreneurs as they seek to grow their businesses. We’re excited for the valuable opportunities this partnership will bring to our region.
quotes.speaker: Brent Tookenay
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investing nearly $500,000 in the agri-food industry of Northwestern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is helping businesses remain competitive and resilient in a rapidly changing global economy. Today's investments will support three Guelph companies in strengthening their operations, increasing productivity, and pursuing new opportunities for growth, helping create good jobs and build a stronger regional economy.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests to help Guelph businesses grow, innovate and increase their resilience

quotes.quote_text: Guelph is home to innovative businesses that grow our local, regional, and national economy, and support supply chains across Ontario. Today's investments will help these companies adapt and adopt new technologies to remain competitive, support workers, and continue growing here at home.
quotes.speaker: Dominique O'Rourke
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests to help Guelph businesses grow, innovate and increase their resilience

quotes.quote_text: FedDev Ontario is investing $900,000 to expand Comoldco Corporation’s compression molding capacity, strengthening Canada's domestic composite manufacturing capabilities. This funding will enhance production for key sectors, including automotive, defence, and other industrial applications.
quotes.speaker: Dave Deegala
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests to help Guelph businesses grow, innovate and increase their resilience

quotes.quote_text: Poly-Nova Technologies is pleased to receive support from FedDev Ontario through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative. This funding will accelerate our efforts to localize critical components, reducing supply chain dependencies and mitigating cost fluctuations. It will also strengthen our in-house technical expertise, enabling more efficient innovation and the rapid development of advanced materials for our growing global customer base.
quotes.speaker: Kirk Brownell
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests to help Guelph businesses grow, innovate and increase their resilience

quotes.quote_text: We are honoured to receive support from FedDev Ontario as this investment will help accelerate our growth and continue developing innovative solutions right here in Ontario. Beyond strengthening our business, this funding allows us to create high-quality jobs, invest in advanced technologies, and better serve our customers across Ontario and beyond.
quotes.speaker: Jonathan Cohen
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests to help Guelph businesses grow, innovate and increase their resilience

quotes.quote_text: When one person in Camrose gets the chance to build a good life, the whole community benefits. Through investments in organizations like Camrose Open Door Association and Camrose Association for Community Living, we are helping youth and persons with disabilities gain the skills, experience and support they need to find meaningful employment. Investments like this are how we build a stronger economy, one community at a time.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests over $1.5 million to help remove employment barriers for youth and persons with disabilities

quotes.quote_text: Organizations like Camrose Open Door Association and Camrose Association for Community Living are helping people overcome barriers to employment and lead better lives. These investments will strengthen their ability to provide the supports and services that connect people with quality jobs and give them greater economic independence.
quotes.speaker: Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Industry
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests over $1.5 million to help remove employment barriers for youth and persons with disabilities

quotes.quote_text: Building a strong Canada starts with building strong communities. Through unprecedented investments in infrastructure, the Government of Canada is delivering projects that help people connected, stay active, and thrive. Investments in facilities like the Bob MacQuarrie Recreation Complex are helping build stronger, safer, and more resilient communities for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in the Bob MacQuarrie Recreation Complex

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today’s investment in the Bob MacQuarrie Recreation Complex in Orléans will enhance the facility’s capacity to meet the growing recreational needs of our community. By adding a new gymnasium, this project will expand access to recreational programming and services, helping residents stay active, connected, and engaged for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Marie-France Lalonde
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in the Bob MacQuarrie Recreation Complex

quotes.quote_text: Orléans is one of Ottawa’s fastest-growing communities, and investments like this help ensure our neighbourhoods grow with the spaces residents need to connect, stay active, and build a strong sense of community. I want to thank the Government of Canada for this important investment in the Bob MacQuarrie Recreation Complex. This new gymnasium will create more opportunities for residents of all ages and abilities to participate in recreation programs, gather with their neighbours, and enjoy a facility that reflects the needs of our growing community.
quotes.speaker: Mayor Mark Sutcliffe
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in the Bob MacQuarrie Recreation Complex

quotes.quote_text: Saskatchewan has long been an agricultural powerhouse. Across the province, farmers, researchers, entrepreneurs, and businesses are helping grow the food Canada and the world need. Our government is investing so Saskatchewan can do even more with those strengths here at home — expanding value-added agriculture, growing food processing and manufacturing, and strengthening domestic supply chains — driving economic growth and creating good jobs along the way.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support for agriculture sector in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Our agriculture and agri-food sector supports 2.3 million jobs across Canada and exports more than $100 billion in products to over 200 countries. Here in Saskatchewan, the sector accounts for over 40% of the province’s exports, reaching $18 billion in 2025. By investing in innovation and securing new economic partnerships, we are helping Canadian businesses reach new markets, building on the $33 billion in exports to non-U.S. markets last year that included world-class products from Saskatchewan farmers.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support for agriculture sector in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Saskatchewan feeds Canada and the world, and our agri-food sector is built on generations of agricultural strength and innovation in rural communities across the province. These new investments are about making sure the next generation of producers, processors, and agri-food businesses can keep growing and keep good jobs right here at home. Whether it’s developing new products or reaching new markets, we’re making sure Saskatchewan continues to lead as one of the best places in the world to grow and produce food.
quotes.speaker: Buckley Belanger
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support for agriculture sector in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: This new platform dramatically enhances our ability to generate the high-quality genomic data needed to advance next generation agriculture. The increased capacity and efficiency of the NovaSeq X Plus will help GIFS to further bridge the gap between scientific discovery and practical application, enabling faster translation of genomic innovations into solutions that benefit farmers, strengthen food systems, and support economic growth across the Prairies.
quotes.speaker: Jason Reinheimer
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support for agriculture sector in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: This investment will strengthen Saskatchewan's ability to help agri-food and biotech innovators move from idea to market. By expanding access to biomanufacturing infrastructure, specialized equipment, and a collaborative ecosystem, GAAP will help companies accelerate commercialization, create new value-added opportunities for Canadian agriculture, and build the next generation of successful agri-food and biotech businesses in Saskatchewan.
quotes.speaker: Jeremy Lang
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support for agriculture sector in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today’s investment in recreational infrastructure in Surrey will help create welcoming, accessible, and vibrant community spaces where people can get outside and enjoy their time—whether kids are playing sports, neighbours are out for a walk, or families are spending time together outdoors. These investments help make local parks more welcoming, active, and enjoyable year-round.
quotes.speaker: Sukh Dhaliwal
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in Newton Parks

quotes.quote_text: Both Unwin Park and Newton Athletic Park are important community spaces that serve residents and attract visitors from across the region. These investments will create more opportunities for people to be active, and foster community connections, health and wellbeing. We are grateful to the Government of Canada for helping us deliver the park amenities our growing community needs that strengthen the resilience and quality of life for residents for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Brenda Locke
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in Newton Parks

quotes.quote_text: Building a stronger, more affordable, better connected electricity system is essential to Canada’s energy security, economic growth and long-term climate competitiveness. This investment is our government doing what we said we would do by advancing a priority transmission project. Strengthening the connection between Prince Edward Island and New Brunswick will help us meet electricity demand with the reliable, affordable electricity Canadians need to thrive.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Canada invests in the Prince Edward Island–New Brunswick Interconnection Expansion Project

quotes.quote_text: Reliable energy is the foundation of a strong economy and thriving communities. By investing in critical infrastructure today, Prince Edward Island is preparing for future growth and increasing energy demand. This project will help create a stronger, more resilient energy system that Islanders, businesses and communities can count on for generations.
quotes.speaker: Rob Lantz
quotes.article_title: Canada invests in the Prince Edward Island–New Brunswick Interconnection Expansion Project

quotes.quote_text: Energy infrastructure does not stop at provincial borders, making strong partnerships essential for long-term planning and investment. By working together with the Government of Canada, provinces and partners, our critical infrastructure investments are co-ordinated, effective and positioned to meet the future energy needs of Prince Edward Island.
quotes.speaker: Ernie Hudson
quotes.article_title: Canada invests in the Prince Edward Island–New Brunswick Interconnection Expansion Project

quotes.quote_text: New Brunswick is the Maritimes’ energy hub. Securing and strengthening our electricity interties with PEI will help us build a cleaner, more affordable, reliable and resilient electricity system for our entire region and country. Working together with our neighbours, New Brunswick will power Canada's energy future.
quotes.speaker: Susan Holt
quotes.article_title: Canada invests in the Prince Edward Island–New Brunswick Interconnection Expansion Project

quotes.quote_text: Operation LATITUDE is a Canadian Armed Forces sovereignty operation conducted alongside our Allies in northern waters. Through regular, professional and coordinated activities, we reinforce Arctic sovereignty, protect Canada’s northern approaches and defend North American territory against evolving security threats.
quotes.speaker: Lieutenant-General Steve Boivin
quotes.article_title: Canadian Armed Forces conduct Operation LATITUDE to strengthen Allied multi-domain operations in northern waters

quotes.quote_text: Building a more efficient and better-connected electricity system is essential to our energy security, economic growth and the affordable cost of living Canadians rightly expect. We are proud to be working with the Maritime provinces to strengthen regional electricity co-operation, because only through collaboration can we truly build a reliable, affordable and clean electricity system that will benefit Canadians for generations.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Building a stronger Maritime electricity grid

quotes.quote_text: A more connected Maritime electricity system will lower costs for households and improve grid reliability across our region. It’s co-operative federalism in action — working together across jurisdictions to deliver lasting benefits for Maritimers and all Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Dominic LeBlanc
quotes.speaker_title: President, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy
quotes.article_title: Building a stronger Maritime electricity grid

quotes.quote_text: We’ve never approached electricity as one region before. The federal government is bringing Atlantic provinces together to better connect our electricity grids. By planning together instead of separately, we’ll make better use of the electricity we already generate, be better able to support one another during storms, outages, periods of high demand, and help keep electricity costs down for Atlantic Canadians over the long term.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Building a stronger Maritime electricity grid
