quotes.quote_text: Over the past five years, Nova Scotia has made significant advances in modernizing our electricity system, and we owe it to ratepayers to keep looking ahead at what more can be done. If this review shows that regional collaboration will generate cost savings and value for Nova Scotians and improve reliability across all three provinces, then we would be very interested in new approaches.
quotes.speaker: Tim Houston
quotes.article_title: Building a stronger Maritime electricity grid

quotes.quote_text: New Brunswick is the Maritimes’ energy hub. From our leadership in nuclear energy to stronger electricity interties across the region, New Brunswick is well positioned to help build a cleaner, more affordable, reliable and resilient electricity system. Working together with our neighbours, New Brunswick will power Canada’s energy future.
quotes.speaker: Susan Holt
quotes.article_title: Building a stronger Maritime electricity grid

quotes.quote_text: As provinces, we are stronger when we work together. This agreement brings the Maritime provinces together to strengthen regional electricity planning and build a more connected system that benefits everyone. For Prince Edward Island, it’s about improving reliability, supporting economic growth and helping ensure Islanders have the secure energy system they deserve.
quotes.speaker: Rob Lantz
quotes.article_title: Building a stronger Maritime electricity grid

quotes.quote_text: Through the Build Communities Strong Fund, our government is delivering infrastructure investments at a speed and scale not seen in generations, with more than $155 million going to support priorities across Nunavut. Together with our efforts to expand housing through Build Canada Homes, our partnership with the Government of Nunavut is helping build stronger, safer, and better-connected communities for all Nunavummiut.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Alty
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, on behalf of the Honourable Gregor Robertson, Minister
quotes.article_title: Canada and Nunavut partner to build essential infrastructure and more homes

quotes.quote_text: These investments reflect our commitment to building a stronger, more resilient and prosperous North. By supporting critical infrastructure and expanding housing opportunities across Nunavut, we are helping communities grow and bolstering Arctic Sovereignty - supporting Nunavummiut now and for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Chartrand
quotes.article_title: Canada and Nunavut partner to build essential infrastructure and more homes

quotes.quote_text: Through the Build Communities Strong Fund, we are upgrading the essential health infrastructure that Nunavummiut rely on. These investments will improve access to safe, reliable and high-quality care closer to home, strengthen community well-being, and support healthier futures for families across Nunavut. All Canadians deserve quality health services, when and where they need them.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.article_title: Canada and Nunavut partner to build essential infrastructure and more homes

quotes.quote_text: Nunavummiut deserve modern, reliable infrastructure that reflects the realities of life in the North. Through the Build Communities Strong Fund, and alongside efforts to expand housing through Build Canada Homes, we are making generational investments to strengthen health infrastructure, increase housing, and build stronger communities across Nunavut.
quotes.speaker: Lori Idlout
quotes.article_title: Canada and Nunavut partner to build essential infrastructure and more homes

quotes.quote_text: Nunavut communities require infrastructure that is reliable, sustainable, and designed for the unique realities of the North. Through these agreements, we will strengthen critical health infrastructure while supporting the essential infrastructure needed to enable future housing and community development across the territory. Our government values its partnership with Canada and the long-term benefits these investments will bring to Nunavummiut.
quotes.speaker: George Hickes
quotes.article_title: Canada and Nunavut partner to build essential infrastructure and more homes

quotes.quote_text: Housing is about more than just walls and shelter. It is the foundation for healthy families and growing communities. Building more homes also requires the infrastructure needed to support them, including roads, water and waste systems. Together, we’re making progress on housing across Nunavut, and this partnership helps us build on that momentum and deliver more homes for Nunavummiut.
quotes.speaker: Cecile Lyall
quotes.speaker_title: Minister responsible for the Nunavut Housing Corporatio, n
quotes.article_title: Canada and Nunavut partner to build essential infrastructure and more homes

quotes.quote_text: NTI welcomes the finalization of the Build Canada Homes agreement, including NTI’s role in delivering 25 of the 750 new homes. This is an important first step toward expanding Inuit-led delivery of affordable housing that Inuit can access independent of their employer. Building on this agreement, NTI has submitted a proposal to Build Canada Homes for a further 400 affordable homes, together with investments in Inuit-led manufacturing and construction capacity across Nunavut. We look forward to working with Build Canada Homes, the Government of Nunavut and the Regional Inuit Associations to advance that proposal.
quotes.speaker: Paul Irngaut
quotes.article_title: Canada and Nunavut partner to build essential infrastructure and more homes

quotes.quote_text: This agreement reflects the strength of partnership needed to accelerate housing delivery in Nunavut. Through Build Canada Homes, we are focused on supporting approaches that are community‑driven, culturally informed, and rooted in Inuit leadership. By combining modern construction methods with local expertise, we can deliver homes more predictably and efficiently. We look forward to working closely with our partners to turn this commitment into quality homes that make a meaningful difference.
quotes.speaker: Ana Bailão
quotes.article_title: Canada and Nunavut partner to build essential infrastructure and more homes

quotes.quote_text: Reliable, modern public transit is key to building connected and resilient communities. We are partnering with provinces and territories to build the local infrastructure that our communities need. The Yonge North Subway Extension is exactly the sort of project that will help grow Toronto strong and shape the future of how we move and explore our community.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario celebrate another milestone for the Yonge North Subway Extension

quotes.quote_text: I am thrilled to see construction is now underway on the Yonge North Subway Extension. This project will help to transform the commute for thousands in York Region, North York and beyond. The Government of Canada will continue to deliver public transit funding across the country that will help to build transit-oriented communities.
quotes.speaker: Ali Ehsassi
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario celebrate another milestone for the Yonge North Subway Extension

quotes.quote_text: Our government is making historic investments in public transit to protect Ontario’s economy and keep people moving in the face of tariffs and economic uncertainty. The Yonge North Subway Extension will bring subway service to Markham and Richmond Hill for the first time ever and connect thousands of people to housing and good-paying jobs.
quotes.speaker: Prabmeet Sarkaria
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario celebrate another milestone for the Yonge North Subway Extension

quotes.quote_text: Today’s groundbreaking for the Yonge North Subway Extension marks a significant milestone for York Region and a project we have long advocated for. Once complete, the Yonge North Subway Extension will transform how people move across our communities, connecting residents to jobs, housing and opportunity while helping to reduce congestion. On behalf of York Regional Council and our 1.3 million residents, we thank the Government of Canada, the Province of Ontario and our municipal partners for their continued collaboration in delivering this critical transit project and supporting a more connected and sustainable future for York Region.
quotes.speaker: Eric Jolliffe
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario celebrate another milestone for the Yonge North Subway Extension

quotes.quote_text: This year’s Farnborough International Airshow was an important opportunity to showcase Canada as a trusted global partner for aerospace investment, innovation and growth. As countries and industry look to build more resilient and competitive supply chains, Canada continues to stand out through the strength of our industrial base, world-class workforce and world-renowned capabilities. Our government will keep working with industry to attract investment, create well-paying jobs and strengthen Canada’s position as a global aerospace leader. We are building a stronger economy and ensuring Canadian expertise continues to compete and succeed on the world stage.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly advances the Canadian aerospace industry at the Farnborough International Airshow in the United Kingdom

quotes.quote_text: “This seizure reflects the scale of criminal activity that crosses borders and impacts communities across Ontario. By removing more than a metric tonne of illegal drugs and multiple firearms from circulation, we have significantly disrupted the flow of harmful substances, prevented community harm and removed substantial profits from the criminal economy. This investigation highlights the critical role of integrated border enforcement, which enables the OPP to work in collaboration with municipal, provincial, federal and international partners to deter, detect and disrupt the cross‑border movement of illegal drugs and firearms.”– OPP Chief Superintendent Mike Stoddart
quotes.article_title: Nearly 1.7 tonnes of illegal drugs seized in one of the largest drug busts by weight in Ontario

quotes.quote_text: “Project Bay is a powerful example of how intelligence-led policing and inter-agency collaboration can deliver significant results. This investigation began as the result of information obtained by the Windsor Police Service and evolved into a complex operation spanning multiple jurisdictions across Ontario. Working closely with our policing partners, we were able to dismantle a network that was moving dangerous drugs and firearms into communities across the province and putting public safety at risk.” – WPS Chief Jason Crowley
quotes.speaker: WPS Chief Jason Crowley
quotes.article_title: Nearly 1.7 tonnes of illegal drugs seized in one of the largest drug busts by weight in Ontario

quotes.quote_text: “The Canada Border Services Agency works with domestic and international enforcement partners to prevent illegal drugs from entering Canada and disrupt criminal networks. Border services officers are Canada’s first line of defence, keeping communities safe from illegal drugs and organized crime. So far this year, the CBSA in Southern Ontario has seized 206 firearms and 5,555 kg of illegal drugs at land ports of entry. Thank you to all partners involved in the Project Bay investigation, particularly the Ontario Provincial Police and Windsor Police Service.” – Michael Prosia, Regional Director General for Southern Ontario, Canada Border Services Agency
quotes.speaker: Michael Prosia
quotes.speaker_title: Regional Director General for Southern Ontario, Canada Border Services Agency
quotes.article_title: Nearly 1.7 tonnes of illegal drugs seized in one of the largest drug busts by weight in Ontario

quotes.quote_text: “The success of Project Bay highlights the critical role of partnership-driven policing in addressing the complex challenges posed by drug trafficking networks. The Toronto Police Service was pleased to provide operational support throughout this investigation, which resulted in the seizure of nearly 1.7 tonnes of illegal drugs and 17 firearms before they could reach communities across Ontario. By disrupting criminal networks that fuel drug trafficking, violence and exploitation, this investigation has made a meaningful contribution to public safety in Toronto and beyond." – TPS Superintendent Ryan Forde
quotes.speaker: TPS Superintendent Ryan Forde
quotes.article_title: Nearly 1.7 tonnes of illegal drugs seized in one of the largest drug busts by weight in Ontario

quotes.quote_text: "Organized crime operates without regard for jurisdictional boundaries, and Project Bay demonstrates the impact of coordinated, interagency enforcement. Through intelligence sharing with our policing and border security partners, we disrupted criminal networks that profit from addiction and violence, preventing dangerous drugs and illegal firearms from reaching Peel Region and helping keep our communities safe." – Deputy Chief Nick Milinovich, Peel Regional Police
quotes.speaker: Deputy Chief Nick Milinovich
quotes.article_title: Nearly 1.7 tonnes of illegal drugs seized in one of the largest drug busts by weight in Ontario

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is making strategic investments to help businesses and organizations overcome tariff-related challenges, strengthen Canada’s economic foundation, build Canada’s defence industrial base and advance critical technologies that support our defence and security capabilities. By supporting businesses and workers today, we are building a more resilient economy for tomorrow. I’m thrilled to support the 23 Waterloo and Brant region businesses that are driving growth, innovation, opportunity, and resilience in our communities.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests nearly $40.5 million in Waterloo and Brant Region businesses and organizations to expand capacity and compete for a more resilient future

quotes.quote_text: Today’s investment is about strengthening businesses and organizations in the Waterloo and Brant regions and communities across southern Ontario, creating good jobs, and building confidence in our regional economy. By investing in businesses and workers today, we are laying the groundwork for a more resilient and prosperous future right here at home.
quotes.speaker: Bardish Chagger
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests nearly $40.5 million in Waterloo and Brant Region businesses and organizations to expand capacity and compete for a more resilient future

quotes.quote_text: Manufacturers and innovators in Kitchener–Conestoga and across Waterloo Region are vital to our economy, creating good jobs and helping our communities thrive. These investments will help businesses and organizations modernize, grow and pursue new opportunities while strengthening long-term prosperity for workers, families and communities and contributing to Canada’s economic sovereignty.
quotes.speaker: Tim Louis
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Secretary to the President, Minister responsible for Canada-U.S. Trade, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy and Member of Parliament for Kitchener–Conestoga
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests nearly $40.5 million in Waterloo and Brant Region businesses and organizations to expand capacity and compete for a more resilient future

quotes.quote_text: This funding will help us enhance our manufacturing capabilities, create high-value jobs, and continue delivering world-class products while strengthening Canada's industrial competitiveness. We also believe that continued investment in education, apprenticeships, and skilled trades training is essential to preparing the next generation of workers and equipping them with the skills needed to support a sustainable, competitive, and prosperous future for Canada.
quotes.speaker: Chris Hergott
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests nearly $40.5 million in Waterloo and Brant Region businesses and organizations to expand capacity and compete for a more resilient future

quotes.quote_text: Gros Morne is already one of Canada’s most remarkable places. This federal investment of more than $3.7 million will support a new culinary and cultural hub, strengthen community-led tourism and create new opportunities for local businesses, farmers and producers. It will help give visitors more reasons to stay longer, return throughout the year and spend more in communities across the region.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: $3.7M federal investment will help Gros Morne attract more visitors and extend the tourism season

quotes.quote_text: Atlantic Canada’s greatest advantage has always been its people, places and communities. Today’s investments will help communities in the Gros Morne region build on their unique assets, expand tourism and cultural opportunities, and create the conditions for long-term economic growth. Local and regional collaboration will help ensure Atlantic Canada remains a vibrant place to live, work, visit, and invest.
quotes.speaker: Kody Blois
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Secretary to the Prime Minister and Member
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: $3.7M federal investment will help Gros Morne attract more visitors and extend the tourism season

quotes.quote_text: We are grateful to the Government of Canada for this significant investment in our region. This funding will help strengthen the experiences that make our communities special, creating lasting benefits for both residents and visitors. Investments like this enhance the quality of life for those who call our region home, while ensuring we can continue to welcome travellers with vibrant, accessible, and memorable places to explore. We look forward to seeing the positive impact this project will have on our communities, our local economy, and the future of tourism across the region.
quotes.speaker: Colleen Kennedy
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: $3.7M federal investment will help Gros Morne attract more visitors and extend the tourism season

quotes.quote_text: GMIST is grateful for ACOA's investment in tourism across Atlantic Canada. This funding will help strengthen our tourism sector through training and development programs that support businesses and communities. These programs help to surface new opportunities to develop and showcase unique experiences and highlight the incredible natural and cultural assets that make the Atlantic region a world-class destination. Together, we are building a stronger, more resilient tourism industry that provides memorable experiences for our visitors while creating lasting benefits for our communities.
quotes.speaker: Nora Fever
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: $3.7M federal investment will help Gros Morne attract more visitors and extend the tourism season

quotes.quote_text: Shawanaga First Nation residents are happy that this 20-year project has finally come to fruition. The community now has access to clean water for the foreseeable future. Miigwech Nibi.
quotes.speaker: Chief Adam Pawis
quotes.article_title: Shawanaga First Nation Marks Grand Opening of New Water Treatment Plant

quotes.quote_text: Projects like the Shawanaga Water Treatment Plant are about supporting healthy communities and creating meaningful opportunities for future generations. This important milestone would not have been possible without the hard work of community leadership and the strength of our partnership.
quotes.speaker: Mandy Gull-Masty
quotes.article_title: Shawanaga First Nation Marks Grand Opening of New Water Treatment Plant

quotes.quote_text: By strengthening its drinking water systems and expanding access to essential services, Shawanaga First Nation is creating the foundation for a healthier, more resilient future. This investment will ensure community members have reliable access to clean and safe drinking water for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Shawanaga First Nation Marks Grand Opening of New Water Treatment Plant

quotes.quote_text: Our government is proud to support local infrastructure projects that lay the foundation for strong, resilient communities and make a real difference in people’s lives. Shawanaga First Nation’s new water treatment plant is part of Ontario’s $236 billion capital plan over the next decade to build and expand infrastructure that will protect communities, create jobs and support economic growth.
quotes.speaker: Todd McCarthy
quotes.article_title: Shawanaga First Nation Marks Grand Opening of New Water Treatment Plant

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Child Benefit is about giving families the breathing room they need to thrive. Over the last decade, this program has made a real difference in the lives of millions of children and parents by providing stable, tax-free support that keeps pace with the cost of living. Combined with other key initiatives, we are building a fairer future where every family can succeed.
quotes.speaker: Anna Gainey
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger highlights increases to Canada Child Benefit payments in 2026–2027

quotes.quote_text: Parents across Saskatchewan want the same thing: to give their kids the best possible start in life. The Canada Child Benefit already helps take some of that weight off their shoulders by putting more money back into the pockets of more than 134,000 Saskatchewan families every month to help pay for the things children need. That support has now increased, so we can help give children across Canada the strong start they deserve.
quotes.speaker: Buckley Belanger
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger highlights increases to Canada Child Benefit payments in 2026–2027

quotes.quote_text: The Atlantic Green Shipping Corridor MoU demonstrates what can be achieved through international collaboration. I welcome Spain as the newest signatory to this growing partnership, joining Canada and Germany in advancing cleaner shipping routes and sustainable trade. By working together to accelerate the adoption of clean fuels and clean technologies, we are helping reduce emissions while strengthening the supply chains that connect Canada to global markets.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: Minister of Transport and Leader of the Government in the House of Commons formalizes a Green Shipping Corridor Memorandum of Understanding with Spain

quotes.quote_text: Canada is committed to maintaining a fair, transparent and predictable trading environment that supports Canadian workers and businesses while safeguarding our economic interests. These consultations will provide stakeholders with an important opportunity to share their perspectives and help ensure that the administration of tariff-rate quotas remains effective, responsive and aligned with Canada’s trade policy objectives.
quotes.speaker: Anita Anand
quotes.article_title: Canada launches public consultations on the administration of tariff-rate quotas for certain steel imports

quotes.quote_text: Canadian businesses and industry stakeholders play an essential role in helping us understand how trade measures operate on the ground. By participating in these consultations, they will provide valuable insights that will support ongoing efforts to administer tariff-rate quotas in a way that reflects market realities and supports a strong and competitive Canadian economy.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canada launches public consultations on the administration of tariff-rate quotas for certain steel imports

quotes.quote_text: Saskatchewan exports 70% of what it produces and is a global leader in agriculture, critical minerals, advanced manufacturing and innovation. From the development of world-class mining projects and cutting-edge defence technologies to the growing success of Indigenous entrepreneurs and agricultural exporters, Saskatchewan businesses are driving Canada’s economic growth. We are negotiating trade agreements faster than ever to diversify our trade and help Canadian businesses so they can compete and succeed around the world.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Minister Sidhu highlights Saskatchewan’s role in strengthening Canada’s trade, innovation and export success

quotes.quote_text: Northern Ontario communities are ready to lead, and they need the right tools to stay ahead as the economy rapidly shifts. This clean energy initiative is about unlocking that potential. It's about helping partner communities harness the power of the Montreal River to generate electricity so it can be sold to provincial power grid. When we invest in Northern Ontario, we’re investing in Canada’s future.
quotes.speaker_title: The Honourable Patty Hajdu, Minister, and Member of Parliament for Thunder Bay—Superior North
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment to help produce clean energy and fuel economic growth along the Highway 11 corridor

quotes.quote_text: “The Government of Canada is actively driving a historic transition to clean energy by working to double the national electricity supply by 2050, while targeting a fully net-zero grid. By investing in the Communities of the Montreal River Power Corp. we are fueling local growth and advancing our goal to improve energy affordability, strengthen economic resilience, and reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
quotes.speaker_title: Pauline Rochefort, Parliamentary Secretary to the Secretary, and Member of Parliament for Nipissing-Timiskaming
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment to help produce clean energy and fuel economic growth along the Highway 11 corridor

quotes.quote_text: We are thrilled that FedNor recognizes the economic and environmental benefits this project will deliver in the form of jobs, growth, and clean energy production. This strong show of support from the Government of Canada will ensure we are ready to bid on IESO renewable electricity contracts.
quotes.speaker_title: Harri Makivirta, Energy Manager, Communities of the Montreal River Power Corp
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment to help produce clean energy and fuel economic growth along the Highway 11 corridor

quotes.quote_text: AI adoption moves at the speed of trust. Canadians need to know when they are interacting with AI systems, when content has been generated or altered by AI, and what these systems can and cannot do. Through AI for All, we are building a Canadian approach that protects people, creates opportunity and strengthens our sovereign control over this defining technology. This consultation will help ensure Canadians have a voice in shaping practical and effective transparency measures.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada launches public consultation on AI transparency

quotes.quote_text: The future of defence will belong to those who can innovate and adapt the fastest. Uncrewed and autonomous systems are already transforming modern military operations, and Canada must be ready to develop, test and field these capabilities at speed. The Defence Drone Initiative will connect the operational needs of the Canadian Armed Forces and the Canadian Coast Guard with the ingenuity, talent and industrial capacity that exist across Canada—strengthening our security while creating new opportunities for Canadian innovators.
quotes.speaker: The Honourable
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada launches Defence Drone Initiative to strengthen Canada’s sovereign defence capabilities

quotes.quote_text: The Defence Drone Initiative will enable Canadian industry to develop sovereign capabilities that support military operations. This approach will help us operationalize the Defence Industrial Strategy and strengthen Canada’s defence industrial base. By engaging Canadian innovators, we are deepening our domestic defence supply chain and delivering critical capabilities to the Canadian Armed Forces and the Canadian Coast Guard.
quotes.speaker: The Honourable
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada launches Defence Drone Initiative to strengthen Canada’s sovereign defence capabilities

quotes.quote_text: The character of warfare is changing, and military advantage will depend on how quickly we can adapt. The Defence Drone Initiative will strengthen the Canadian Armed Forces by connecting operational requirements with Canadian innovation so we can field the capabilities our personnel need for future operations.
quotes.speaker: Vice-Admiral
quotes.speaker_title: Angus Topshee, Acting Chief of the Defence Staff
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada launches Defence Drone Initiative to strengthen Canada’s sovereign defence capabilities

quotes.quote_text: Building Canada's uncrewed systems ecosystem goes beyond acquiring new equipment. It strengthens national security, improves operational readiness, supports innovation, grows the defence industry, and creates jobs. The initiative demonstrates Canada's commitment to building security through Canadian expertise, with the Defence Investment Agency helping accelerate procurement through the Build-Partner-Buy approach.
quotes.speaker: Doug Guzman
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada launches Defence Drone Initiative to strengthen Canada’s sovereign defence capabilities

quotes.quote_text: Farmers across Manitoba work hard every day to manage risks and keep their operations strong in the face of unpredictable challenges. These changes to AgriStability will provide producers with timely and meaningful support when they need it most, helping them manage financial pressures and make decisions with greater confidence.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Governments of Canada and Manitoba provide flood recovery support for producers through AgriStability

quotes.quote_text: Flooding has created significant challenges for producers in impacted regions, and our government is taking action to ensure farmers have access to the support they need as they recover. By enhancing AgriStability supports, we are helping producers manage the impacts of flooding, maintain their operations and continue contributing to Manitoba’s strong agricultural sector.
quotes.speaker: Ron Kostyshyn
quotes.article_title: Governments of Canada and Manitoba provide flood recovery support for producers through AgriStability

quotes.quote_text: Investing in active transportation infrastructure is vital for the wellbeing and growth of our communities. This extension of the Trans Canada Trail is about completing a safer, more connected network that links Tecumseh with Windsor and Lakeshore and makes active transportation more convenient and accessible. That’s how we build healthier, better-connected communities, and build Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in active transportation in Tecumseh

quotes.quote_text: Tecumseh welcomes funding through the federal Active Transportation Fund and thank the Honourable Minister Gregor Robertson and Ministry of Housing, Infrastructure and Communities Canada for approving our application, submitted back in February 2025 . This investment furthers Tecumseh’s leadership in multi-modal transportation, completing the connection between our neighbouring communities and expanding safe, accessible, sustainable active transportation along our part of the Trans Canada Trail. Multi-use pathways transform our community enabling residents to choose a mode of transportation that reduces our carbon footprint and promotes healthy lifestyles.
quotes.speaker: Gary McNamara
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in active transportation in Tecumseh

quotes.quote_text: Trails don't just move people from one place to another; they connect communities. The Trans Canada Trail is a vital national infrastructure project that unites Canadians and reflects our shared identity. We welcome this investment from the Government of Canada and its recognition that trails and other active transportation infrastructure are essential to building strong, resilient and connected communities across Canada.
quotes.speaker: Mathieu Roy
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in active transportation in Tecumseh

quotes.quote_text: The Share the Road Cycling Coalition has long championed safe, connected infrastructure that gives people the opportunity to choose active travel options. The enhancements announced today in Tecumseh represent meaningful progress — making it safer and more accessible for residents and visitors to walk, cycle, and connect with neighbouring communities. Investments like these strengthen local economies, enhance affordability, support healthier lifestyles, and help build the kind of vibrant, people‑focused places Canadians want and deserve.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor McMahon
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in active transportation in Tecumseh

quotes.quote_text: An important cultural hub on the Burin Peninsula, St. Gabriel’s Hall has hosted community gatherings for over 100 years. Our government is proud to support these renovations, ensuring the building is accessible and welcoming for many more years to come.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Federal and provincial investment sets the stage for a more accessible community hall in Marystown, NL

quotes.quote_text: Community halls like St. Gabriel’s are the heart of rural Newfoundland and Labrador, bringing people together for events, celebrations, and everyday connection. This investment will help strengthen the local community and improve quality of life, by ensuring that residents have an accessible and welcoming place to gather.
quotes.speaker: Lin Paddock
quotes.article_title: Federal and provincial investment sets the stage for a more accessible community hall in Marystown, NL

quotes.quote_text: This investment allows us to modernize St. Gabriel’s Hall in ways that make the building more accessible, more energy‑efficient, and better equipped to serve our community. These upgrades will ensure the Hall remains a welcoming space for gatherings, performances, and events for many years to come. We’re grateful for the support of both governments as we take this important step in strengthening a facility that means so much to the Burin Peninsula.
quotes.speaker: John Baker
quotes.article_title: Federal and provincial investment sets the stage for a more accessible community hall in Marystown, NL

quotes.quote_text: The federal government is proud to invest in environmentally sustainable infrastructure projects like this one. Now that the solar panel installation is complete, ten Mi’kmaw communities in Nova Scotia have more autonomy over their energy production and environmental impact.
quotes.speaker: Jaime Battiste
quotes.article_title: Federal government and ten First Nation communities invest in renewable energy in Nova Scotia

quotes.quote_text: By making use of our strong solar energy potential, Mi’kmaw communities are lowering their energy costs and creating local jobs and economic opportunities that can last generations. This is also a great example of how solar power is becoming a larger part of our overall energy mix and providing affordable, cleaner, and reliable electricity.
quotes.speaker: Marco MacLeod
quotes.article_title: Federal government and ten First Nation communities invest in renewable energy in Nova Scotia

quotes.quote_text: High-speed Internet is no longer just a luxury—it’s essential infrastructure, no matter where you live in Canada. It’s how people access health care virtually, start a business or just stay in touch with their loved ones. That’s why we made a historic commitment to provide 100% of Canadian households with access to high-speed Internet by 2030. The projects announced today are a major milestone for connectivity in Saskatchewan, providing reliable and affordable high-speed Internet to more than 30,000 underserved homes in over 500 rural and remote communities across the province.
quotes.speaker: Buckley Belanger
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger announces expansion of high-speed Internet access in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: In many rural and remote areas, connectivity projects like these face a number of financial and structural barriers. Federal tools like the Canada Infrastructure Bank help bridge that gap, ensuring critical infrastructure is built where it otherwise would not be. By supporting initiatives like this, we are advancing economic growth today and helping close the connectivity gap for underserved communities well into the future.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger announces expansion of high-speed Internet access in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Access to dependable high-speed Internet should not be determined by where people live. Thanks to support from the Government of Canada through the Universal Broadband Fund, RFNOW is delivering the infrastructure needed to connect underserved rural and First Nations communities across Saskatchewan. Together, we are building a stronger digital future that will enhance economic development, support essential services and improve quality of life for thousands of Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Chris Kennedy
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger announces expansion of high-speed Internet access in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Every community deserves the opportunity that comes with access to reliable high-speed Internet—and that’s exactly what this investment delivers. In partnership with the Government of Canada’s Universal Broadband Fund, Xplore is bringing high-speed Internet connectivity to nearly 20,000 homes and businesses in Saskatchewan. Better connectivity means more than faster downloads—it means students can learn without interruption, families can access health care from home, and local businesses can compete on a level playing field.
quotes.speaker: Brent Johnston
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger announces expansion of high-speed Internet access in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Since our establishment in 2007, we have been committed to providing dependable Internet service and strengthening connections in the communities we serve. With support from the Government of Canada’s Universal Broadband Fund, we’re excited to expand our network and introduce new 6 GHz fixed wireless technology capable of delivering speeds of up to 1 Gbps. This project will help more residents of rural and remote communities access the reliable high-speed connectivity they need for work, education, health care, business and everyday life.
quotes.speaker: Allen Stafford
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger announces expansion of high-speed Internet access in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Beaver River Broadband has secured federal Universal Broadband Fund support to deliver fibre-to-the-home infrastructure directly to Peepeekisis Cree Nation. This critical investment guarantees gigabit-capable Internet access that will transform local opportunities in digital education, remote health care and community-led economic development. Crucially, the project underscores the importance of partnering with smaller, regional Internet providers that bring deep community roots, agile deployment and a dedicated focus on serving areas that larger national carriers often overlook. As an Indigenous-led regional provider working closely with First Nations, Beaver River Broadband understands the unique needs of the area and delivers tailored, reliable customer support on the ground. Empowering local providers through initiatives like the Universal Broadband Fund ensures that underserved First Nations are not just connected but also supported by partners invested in their long-term digital sovereignty.
quotes.speaker: John DeGraauw
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger announces expansion of high-speed Internet access in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: MCSnet’s fibre-to-the-tower expansion in Saskatchewan will deliver fast, highly reliable Internet access to underserved homes in rural Saskatchewan, courtesy of a dedicated, community-invested provider. As a family-owned company based in the Prairies, we have been serving rural communities with our innovative technology and exceptional customer service for over 30 years.
quotes.speaker: Jerome VanBrabant
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Belanger announces expansion of high-speed Internet access in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: The signing of the Canada–Ecuador Free Trade Agreement marks an important chapter in our partnership. This FTA will significantly increase Canadian exports to Ecuador, creating new opportunities for our businesses and workers. By advancing agreements with partners like Ecuador, we are diversifying our trading relationships while building a stronger and more resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ecuador sign a free trade agreement

quotes.quote_text: The successful conclusion of Canada-UAE CEPA negotiations reflects our shared economic ambition and will lead to new opportunities for Canadian and UAE businesses and workers. This agreement will help Canadian companies expand internationally and create good-paying jobs while promoting Canada as a reliable destination for trade and investment.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canada and United Arab Emirates conclude Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement negotiations

quotes.quote_text: The conclusion of CEPA negotiations between the UAE and Canada marks a defining chapter in a relationship that has grown significantly in depth and ambition. Bilateral non-oil trade has grown significantly in recent years, and this agreement will accelerate that trajectory by opening markets, reducing barriers, and creating a framework for our private sectors to collaborate at scale. Canada is a trusted partner of the UAE, and this CEPA reflects the confidence we have in one another.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Thani bin Ahmed Al Zeyoudi
quotes.article_title: Canada and United Arab Emirates conclude Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement negotiations

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is proud to invest in this project, which reflects the strength and lasting legacy of Acadian communities. By celebrating our shared Acadian heritage and creating an accessible space where our history and traditions can be passed on to future generations, this site will foster pride in our Acadian roots, strengthen community connections, and enrich the region’s cultural and tourism offerings.
quotes.speaker: Dominic LeBlanc
quotes.speaker_title: President, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy and Member of Parliament for Beauséjour
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in an Acadian cultural and historical space

quotes.quote_text: Acadian culture is more than history in New Brunswick – it’s a huge part of what makes New Brunswick so unique and so strong. The Place du Drapeau acadien is a welcome addition to the community of Saint-Louis-de-Kent, as it not only honours our Acadian roots, but helps preserve them for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Pat Finnigan
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Aquaculture and Fisheries, on behalf of Gilles LePage, Minister responsible for the Regional Development Corporation
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in an Acadian cultural and historical space

quotes.quote_text: On behalf of the Town of Beaurivage, I would like to thank the governments of Canada and New Brunswick for their valuable support, as well as all the residents, donors, partners and volunteers who believed in this project. Thanks to their commitment, Place du Drapeau acadien will become a gathering place that will showcase our history, our culture and our Acadian pride for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Danielle Dugas
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in an Acadian cultural and historical space

quotes.quote_text: A stronger Canadian economy starts with businesses that are equipped to grow, innovate, and compete. By supporting facility expansions, advanced manufacturing capabilities, and productivity-enhancing technologies, these investments will help Atlantic Canadian companies strengthen their competitiveness and reach new customers.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada boosts manufacturing growth in Dartmouth

quotes.quote_text: Dartmouth is home to innovative businesses that create good jobs and drive economic growth. These investments will help Site 20/20 expand its manufacturing capacity and enable Atlantica Mechanical Contractors to modernize its production floor, strengthening competitiveness, reducing waste and building sustainability for the future.
quotes.speaker: Braedon Clark
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada boosts manufacturing growth in Dartmouth

quotes.quote_text: ACOA’s investment is a powerful vote of confidence in Site 20/20’s technology, our people, and our vision for the future of traffic control. This support will help us expand our manufacturing capacity, accelerate innovation, and create new skilled employment opportunities here in Nova Scotia. Most importantly, it strengthens our ability to deliver safer, smarter, and more efficient traffic control solutions to communities across Canada and beyond.
quotes.speaker: Mitch Hollohan
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada boosts manufacturing growth in Dartmouth

quotes.quote_text: This investment allows us to take an important step forward in modernizing our fabrication operations. The new equipment and facility upgrades will improve efficiency, increase capacity, and strengthen our ability to support both our own projects and valued industry partners throughout the region. We are grateful for the support and excited about the opportunities this creates for continued growth and innovation.
quotes.speaker: Gabriel Iturriaga
quotes.speaker_title: P.Eng. MBA, Vice President, Atlantica & Cahill Maritimes
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada boosts manufacturing growth in Dartmouth

quotes.quote_text: Canada and Peru have built a strong partnership based on trade, investment and people-to-people ties. We are working together to create new opportunities for Canadians and Peruvians, strengthening resilient supply chains and supporting sustainable economic growth. I look forward to representing Canada at this important moment in Peru’s history and advancing our shared priorities for the benefit of the two countries.
quotes.speaker: Robert Oliphant
quotes.article_title: Parliamentary Secretary Oliphant represents Canada at Peru’s presidential inauguration

quotes.quote_text: Our government continues to take action to support Canadian companies facing challenging global market conditions, including those in the forest sector. This support to Millar Western Forest Products will allow the company to navigate these challenging times for its industry, support its workers and help position the company for long-term success. This is about protecting jobs, supporting communities and protecting the competitiveness of a key Canadian industry.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces loan support to Millar Western Forest Products Ltd.

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s forests are the foundation for good jobs, affordable housing, and sustainable economic growth from coast to coast to coast. At this moment of global instability, we are supporting and stabilizing the industry today, while positioning it to thrive for tomorrow. Our government is proud to support Millar Western Forest Products, who create good Canadian jobs and are leading in world-class Canadian forest products.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces loan support to Millar Western Forest Products Ltd.

quotes.quote_text: This type of investment is key to tackling the root causes of crime, by giving vulnerable young people real opportunities and a better chance for long-term success. The funding we are announcing today will support the New Westminster community in its fight to end gun and gang violence and build a safer community for everyone.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in gun violence prevention in New Westminster, British Columbia

quotes.quote_text: Creating a safer community starts long before a crime is committed. This investment will help New Westminster strengthen local prevention and intervention programs that support young people, build resilience, and create pathways to opportunity. We are grateful to the Government of Canada for recognizing the importance of community-based solutions that address the root causes of gun and gang violence and help keep the neighbourhoods safe for everyone.
quotes.speaker: Patrick Johnstone
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in gun violence prevention in New Westminster, British Columbia

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s rural communities do so much for this country—it’s time that federal policies and programs reflect and respond to their unique realities. That’s why we launched a consultation and held roundtables across the country to hear directly from voices on the ground in rural, remote, northern and Indigenous communities about the challenges they face and the opportunities ahead. I want to thank everyone who took the time to share their perspectives and to assure them that the government is listening closely. We are committed to crafting a new Rural Development Action Plan that truly delivers on our government’s plan for rural Canada.
quotes.speaker: Buckley Belanger
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada highlights key themes from Rural Development Action Plan consultation

quotes.quote_text: We’ve been listening to Canadian athletes, and they’ve been clear. They need more support to compete at the highest levels and represent Canada on the world stage. In a country as great as Canada, with record-breaking athletes who proudly wear the maple leaf, we need to make sure they have more support to focus on their performance and achieve their goals. This investment will help more athletes train, compete and succeed, while strengthening our sport system for the future.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces strengthened support for Canadian athletes

quotes.quote_text: Today’s investments are of paramount importance to building a stronger Canada. We are working together with sporting organizations and the provincial government to invest in national training centres, including the Olympic Oval, that will provide both athletes and broader communities with world-class facilities. Investments such as these promote healthy, active lifestyles, foster our talent, and position Canada as a top sporting destination.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investments in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: Sport has the power to shape lives and connect people in ways that very few things can. These legendary facilities, the Olympic Oval, the WinSport halfpipe in Calgary, and the Nakiska National Ski Cross Training Centre, are places where we can create more opportunities for Canadians to play, train, and proudly wear the maple leaf on the world stage. By investing in these projects, the Government of Canada is strengthening our ability to host major sporting events, from the 1988 Calgary Olympic Winter Games to the FIFA World Cup 2026. We’re continuing to prove that Canada is the best sport-hosting nation in the world, while helping more athletes focus on their performance and pursuit of excellence. We’re building Canada Strong, from playground to podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investments in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: Calgary is well-renowned for its athletic facilities, such as the Olympic Oval and WinSport, as well as for the high-achieving athletes that those facilities have nurtured. Investing in training centres in Alberta, and across the country, helps ensure that they meet competitive standards while enhancing access to recreational opportunities for local residents.
quotes.speaker: Corey Hogan
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investments in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: Our government is proud to provide $26 million in matching funding to help preserve one of Canada's most iconic sport facilities. Together, we are ensuring the Olympic Oval continues to provide world-class training opportunities for high-performance athletes. This investment reflects our shared commitment to supporting excellence in sport and strengthening this legacy for generations to come
quotes.speaker: Andrew Boitchenko
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investments in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: The University of Calgary thanks the Government of Canada and the Government of Alberta for these critical and timely investments to ensure the Olympic Oval remains one of the nation’s premier athletic facilities and a vibrant community hub that bolsters Calgary’s reputation as a world-class sporting city. Complementing the Oval’s elite training and event-hosting capacity is decades of globally recognized research undertaken at the University of Calgary, in human physiology, injury prevention and recovery, and equipment design. This funding from the federal and provincial governments supports more than renewed infrastructure. It supports athletic excellence, scientific innovation, and community connection.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Ed McCauley
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investments in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: This investment is about much more than infrastructure—it's about creating opportunities for Canadian snowboarders to develop, train and succeed here at home. By strengthening our National Training Centre Network, we're investing in the next generation of athletes, supporting the communities that help grow our sport, and building a lasting legacy that will benefit Canadian snowboarding for years to come. We're grateful to the Government of Canada and all of our partners for believing in the future of our sport and helping create an environment where more athletes can chase their dreams right here in Canada.
quotes.speaker: Dustin Heise
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investments in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: Canada has a proud and decorated history in ski racing, with Olympic, Paralympic and World Championship success that has inspired generations of Canadians. Sustaining and building on that success requires continued investment in world-class training environments where athletes can develop to reach their full potential. Alpine Canada welcomes the Government of Canada's support through the Build Communities Strong Fund. This investment in three training centres, the Dave Murray National Training Centre in Whistler, the Panorama Mountain National Alpine Training Centre, and the Nakiska National Ski Cross Training Centre, will strengthen the development pathway, creating lasting benefits for athletes and coaches at every level—from local clubs to the national team—and helping position Canada as a world-leading ski racing nation.
quotes.speaker: Jeff Thompson
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investments in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s economy is powered by the strength and ingenuity of its businesses and workers. By investing at home, we’re helping companies access the resources they need to adapt, grow, and succeed. Today’s investment will provide three Burlington businesses with support to expand their operations, safeguard quality Canadian jobs, and contribute to building a stronger, more resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports growth and competitiveness of three Burlington businesses

quotes.quote_text: The strength of Burlington’s economy comes from the hardworking businesses and workers who call this community home. By supporting local companies, like PV labs, Modern Elevator Innovations and Spatial Data Analytics as they grow and innovate, we are helping create quality jobs, attract new opportunities, and build a stronger future for Burlington.
quotes.speaker: The Honorable Karina Gould
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports growth and competitiveness of three Burlington businesses

quotes.speaker: Canada's long-term security and economic prosperity depend on a strong domestic defence industrial base. This investment enables PV Labs to expand Canadian manufacturing capacity
quotes.speaker_title: and strengthen sovereign Canadian capability. It also positions Canadian innovation to compete globally, - Mark Chamberlain, President and Founder, PV Labs
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports growth and competitiveness of three Burlington businesses

quotes.quote_text: We’re really appreciative of the contribution we received from FedDev Ontario. This is going to help us invest in resources that will enhance our manufacturing capabilities and help create jobs for the region.
quotes.speaker: David Lewis
quotes.speaker_title: Senior Vice President Manufacturing, MODERN Elevator Innovations
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports growth and competitiveness of three Burlington businesses

quotes.quote_text: Spatial Data Analytics Inc. is pleased to receive support from FedDev Ontario, through the Regional Artificial Intelligence Initiative. This funding will accelerate the development of our solution, secure additional talent and enable us to expand into new markets.
quotes.speaker: Douglas Culbert
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports growth and competitiveness of three Burlington businesses

quotes.quote_text: Every Canadian deserves a safe, affordable place to call home. This partnership with the Ismaili Council for Canada demonstrates how we can work together to build more homes, faster, while creating comprehensive communities where people of all ages can thrive. By supporting innovative, community-based housing models like Generations, we are helping increase the supply of affordable rental housing and making life more affordable for families across Canada.
quotes.speaker: Anita Anand
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and Ismaili Council for Canada sign memorandum to advance affordable housing development across Canada

quotes.quote_text: We need to build more homes, faster, and we need strong partners to help us get there. This memorandum with the Ismaili Council for Canada brings together shared expertise, community leadership, and a commitment to affordability. By working together, we're creating new opportunities to deliver homes that meet the needs of working families, seniors, newcomers, and vulnerable Canadians while supporting the development of complete communities.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and Ismaili Council for Canada sign memorandum to advance affordable housing development across Canada

quotes.quote_text: The housing challenges facing Canadians require new approaches and partnerships that can accelerate housing delivery while creating lasting community benefits. The Generations model demonstrates how affordable housing can be community-based, and integrated with essential supports and services. This memorandum establishes a strong foundation for collaboration that can help deliver more homes and create vibrant, inclusive communities for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Ana Bailão
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and Ismaili Council for Canada sign memorandum to advance affordable housing development across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Under the leadership of His Highness the Aga Khan, the Ismaili community has a long tradition of working in partnership to strengthen the communities we call home. This Memorandum of Understanding with Build Canada Homes reflects a shared commitment to expanding affordable housing opportunities while building inclusive communities that support people at every stage of life. Through the Generations model, we look forward to advancing innovative, community-led housing solutions that will benefit Canadians for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Ameerally Kassim-Lakha
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and Ismaili Council for Canada sign memorandum to advance affordable housing development across Canada

quotes.quote_text: “2026 is Canada’s Year of Sport, and we’re welcoming the world once again! The 2026 IWBF Wheelchair Basketball World Championships in Ottawa will bring together the best athletes from across the globe, while attracting international fans and reinforcing that Canada is the best sport-hosting nation in the world. We’ll continue building on this momentum and can’t wait to cheer for Team Canada on home soil!
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports 2026 IWBF Wheelchair Basketball World Championships, building on Canada's sport hosting legacy

quotes.quote_text: Ottawa Centre is proud to host the 2026 IWBF Wheelchair Basketball World Championships, a celebration of athletic excellence and performance. This event will bring some of the world's best athletes to our riding while highlighting Ottawa as a world-class host city. I look forward to welcoming competitors and fans, and seeing our community come together to cheer on Team Canada. Go Canada Go!
quotes.speaker: Yasir Naqvi
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports 2026 IWBF Wheelchair Basketball World Championships, building on Canada's sport hosting legacy

quotes.quote_text: We are sincerely grateful to the Government of Canada for its investment in the 2026 IWBF Wheelchair Basketball World Championships. As the world's best wheelchair basketball athletes compete on the global stage, Canadians will witness their exceptional skill, speed and athleticism. This championship provides a unique opportunity to showcase Canada’s leadership in inclusive and accessible sport, while demonstrating the power of sport to inspire, unite communities and transform perceptions.
quotes.speaker: Wendy Gittens
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports 2026 IWBF Wheelchair Basketball World Championships, building on Canada's sport hosting legacy

quotes.quote_text: Building more homes requires the infrastructure to support them. Through these housing and infrastructure agreements with the Northwest Territories, we are increasing housing supply and strengthening important infrastructure to help these northern communities grow stronger and thrive for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Canada and Northwest Territories partner to build more homes and essential infrastructure

quotes.quote_text: Building a stronger, more resilient country begins with investing in communities. Through these agreements with the Northwest Territories, we’re taking action to build more homes, faster, and deliver the modern, reliable infrastructure Northerners need to thrive and prosper. Together, we’re supporting community growth, health, and prosperity, and creating lasting opportunities throughout the NWT.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Alty
quotes.article_title: Canada and Northwest Territories partner to build more homes and essential infrastructure

quotes.quote_text: Through the Build Communities Strong Fund, we are strengthening the health infrastructure that residents of the Northwest Territories rely on. These investments will improve access to safe, reliable and high-quality health care, especially in northern and remote communities so people can get the care they need, closer to home.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.article_title: Canada and Northwest Territories partner to build more homes and essential infrastructure

quotes.quote_text: The Government of the Northwest Territories welcomes this significant investment in housing and in the infrastructure that will support it. Safe, affordable housing is the foundation of healthy communities. Nowhere is that more important than here in the North, where the need is significant and the cost of building is among the highest in the country. This investment will help us build more homes for northerners through the delivery of more social, affordable and supportive housing, while creating new opportunities for Northerners, and strengthening communities across the territory. I want to thank the Government of Canada for recognizing the North's unique realities and for making this meaningful investment in one of our government's highest priorities.
quotes.speaker: Lucy Kuptana
quotes.speaker_title: Minister Responsible for Housing Northwest Territories
quotes.article_title: Canada and Northwest Territories partner to build more homes and essential infrastructure

quotes.quote_text: In the North, our communities succeed when we take care of each other and the places we call home. Truly reliable infrastructure means ensuring clean, dependable water in our taps, safe wastewater systems that protect our land, and warm and welcoming community spaces where we can gather. By investing directly in these essentials, alongside strong transportation links to keep us connected, we are laying the groundwork for safe new housing and a secure, healthy future for all NWT residents and communities. This partnership with the Government of Canada recognizes the unique realities of building in the North and will help communities across the Northwest Territories grow stronger, healthier and more resilient for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Vince McKay
quotes.article_title: Canada and Northwest Territories partner to build more homes and essential infrastructure

quotes.quote_text: Healthy communities depend on strong, reliable health infrastructure. This investment will help strengthen and improve the facilities and systems that support quality health care services across the Northwest Territories. As our communities grow, modern health infrastructure is essential to ensuring Northerners can access safe, high-quality care close to home. We welcome this partnership with the Government of Canada, which recognizes the importance of investing in infrastructure that supports healthy people and communities.
quotes.speaker: Lesa Semmler
quotes.article_title: Canada and Northwest Territories partner to build more homes and essential infrastructure

quotes.quote_text: Capital investment and the jobs it creates are an important part of healthy, vibrant communities. Investments like this create more skilled jobs, strengthen pathways to employment and have multiplier effects on investment in the Northwest Territories. Through our partnership with the Government of Canada, we are creating new opportunities for Northerners and building the infrastructure we need for a prosperous future.
quotes.speaker: Caitlin Cleveland
quotes.article_title: Canada and Northwest Territories partner to build more homes and essential infrastructure

quotes.quote_text: Our partnership with Housing Northwest Territories is about taking action to deliver tangible results. By working alongside our partners, Build Canada Homes is making a lasting impact by supporting the delivery of hundreds of homes that range from affordable and social housing to transitional and supportive homes, while creating a strong foundation for communities across the Northwest Territories.
quotes.speaker: Ana Bailão
quotes.article_title: Canada and Northwest Territories partner to build more homes and essential infrastructure

quotes.quote_text: Deceiving consumers has significant impacts, with Canadians continuing to lose money to scams and other deceptive practices. The Competition Bureau is taking action to stop those who use misleading tactics to take Canadians’ hard-earned money.
quotes.speaker: Jeanne Pratt
quotes.article_title: Multiple charges laid in deceptive online passport service scam

quotes.quote_text: The inshore commercial fishing is at the heart of Eastern Canada. It’s part of who we are, and it supports families and communities right across the region. That’s why the Inshore Regulations are critical to keeping the benefits of fishing in the hands of independent harvesters and, in turn, their communities. The measures I’m announcing today will strengthen these regulations, and I want to hear directly from harvesters about how we can keep supporting them how they need.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Strengthening protections for Canadian independent harvesters and coastal communities

quotes.quote_text: The growing demand for Canadian products both at home and abroad stands as a testament to the hard work and dedication of our farmers and food producers. Our government is committed to supporting all producers and exporters as they pursue new markets while continuing to succeed at home.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Strengthening access to new markets: Export opportunities for Canadian Blueberries to the Philippines

quotes.quote_text: New market access to the Philippines is a significant win for British Columbia's blueberry growers. It opens the door to one of Asia's fastest-growing consumer markets and reflects the strength of Canada's food safety and plant health systems. On behalf of our growers, we thank the CFIA for the work behind this achievement, and we look forward to bringing the quality and freshness of BC blueberries to consumers in the Philippines.
quotes.speaker: Sudeshna Nambiar
quotes.article_title: Strengthening access to new markets: Export opportunities for Canadian Blueberries to the Philippines

quotes.quote_text: Across Atlantic Canada, we’re seeing real momentum in sectors like aerospace, marine, transportation and advanced manufacturing. With federal support for new automated equipment, Velocity Machining & Welding will be able to produce more, deliver faster for customers and support the supply chains that keep major projects moving across our region.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Federal investment helps Dartmouth manufacturer produce critical parts faster

quotes.quote_text: Burnside is home to hundreds of businesses that help keep our economy moving, and Velocity Machining & Welding is one of them. This investment will help the company take on more work, deliver orders faster and continue growing here in Dartmouth, while strengthening local manufacturing.
quotes.speaker: Braedon Clark
quotes.article_title: Federal investment helps Dartmouth manufacturer produce critical parts faster

quotes.quote_text: Sport is the ultimate nation builder. This summer, from coast to coast to coast, the beautiful game brought Canadians together and inspired the next generation of athletes. We’re building on that momentum. From neighbourhood matches to dreams of representing Canada on the world stage, this community soccer pitch in Calgary will give local kids the opportunity to get outside, participate in sport and build a lifelong connection to the game, from the playground to the podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports soccer in Calgary and across the country

quotes.quote_text: As Jumpstart continues to build new community soccer pitches across the country, we’re focused on creating more safe, welcoming places where kids can play, build confidence and feel connected to their community. We’re grateful to Sport Canada and the City of Calgary for their shared commitment to expanding access to sport and play, and we’re excited to work with the community in the months ahead to help bring this vision to life in Calgary.
quotes.speaker: Marco Di Buono
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports soccer in Calgary and across the country

quotes.quote_text: Calgary continues to see strong demand for quality sport and recreation infrastructure. Through GamePLAN, the City’s long-term vision for public recreation, we are working to make recreation more accessible and inclusive for all Calgarians. This partnership will help expand access to sport, support active lifestyles and create more opportunities for children and youth to play, learn and connect in their community,
quotes.speaker: DJ Kelly
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports soccer in Calgary and across the country

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s future prosperity depends on our ability to produce more of what we need here at home. Through the National Food Security Strategy, we are strengthening Canada’s food system, improving our resilience across our supply chains and helping ensure Canadians have reliable access to affordable and nutritious food. Our investment in Natural Products Canada will help turn Canadian innovation into Canadian solutions by accelerating the commercialization of homegrown agri-food and bio-based technologies, creating well-paying jobs and further strengthening Canada’s food security.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces $50 million federal investment in Natural Products Canada to strengthen Canada’s agri-food sector

quotes.quote_text: Farmers and agri-food businesses are key to a stronger Canadian economy and a more secure food supply. Our government is committed to investing in innovation across the agriculture and agri-food sector, to meet the needs of producers and processors and keep healthy and affordable food within reach for all Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces $50 million federal investment in Natural Products Canada to strengthen Canada’s agri-food sector

quotes.quote_text: Prince Edward Island has long been a leader in innovation, agriculture and food production, and Natural Products Canada is a great example of that leadership in action. This investment will help Canadian innovators bring new agri-food and bio-based technologies to market, create good jobs, strengthen our food supply chains and support economic growth here at home. I am proud that Charlottetown is home to an organization that is helping build a more resilient, competitive and food-secure Canada for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Sean Casey
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces $50 million federal investment in Natural Products Canada to strengthen Canada’s agri-food sector

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s economic security depends on building a strong, domestic base of natural and bio-based innovators, and that is exactly what NPC exists to do. This $50 million investment provides the continued opportunity to evaluate, support and provide capital to those companies, while providing the resources necessary to strengthen Canada’s bioeconomy and food security initiatives, building on a decade of impact that includes investment in over 100 companies, generating $622 million in follow-on capital, and contributing $900 million to Canada’s GDP.
quotes.speaker: Shelley King
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces $50 million federal investment in Natural Products Canada to strengthen Canada’s agri-food sector

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is providing targeted support to ensure that Canadian businesses have the support they need to navigate tariff-related challenges and remain competitive. Today’s investments in these 13 Niagara Region businesses will help strengthen their operations, expand into new markets, and build resilience against external pressures. By backing local businesses, we are protecting jobs, reinforcing regional supply chains, and supporting long-term economic growth to keep Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investments to help Niagara Region businesses adapt and drive innovation

quotes.quote_text: These investments will make a real difference for businesses here in the Niagara Region. Together we are helping companies adapt to new challenges while strengthening the regional economy and supporting high-quality jobs right here at home.
quotes.speaker: Chris Bittle
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investments to help Niagara Region businesses adapt and drive innovation

quotes.quote_text: High Strength Plates & Profiles Inc. is grateful for the funding support from FedDev Ontario through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative. It has helped us enhance our cutting capabilities and pursue new business opportunities as we adapt to changing trade policies that are affecting our customers and broader supply chains.
