quotes.speaker: Jason Brock
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investments to help Niagara Region businesses adapt and drive innovation

quotes.quote_text: The softwood lumber industry is a key pillar of Canada's highly integrated forest sector, and a source of good-paying jobs in communities across the country. However, ongoing U.S. tariffs continue to place significant pressure on Canadian producers, reducing exports and profit margins. This support will provide Arbec with the support they need to maintain operations, protect jobs, and adapt their business to remain competitive in a changing global market.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada acts to protect Canadian softwood lumber jobs, announces support to lumber company

quotes.quote_text: Canada's forests are the foundation for good jobs, affordable housing, and sustainable economic growth from coast to coast to coast. At this moment of global instability, we are supporting and stabilizing the industry today, while positioning it to thrive for tomorrow. Our government is proud to support Arbec, who create good Canadian jobs and are leading in world-class Canadian forest products.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada acts to protect Canadian softwood lumber jobs, announces support to lumber company

quotes.quote_text: Our official languages are a vital part of our national identity and a great source of pride for Canadians. Our government is investing in organizations whose efforts ensure the strength and vitality of our official languages by providing access to essential services, promoting our arts and culture, growing our economy, and helping showcase the best of Canada to the world.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports the strength and promotion of French in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: The French language has deep roots in Saskatchewan, and the Fransaskois community has made an incredible contribution to the story of our province. That’s why our government is proud to invest in the community organizations doing the important work of keeping French language and culture vibrant in cities and rural communities across Saskatchewan. We believe in their future, and we’ll always stand with them.
quotes.speaker: Buckley Belanger
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports the strength and promotion of French in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Saskatchewan’s Francophone community is an important part of the province’s identity and future. Across the province, Francophone organizations are bringing people together, welcoming newcomers, supporting young people and creating opportunities for communities to thrive in French. Our government is proud to support their work because investing in these organizations means investing in vibrant communities, cultural vitality and a stronger Saskatchewan for everyone.
quotes.speaker: Ginette Lavack
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports the strength and promotion of French in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: We’re grateful for the Government of Canada’s continued support of French-language minority communities. This funding is essential to our organization, allowing us to continue our mission serving families, promoting the French language, and making a meaningful contribution to the vitality and growth of Francophone culture in Saskatchewan.
quotes.speaker: Bernard Wenga Ntcheping
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports the strength and promotion of French in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Canadians expect passport services that work for their lives. Expanding online renewal gives eligible Canadians a simpler, more convenient way to renew their passports, without unnecessary barriers or delays. This is part of the Government of Canada’s ongoing work to modernize passport services and deliver public services that are responsive to the needs of Canadians today.
quotes.speaker: Lena Metlege Diab
quotes.article_title: Canada expands online passport renewal to all eligible adults

quotes.quote_text: Accessible service means giving Canadians options, starting with more ways to renew a passport. We are removing the barriers between Canadians and the services they rely on by modernizing how we deliver them and shaping them around how people live. When Canadians can access services without added stress or lost time, they can focus on what matters, their families, their jobs, and their futures.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Canada expands online passport renewal to all eligible adults

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is working to make services more efficient and better suited to the needs of Canadians. The online passport renewal service is a great example of modernizing our service delivery landscape and improving the passport program. In the long term, this online service will reduce wait times at our points of service and benefit Canadians who can spend more time where it matters the most to them.
quotes.speaker: Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Jobs and Families
quotes.article_title: Canada expands online passport renewal to all eligible adults

quotes.quote_text: As Canada rebuilds, rearms and reinvests in our national defence, we are also investing in the industries, workers and innovators who make that possible. Canada's Defence Industrial Strategy is helping Canadian companies access the capital and partnerships they need to grow, compete globally and deliver the capabilities our Armed Forces require. A stronger defence industrial base means a stronger Canada—more secure, more resilient and better positioned to succeed in an increasingly uncertain world.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Minister McGuinty brings together industry and investment leaders to accelerate Canada’s Defence Industrial Strategy

quotes.quote_text: A strong defence industry helps keep Canadians safe while creating high-quality jobs and economic opportunities. Through engagement with pension funds and defence industry leaders, we are helping mobilize the investment needed to grow Canada’s defence industrial base and support long-term prosperity.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.article_title: Minister McGuinty brings together industry and investment leaders to accelerate Canada’s Defence Industrial Strategy

quotes.quote_text: By bringing together institutional investors, industry leaders, and federal partners to advance Canada’s Defence Industrial Strategy, we are helping Canadian firms access the capital, expertise and markets they need to grow. This collaboration strengthens our economic resilience, supports high-quality jobs, and positions Canadian businesses to compete and succeed globally.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Minister McGuinty brings together industry and investment leaders to accelerate Canada’s Defence Industrial Strategy

quotes.quote_text: As Canada's export credit agency, EDC provides the financing, risk-sharing solutions and international market expertise that help Canadian defence and security companies diversify their exports and succeed in partner markets. Through collaboration with Canada’s venture capital community, pension funds and our government partners, we can leverage complementary strengths to help Canadian companies access the capital they need to scale, innovate and seize opportunities.
quotes.speaker: Alison Nankivell
quotes.article_title: Minister McGuinty brings together industry and investment leaders to accelerate Canada’s Defence Industrial Strategy

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s defence sector is entering a new strategic era, and SMEs are at the heart of this transformation. BDC put its ear to the ground, listened to businesses, investors, financial partners, and collaborated closely with key associations to inform how we built and refined our Defence Platform. This work continues today, because we know that entrepreneurs aligned to the sector still face unique challenges in accessing capital and navigating complex supply chains.
quotes.speaker: Isabelle Hudon
quotes.article_title: Minister McGuinty brings together industry and investment leaders to accelerate Canada’s Defence Industrial Strategy

quotes.quote_text: This agreement between Ksi Lisims LNG and Uniper represents more than an energy partnership. It is a powerful example of how, by working with allies like Germany, Canada can strengthen its economy and sovereignty and support global energy security. Amidst energy market disruptions, international demand for reliable energy only continues to grow, and projects like this — developed in partnership with Indigenous Peoples and providing best-in-class low-carbon energy — demonstrate how Canada is not only a competitive but also a leading energy superpower.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Canada advances global energy exports by signing second European LNG deal

quotes.quote_text: Today marks another important step in Canada’s trade diversification and in building a stronger, more independent and resilient economy. By expanding international trade and supplying low-carbon LNG to trusted allies like Germany, Ksi Lisims LNG will create jobs, attract investment, contribute to Canada’s long-term prosperity and reinforce Canada’s position as a global energy superpower.
quotes.speaker: Dominic LeBlanc
quotes.speaker_title: President, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy
quotes.article_title: Canada advances global energy exports by signing second European LNG deal

quotes.quote_text: By working alongside the Nisga’a Nation to advance major projects like Ksi Lisims, we are creating opportunities for investment, jobs and long-term prosperity in communities across B.C. This agreement not only strengthens and diversifies our trade relationships but also reinforces B.C.’s position as a reliable, clean energy partner.
quotes.speaker: Adrian Dix
quotes.article_title: Canada advances global energy exports by signing second European LNG deal

quotes.quote_text: Today marks another important milestone for British Columbia and Canada as we continue to strengthen our economy and diversify trade by expanding access to global markets. As a leader in Canada’s export growth, B.C. is helping deliver low-carbon energy to the world while creating well-paying jobs and opportunities here at home. Developed in partnership with Indigenous communities, Ksi Lisims LNG demonstrates how sustainable resource development can advance reconciliation and deliver mutual prosperity. This project will help catalyze growth across the province and reinforce Canada’s role as a trusted energy partner for allies around the world.
quotes.speaker: Jill McKnight
quotes.article_title: Canada advances global energy exports by signing second European LNG deal

quotes.quote_text: Today’s signing shows that Germany and Canada want to deliver fast: to the benefit of our businesses, our people; to the benefit of Canadians, British Columbians and the Nisga’a Nation. Our partnership is entering into a new era, be it in energy, technology or defence. We are proud to be reliable and trusted partners of our Canadian friends.
quotes.speaker: Tjorven Bellman
quotes.article_title: Canada advances global energy exports by signing second European LNG deal

quotes.quote_text: This agreement sends a strong signal for greater security of supply and strategic independence: Uniper is securing around two million tonnes of Canadian LNG per year over the long term, equivalent to approximately 30 terawatt-hours. This is how we strengthen our resilience: through new sources of supply, long-term partnerships and greater diversification. Canada is a strategic partner for us — reliable, rich in natural resources and closely connected to Germany through strong economic ties.
quotes.speaker: Katherina Reiche
quotes.speaker_title: German Federal Minister for Economic Affairs and Energy
quotes.article_title: Canada advances global energy exports by signing second European LNG deal

quotes.quote_text: A project of this size returns real value — not just for Indigenous people but for everyone across B.C. and Canada — revenue that helps fund the hospitals we rely on and the schools our children learn in. It creates thousands of good careers for people who deserve the chance to build a future right here in northwest B.C. This agreement is proof of what’s possible when First Nations, the Province of B.C., the Canadian government, international partners and industry proponents work together. We’re proud of what Ksi Lisims LNG represents and optimistic for the future as the project moves toward FID and construction.
quotes.speaker: Eva Clayton
quotes.article_title: Canada advances global energy exports by signing second European LNG deal

quotes.quote_text: This agreement is about far more than LNG. By signing this long-term, off-take agreement, we are strengthening Uniper’s portfolio with a reliable source of LNG from Canada. As a trusted partner, Canada helps diversify Europe’s energy supply and strengthens resilience against future disruptions. In an increasingly uncertain world, diversification is a strategic necessity. The project combines security of supply, low-carbon hydropower infrastructure and a strong partnership — exactly the kind of long-term energy partnership we seek to build.
quotes.speaker: Michael Lewis
quotes.article_title: Canada advances global energy exports by signing second European LNG deal

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s defence needs are changing, and Canadian companies have an important role to play in meeting them. This investment will help GIT Coatings scale up production, strengthen local manufacturing capacity and support the growth of a resilient and sovereign defence industrial base.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: GIT Coatings to expand production with federal investment in Canada’s defence sector

quotes.quote_text: GIT Coatings is a strong example of the innovative companies helping Nova Scotia build the future of Canada’s defence industry. This project will help the company increase production and bring more Canadian-made solutions into defence and marine supply chains.
quotes.speaker: Braedon Clark
quotes.article_title: GIT Coatings to expand production with federal investment in Canada’s defence sector

quotes.quote_text: ACOA's support comes at a defining moment for both GIT Coatings and Canada's innovation economy. As we expand our Canadian-developed technologies into defence and security applications, this investment enables us to accelerate innovation, strengthen domestic manufacturing, create highly skilled jobs, and showcase Canadian technology on the global stage while reinforcing Canada's leadership in advanced marine technologies.
quotes.speaker: Mo AlGermozi
quotes.article_title: GIT Coatings to expand production with federal investment in Canada’s defence sector

quotes.quote_text: Today, for the first time in more than 25 years, we're bringing passenger rail locomotive assembly back to Montréal. This investment means skilled manufacturing jobs, stronger Canadian supply chains, and a modern fleet that will keep Canadians connected for decades to come. By combining Canadian expertise with world-class European innovation, we're strengthening our economy while building a more resilient passenger rail network for the future.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: Passenger Rail Locomotive Assembly Returns to Canada Through a $1.95 Billion Government of Canada Investment

quotes.quote_text: We thank the Government of Canada for its strong commitment to passenger rail. This major investment will help secure the future of long-distance, regional and remote passenger rail, allowing VIA Rail to continue fulfilling its national mandate and preserving essential connections for communities across the country. By building new rail capacity and specialized expertise in Canada, it will also strengthen our ability to serve Canadians for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Mathieu Paquette
quotes.speaker_title: Interim President and Chief Executive Officer
quotes.article_title: Passenger Rail Locomotive Assembly Returns to Canada Through a $1.95 Billion Government of Canada Investment

quotes.quote_text: Our hybrid locomotive platform combines performance, reliability and sustainability. By integrating battery-assisted operation into a powerful long-distance locomotive, we are providing VIA Rail with a future-oriented solution that supports its environmental objectives while enhancing operational flexibility and passenger service.
quotes.speaker: Iñigo Parra
quotes.article_title: Passenger Rail Locomotive Assembly Returns to Canada Through a $1.95 Billion Government of Canada Investment

quotes.quote_text: When we invest in the productivity of Atlantic Canadian businesses, we are sharpening Canada’s competitive edge. The Regional Tariff Response Initiative provides the tools local companies need to modernize their operations and build the strength required to thrive in a changing global marketplace.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support to help a New Brunswick company modernize, compete, and reach new markets

quotes.quote_text: Saint John is home to innovative companies that are creating good jobs and strengthening our local economy. This investment is helping Ocean Steel & Construction modernize its operations, adopt new technologies, and reach new markets. By supporting this project, we’re building stronger supply chains and positioning New Brunswick as a hub for growth and innovation in Atlantic Canada.
quotes.speaker: Wayne Long
quotes.speaker_title: Secretary, and Member of Parliament for Saint John – Kennebecasis
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support to help a New Brunswick company modernize, compete, and reach new markets

quotes.quote_text: This investment is about strengthening our operations and keeping our people employed here in New Brunswick. By modernizing our facilities, we’re increasing efficiency, and building Ocean Steel & Construction’s capacity to compete across North America as demand continues to grow. We are prioritizing this work to support steel manufacturing jobs and long-term growth in the region.
quotes.speaker: Hans O. Klohn
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support to help a New Brunswick company modernize, compete, and reach new markets

quotes.quote_text: The Ontario Honda Dealers Indy is a unique opportunity for Markham, York Region and Canada. Through this investment, we are helping the City of Markham ensure it has the infrastructure and capacity needed to deliver world-class events and attract visitation and investment in the years to come. This project will help drive investment and job creation, generating long-term economic benefits for the businesses, workers and sectors across the region.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports economic development in Markham

quotes.quote_text: This investment reinforces Markham’s reputation as a hub for innovation and world-class events, while also driving economic growth in our city.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports economic development in Markham

quotes.quote_text: Investing in Markham’s ability to host events like the Ontario Honda Dealers Indy will generate meaningful economic activity for the community. These improvements will make it easier for residents and visitors alike to access venues, while supporting local tourism and long-term growth.
quotes.speaker: Helena Jaczek
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports economic development in Markham

quotes.quote_text: Markham is a vibrant and growing community with the capacity to host major international events. This investment will help enhance local infrastructure and support initiatives that bring visitors to our city, benefiting businesses, creating jobs, and showcasing Markham as a destination of choice.
quotes.speaker: Michael Ma
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports economic development in Markham

quotes.quote_text: A race is never just a race, it is an economic engine. When 150,000 people come to your city and the world is watching in more than 200 countries, that fuels economic development. This investment drives growth, builds infrastructure, develops skilled talent, and sends a clear message: Markham is open for business, and Canada is open for investment. We thank the Government of Canada for backing a city that dares to be bold and delivers results.
quotes.speaker: His Worship
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports economic development in Markham

quotes.quote_text: Every day, the Canada Border Services Agency detects, prevents and disrupts drug smuggling. I have seen how effectively they work with the RCMP and other law enforcement partners to fight organized crime and protect our communities.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: CBSA officers seize 380 kg of methamphetamine and cocaine at Coutts port of entry in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: The CBSA defends our borders and protects Canadians. This significant seizure of hundreds of kilograms of methamphetamine and cocaine in Alberta highlights the skill of CBSA officers to stop illegal narcotics and other contraband from breaching our borders.
quotes.speaker: Janalee Bell-Boychuk
quotes.article_title: CBSA officers seize 380 kg of methamphetamine and cocaine at Coutts port of entry in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: The safety of Canadians depends on strong partnerships. By working collaboratively with our law enforcement partners, we are better positioned to stop illegal drugs at the border and prevent harmful substances from reaching our communities.
quotes.speaker: Chief Superintendent Brad Wirachowsky
quotes.article_title: CBSA officers seize 380 kg of methamphetamine and cocaine at Coutts port of entry in Alberta

quotes.quote_text: Building a strong Canada starts with building strong communities. The Government of Canada is building infrastructure at a speed and scale not seen in generations – the type of infrastructure projects that support stronger, safer, more connected communities across the country.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in the Saint John Multipurpose Recreational Facility

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today’s investment in the Saint John Multipurpose Recreational Facility in Saint John will help expand opportunities for residents to participate in sports, recreation, and community activities. By providing modern, welcoming facilities, it will encourage active lifestyles, foster social connections, and improve the overall quality of life for people of all ages and abilities.
quotes.speaker: Wayne Long
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in the Saint John Multipurpose Recreational Facility

quotes.quote_text: Investing in modern, energy efficient community infrastructure is an investment in the future of our city and our region. This exciting initiative strengthens our ability to meet the needs of an increasingly growing, healthy and active population, while also supporting our long-term vision for a more sustainable, inclusive, and resilient Saint John. We are proud to partner with the Government of Canada on this transformative facility that will benefit families, athletes, organizations, and communities throughout the Saint John region for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Donna Noade Reardon
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in the Saint John Multipurpose Recreational Facility

quotes.quote_text: Building a stronger Canada starts with building reliable, affordable and clean electricity systems throughout the country, including the North. Investments like the ones announced today reduce reliance on diesel and support Indigenous leadership in shaping the energy future of their communities. By working in partnership with territorial and Indigenous governments, we are creating the conditions for long-term economic growth, greater resilience and new opportunities for northern communities while advancing our path to a low-carbon future.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in clean energy projects across Yukon, Nunavut and the Northwest Territories to secure affordable, reliable, clean power

quotes.quote_text: Securing reliable, affordable, clean power in Yukon and the North is essential to our prosperity, security and sustainability. Investments like these demonstrate our government’s commitment to working, in partnership with Indigenous Peoples and northern communities, to help meet evolving energy needs, create economic opportunities, reduce emissions and advance community-led solutions that will help power the North’s energy future.
quotes.speaker: Brendan Hanley
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in clean energy projects across Yukon, Nunavut and the Northwest Territories to secure affordable, reliable, clean power

quotes.quote_text: Canadians expect passport services that work for their lives. Expanding online renewal gives eligible Canadians a simpler, more convenient way to renew their passports, without unnecessary barriers or delays. This is part of the Government of Canada’s ongoing work to modernize passport services and deliver public services that are responsive to the needs of Canadians today.
quotes.speaker: Lena Metlege Diab
quotes.article_title: Canada expands online passport renewal to all eligible adults (Toronto)

quotes.quote_text: Accessible service means giving Canadians options, starting with more ways to renew a passport. We are removing the barriers between Canadians and the services they rely on by modernizing how we deliver them and shaping them around how people live. When Canadians can access services without added stress or lost time, they can focus on what matters, their families, their jobs, and their futures.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Canada expands online passport renewal to all eligible adults (Toronto)

quotes.quote_text: Expanding online passport renewals reflects the way Canadians increasingly expect to interact with government: through secure, convenient and reliable digital services. By modernizing the passport renewal process, we improve accessibility, enhance the client experience, and deliver faster, more efficient service, while maintaining the integrity and security of Canada’s passport program. This is another step toward building a responsive, client-focused service that meets the needs of Canadians in today’s digital world.
quotes.speaker: Peter Fragiskatos
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister, Refugees and Citizenship
quotes.article_title: Canada expands online passport renewal to all eligible adults (Toronto)

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is proud to invest in active transportation infrastructure that will create safer, more accessible sidewalks and pathways for pedestrians and cyclists, which will improve the quality of life for residents and visitors in Antigonish.
quotes.speaker: Jaime Battiste
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in active transportation and accessibility improvements in Antigonish

quotes.quote_text: This project is about creating better connections for our community and ensuring that residents can move safely and comfortably to one of our most important destinations, St. Martha’s Regional Hospital. By improving pedestrian access to the hospital, we are enhancing accessibility for patients, visitors, staff, and families, while encouraging healthier and more active ways of getting around. This new pathway is another important piece of our growing active transportation network. It will connect the Town’s recently completed active transportation trail on the east end of Main Street with the hospital’s existing pathway system, creating a seamless and accessible route for everyone who uses it. Together, these investments are helping us build a more connected, accessible, and vibrant community—one that supports the well-being of our residents today and for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Sean Cameron
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in active transportation and accessibility improvements in Antigonish

quotes.quote_text: Over the past two days, I had the opportunity to meet the people and organizations that make Alberta a driving force in Canada’s sport system. Together, community and Indigenous-led programs, world-class training centres and international events create opportunities for children to discover sport, for communities to connect and for athletes to pursue excellence in this province. These Government of Canada investments will strengthen sport at every level across Alberta, from the playground to the podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Federal investments support Canada’s sport system in Alberta from playground to podium

quotes.quote_text: Bloor Station is one of Toronto’s most connected transit hubs, bringing together access to GO Transit, UP Express, and the TTC – all in one facility. These upgrades will make it easier for people across the region to get to work, school, and home, strengthening the links that keep our city moving.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, on behalf of the Honourable Gregor Robertson, Minister
quotes.article_title: Federal government celebrates progress on the GO Transit expansion

quotes.quote_text: Our Government is tackling the affordability crisis from every angle. That includes building more transit so that more people can reach their destinations quickly and reliably. I am very pleased to see that progress on expanding and improving public transportation across the GTA . We’re building Toronto strong and Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Karim Bardeesy
quotes.article_title: Federal government celebrates progress on the GO Transit expansion

quotes.quote_text: The Bloor GO/UP Station is a vital hub in our community. These upgrades will make a real difference for the people who use it every day. By expanding transit capacity and constructing parks and noise barriers, this facility will provide a better experience for riders now and into the future.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dzerowicz
quotes.article_title: Federal government celebrates progress on the GO Transit expansion

quotes.quote_text: Under Premier Ford’s leadership, our government is delivering the largest transit expansion in North America to tackle gridlock and connect more people to housing and jobs. The improvements at Bloor GO/UP Station will support increased service on the Kitchener Line, getting people where they’re going faster.
quotes.speaker: Prabmeet Sarkaria
quotes.article_title: Federal government celebrates progress on the GO Transit expansion

quotes.quote_text: I applaud the completion of these important upgrades at Bloor GO/UP Station. As Toronto continues to grow, investments that improve transit connections and increase service will help residents move around the city more easily and support our shared goal of building a more connected city.
quotes.speaker: Olivia Chow
quotes.article_title: Federal government celebrates progress on the GO Transit expansion

quotes.quote_text: Operation NANOOK-QIMAAVIVUT strengthens the practical foundations that enable effective Arctic operations. By improving mobility, sustainment, and operational support, we ensure the Canadian Armed Forces can operate effectively across Canada’s Arctic and North, in all seasons.
quotes.speaker: Lieutenant-General Steve Boivin
quotes.article_title: Canadian Armed Forces strengthen Arctic mobility and operational support during Operation NANOOK-QIMAAVIVUT

quotes.quote_text: QIMAAVIVUT is about enabling operations today and into the future. By improving access, mobility, and sustainment in challenging environments, we are improving how the CAF supports operations across the North while respecting local conditions and communities.
quotes.speaker: Brigadier-General Marc Parent
quotes.article_title: Canadian Armed Forces strengthen Arctic mobility and operational support during Operation NANOOK-QIMAAVIVUT

quotes.quote_text: Communities across Atlantic Canada need infrastructure that works, today and for the future. This targeted investment will help get federal dollars directly into the Crapaud area to build and upgrade the places people rely on every day. Practical investments like this support for the Crapaud Exhibition Association bring people together and strengthen local economies.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: $150,700 in federal funding will help add more seating at the Crapaud Exhibition

quotes.quote_text: This federal investment of $150,700 will support the Crapaud Exhibition Fairgrounds welcome more people and support the continued growth of popular annual events like the Crapaud Exhibition and Truck and Tractor Pulls, timeless traditions every summer for many Islanders and tourists alike. Investments in rural community infrastructure ensures we are building strong communities today and for future generations.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: $150,700 in federal funding will help add more seating at the Crapaud Exhibition

quotes.quote_text: We are extremely grateful to ACOA and the Government of Canada for their support of this important project. These new bleachers will greatly improve the comfort, safety and overall experience for visitors attending the Crapaud Exhibition and the PEI Truck and Tractor Pull Championships. This investment will provide lasting value to our events, our grounds and our community for many years to come.
quotes.speaker: Jason Webster
quotes.article_title: $150,700 in federal funding will help add more seating at the Crapaud Exhibition

quotes.quote_text: Southern Ontario businesses have what it takes to compete internationally. By supporting organizations like TBDC, we are helping our companies gain the knowledge, networks, and market access they need to grow in European markets, strengthen their global competitiveness and build trade resiliency to build Canada strong.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada support to help Ontario businesses strengthen trade resilience and expand into new markets

quotes.quote_text: Ontario is proud to support Toronto Business Development Centre’s new GoEU program, which will connect businesses from across the province with new export opportunities in Europe. As we accelerate our efforts to diversify trade with reliable partners from across the world, TBDC’s work will play a critical role in helping businesses stay competitive by forging new, international partnerships and unlocking opportunities for economic growth.
quotes.speaker: Victor Fedeli
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada support to help Ontario businesses strengthen trade resilience and expand into new markets

quotes.quote_text: This is the moment for Canadian Entrepreneurs to expand globally. GoEU gives our exporters and tech companies a real running start in Europe, the contacts and the in-market support to acquire customers. With support from the Government of Canada and the Government of Ontario, we can help these founders not just enter Europe, but grow in it.
quotes.speaker: Vikram Khurana
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada support to help Ontario businesses strengthen trade resilience and expand into new markets

quotes.quote_text: Canada has what it needs to lead in the global electric vehicle revolution. With our resources and our skilled workforce, as well as the momentum created by new international partnerships like the memorandum of understanding we signed with the Republic of Korea earlier this year to advance domestic EV manufacturing opportunities, we are building a competitive, resilient battery supply chain that attracts major investments. Volta’s new battery foil plant will strengthen Quebec’s central role in our auto strategy and ensure that more of the EV value chain is anchored here at home, creating hundreds of well-paying jobs for the people of Granby and driving long-term growth for Canadian industry.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests $70 million to strengthen the EV battery supply chain in Quebec

quotes.quote_text: We are deeply grateful for the support of the Canadian government. Through this project, we are committed to contributing to local economic revitalization and the stabilization of the North American battery supply chain. With the Canadian production base now moving into full swing following Hungary, the completeness of our global battery foil supply system has reached a new level. We will continue to build an even more robust supply foundation to meet the growing demand from North America’s EV and ESS industries.
quotes.speaker: Kwak Geun-man
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests $70 million to strengthen the EV battery supply chain in Quebec

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada has advanced new laws to enhance protection for victims and survivors of human trafficking. These consequential Criminal Code reforms support building safer communities for all Canadians, while complementing the ongoing work by the provincial, territorial, and community partners. Today’s investment signifies an important step in our efforts to end human trafficking, and solidifying a justice system that responds to the needs of victims and survivors while putting their safety and dignity first.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Human trafficking is a devastating form of gender-based violence that demands a coordinated response. Through sustained collaboration and a shared commitment to action, we are strengthening Canada's response by enhancing supports for victims and survivors, and advancing community-driven prevention efforts. Together, we are building a future where everyone can live safely, and those at risk of exploitation are better supported and protected.
quotes.speaker: Rechie Valdez
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Human trafficking robs people of their freedom, safety and dignity. This $450,000 investment in CEASE will strengthen support for survivors in Alberta, help address the growing connection between online exploitation and human trafficking, and ensure more people have somewhere to turn when they need help most.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Building a safer Canada means investing in organizations that deliver ongoing services to support victims and survivors of serious crime, including human trafficking. These services will enable survivors across Canada and in my riding of Kelowna to receive the supports they need. Today’s investment by Justice Canada along with continued efforts from federal, provincial, and territorial partners will ensure stronger, safer communities for all Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Stephen Fuhr
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Organizations like Angels of Hope provide vital and invaluable services and resources to our community, offering support, safety, and hope. Ensuring that survivors of human trafficking and gender-based violence have access to these services in the language of their choice is essential. Language should never be a barrier to seeking help, accessing critical resources, or beginning the journey toward healing and recovery. Today as we honour ‘World Day Against Trafficking in Persons’ – I want to acknowledge Angels of Hope, and all the important work they do across our communities.
quotes.speaker: Viviane Lapointe
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Every survivor deserves to know that they are not alone and that help is available. This investment is more than funding, it is an investment in hope, healing, and second chances. We are honoured that Angels of Hope Against Human Trafficking is among the organizations receiving this support, and we thank the Government of Canada for recognizing the vital role community organizations play in walking alongside survivors on their journey toward recovery. Together, we can continue building a future where survivors are empowered, traffickers are held accountable, and human trafficking has no place in our communities.
quotes.speaker: Cristina Scarpellini
quotes.speaker_title: Founder/Executive Director, Angels of Hope Against Human Trafficking
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada has advanced new laws to enhance protection for victims and survivors of human trafficking. These consequential Criminal Code reforms support building safer communities for all Canadians, while complementing the ongoing work by the provincial, territorial, and community partners. Today’s investment signifies an important step in our efforts to end human trafficking, and solidifying a justice system that responds to the needs of victims and survivors while putting their safety and dignity first.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Human trafficking is a devastating form of gender-based violence that demands a coordinated response. Through sustained collaboration and a shared commitment to action, we are strengthening Canada's response by enhancing supports for victims and survivors, and advancing community-driven prevention efforts. Together, we are building a future where everyone can live safely, and those at risk of exploitation are better supported and protected.
quotes.speaker: Rechie Valdez
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Human trafficking robs people of their freedom, safety and dignity. This $450,000 investment in CEASE will strengthen support for survivors in Alberta, help address the growing connection between online exploitation and human trafficking, and ensure more people have somewhere to turn when they need help most.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Building a safer Canada means investing in organizations that deliver ongoing services to support victims and survivors of serious crime, including human trafficking. These services will enable survivors across Canada and in my riding of Kelowna to receive the supports they need. Today’s investment by Justice Canada along with continued efforts from federal, provincial, and territorial partners will ensure stronger, safer communities for all Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Stephen Fuhr
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Human trafficking is a crime that disproportionately affects women and girls, particularly Indigenous, newcomer and low-income individuals. We know that we can better support victims and survivors of this heinous crime by partnering with organizations across Canada, like Dartmouth’s Stepping Stone, that deliver critical services to those who need them most.
quotes.speaker: Darren Fisher
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Every survivor deserves to know that they are not alone and that help is available. This investment is more than funding, it is an investment in hope, healing, and second chances. We are honoured that Angels of Hope Against Human Trafficking is among the organizations receiving this support, and we thank the Government of Canada for recognizing the vital role community organizations play in walking alongside survivors on their journey toward recovery. Together, we can continue building a future where survivors are empowered, traffickers are held accountable, and human trafficking has no place in our communities.
quotes.speaker: Cristina Scarpellini
quotes.speaker_title: Founder/Executive Director, Angels of Hope Against Human Trafficking
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Human trafficking has devastating and lasting impacts on individuals, families, and communities. This investment from the Government of Canada will strengthen CEASE's ability to develop innovative approaches and expand our work into digital spaces, where victims of sex trafficking can be identified and connected to support. Together, we can create safer pathways to recovery, and healing, from trafficking.
quotes.speaker: Liz John-West
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Thanks to the Victims Fund, La Sortie was able to structure and expand its services beginning in 2017. Today, this support continues to provide women who have experienced sexual exploitation and participants in our programs with a safe place to find refuge, rebuild their lives, and begin a process of social and judicial reintegration, as many face significant barriers on their path to recovery. Indeed, the majority of them face significant justice-related challenges.
quotes.speaker: Ronald Lepage
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Survivors of sex trafficking often face significant barriers when navigating the justice system, and without specialized, trauma and violence informed support, the process can be difficult and retraumatizing. This investment in the London Abused Women’s Centre’s Journey to Justice Program recognizes the critical need for survivor-centred advocacy and individualized case management to empower women through their journey to justice. This funding will strengthen our ability to provide immediate access to service, promote healing, and ensure survivors have the support they need to pursue justice with dignity. We are grateful for the federal government's leadership and commitment to investing in services that put the needs, safety, and voices of survivors first.
quotes.speaker: Jennifer Dunn
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Today we celebrate more than an investment in programming; it is an investment in possibility. At NOW Canada, we witness the courage of survivors of human trafficking as they reclaim their lives. This funding from Justice Canada strengthens our trauma-informed, wraparound supports for women and girls, fostering safety, healing, stability, and hope. Addressing human trafficking requires sustained partnerships and coordinated systems. We are grateful to Justice Canada for investing in survivor-centred, community-based solutions that align with our mission and help create pathways to freedom, dignity, and lasting change.
quotes.speaker: Zandi Moyo
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Réseau-femmes du Sud-Ouest de l’Ontario sincerely thanks the Department of Justice Canada for its support in carrying out the Justice and Freedom: Protecting Vulnerable Women from Human Trafficking project. While Ontario accounts for nearly 67% of reported human trafficking cases in Canada, and the Windsor region is a high-risk corridor due to its proximity to the U.S. border and the high volume of cross-border traffic, this two-year funding will help address a very real need in a region that is particularly vulnerable to this issue. Through this project, we will strengthen prevention efforts, develop tailored resources, and provide safe support to vulnerable girls and women. By engaging community partners and raising public awareness, we will help build a community that is better informed, more vigilant, and better equipped to recognize, prevent, and address human trafficking.
quotes.speaker: Danielle Péladeau
quotes.speaker_title: Executive Director, Réseau-Femmes du Sud-Ouest De L'Ontario
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Survivors of trafficking have identified navigating government and social services as a challenge to receiving adequate support and an avenue for re-traumatization to causes further harm. To counter this, survivors of trafficking require specialized and wraparound resources and services that center their unique needs and circumstances. Specialized, trauma-informed training and dedicated community responses are foundational to minimizing secondary harm, meeting the survivor where they are at, and supporting survivors at all stages of their journey. Dedicated funding to support survivors of trafficking is an important step that emphasizes the diverse needs of survivors and ensures best practices are integrated into services across community and government.
quotes.speaker: Lorraine Whalley
quotes.speaker_title: Executive Director, Sexual Violence New Brunswick
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: Recovery from human trafficking requires comprehensive and sustained support that is only possible with adequate funding. This crucial investment will provide vital programs for victims and survivors of human trafficking including effective prevention efforts, timely crisis responses, and essential continuous wrap-around supports necessary for long term safety and well being.
quotes.speaker: Alex MacDonnell
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: No survivor should have to choose between pursuing justice and protecting their recovery (from what was done to them). This funding helps ensure survivors are not left to navigate that journey alone by providing practical support and lived experience peer support that protects healing during one of the most vulnerable stages of recovery.
quotes.speaker: Cynthia Bland
quotes.article_title: Minister Fraser announces support and funding for victims and survivors of human trafficking

quotes.quote_text: For local governments across British Columbia, the right investment can support housing, foster connection and build strong communities. These projects will make a lasting impact and reinforce our commitment to building bold, building strong, and building together.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Building Communities Strong in British Columbia with 54 new infrastructure projects

quotes.quote_text: Strong communities depend on strong infrastructure. As British Columbia grows, our government's priority is helping municipalities plan for the future and meet changing needs. Thanks to partnerships with the Government of Canada, UBCM and local governments, these 54 projects will help communities build the infrastructure they need to deliver reliable services and create a more resilient future.
quotes.speaker: Christine Boyle
quotes.speaker_title: B.C. Minister of Housing and Municipal Affairs
quotes.article_title: Building Communities Strong in British Columbia with 54 new infrastructure projects

quotes.quote_text: On behalf of the CRD , I would like to thank the Government of Canada, the Province of British Columbia and UBCM for their commitment to building stronger, more resilient communities through investments in innovative infrastructure. This biochar project will position the CRD as a national leader in biosolids management, carbon reduction and resource recovery. We are proud to advance an initiative that will provide lasting environmental and community benefits while further establishing our region as a leader in sustainable wastewater management.
quotes.speaker: Cliff McNeil-Smith
quotes.article_title: Building Communities Strong in British Columbia with 54 new infrastructure projects

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is improving the quality of life across British Columbia by investing directly into communities. UBCM is pleased to administer this fund that empowers local governments to address critical infrastructure priorities and refine asset management. We are grateful for the long-term commitment that Canada and BC have provided for this program.
quotes.speaker: Jenna Stoner
quotes.speaker_title: First Vice President, Union of British Columbia Municipalities (UBCM)
quotes.article_title: Building Communities Strong in British Columbia with 54 new infrastructure projects

quotes.quote_text: Under the leadership of Prime Minister Mark Carney, we have already secured more than $28 billion in international sales for Canadian companies. Today’s announcement builds on that work and accelerates it. That’s why we are bringing together leaders from some of Canada’s biggest companies, alongside diplomatic and financial specialists, as Team Canada. Canadian exports power our economy. They support millions of jobs and strengthen communities in every province and territory. The Strategic Exports Office and Strategic Exports Advisory Council mark a decisive step toward doubling our exports to non-U.S. markets. And they give Canadian businesses the whole-of-government support they need to compete and win around the world.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Minister Sidhu establishes Strategic Exports Office to strengthen Canada’s global competitiveness

quotes.quote_text: We're investing in more electric vehicle chargers across the country, making it even easier for Canadians to get to where they live, work, and play. Together with our Auto Strategy, we’re creating good jobs, strengthening Canada’s economy, and building a strong and climate-competitive future.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: The federal government invests in electric vehicle infrastructure and education across Canada

quotes.quote_text: With today’s announcement, we are accelerating the transition to zero-emission transportation across Canada through investments in electric vehicle infrastructure. By supporting the installation of electric vehicle charging infrastructure and increasing access to clean transportation options, we are making it easier for Canadians to choose electric vehicles and help build a cleaner, more sustainable future.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: The federal government invests in electric vehicle infrastructure and education across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Driving electric can save a Canadian household between $23,000 and $32,000 over 10 years, but for the nearly one in three Canadian families who live in condominiums, stratas, and apartments, those savings can be out of reach. Every day, condo boards, property managers, and landlords ask our members the same question: What do we do when a resident wants to install electric vehicle charging? This guide, funded by the Government of Canada, will give them clear, practical answers, and help ensure the benefits of low-cost electric driving reach every Canadian, not just those with a driveway. We thank Minister Dabrusin and the Government of Canada for this important investment.
quotes.speaker: Travis Allan
quotes.article_title: The federal government invests in electric vehicle infrastructure and education across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Electric Mobility Canada is grateful to the Government of Canada for supporting two practical, high-impact initiatives that will help accelerate transportation electrification across the country. The first will establish light-duty vehicle fleet charging resource hubs in the Prairies and the Maritimes, giving municipalities, public agencies, institutions, utilities, and commercial fleets the guidance, tools, and peer support they need to plan and implement charging infrastructure. The second will advance vehicle-grid integration in Canada by bringing utilities, regulators, automakers, and policymakers together around managed charging and bidirectional charging solutions that can improve affordability, reliability, and sustainability across the electricity system. Together with our partners, Electric Mobility Canada is proud to help build the knowledge, collaboration, and implementation capacity needed to make electric mobility work for communities across Canada.
quotes.speaker: Daniel Breton
quotes.article_title: The federal government invests in electric vehicle infrastructure and education across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Canada's impact assessment process is designed to support well-planned projects that benefit communities. Through meaningful Indigenous engagement and evidence-based decision-making, it helps create the conditions for job creation, economic opportunity, and responsible development.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: The federal government announces major milestone for the Crawford Nickel Project

quotes.quote_text: The Crawford Nickel Project is an example of Canada's global critical minerals leadership, and today's approval is a testament to our government's commitment to getting projects approved and streamlining our permitting processes in a way that maintains rigorous environmental standards and respect for the rights of Indigenous Peoples. This is how we create investment certainty for Canadian mining here in Ontario and across the country, so we can be a critical minerals superpower and create economic growth and opportunity and enhance supply chain sovereignty for all Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: The federal government announces major milestone for the Crawford Nickel Project

quotes.quote_text: Today's milestone reflects the Government of Canada's commitment to getting nation-building projects built faster and more efficiently. A more predictable path for projects of national interest will strengthen Canada's economy, create thousands of good-paying jobs, and deliver lasting benefits for communities across the country, while upholding Indigenous rights and maintaining strong environmental standards.
quotes.speaker: Dominic LeBlanc
quotes.article_title: The federal government announces major milestone for the Crawford Nickel Project

quotes.quote_text: Building more homes starts with providing the right infrastructure that makes new housing possible. By investing in essential water, sewer, and stormwater infrastructure in Fredericton, we are creating the conditions for sustainable growth. This investment will help increase housing supply, improve affordability, and ensure more Canadians have access to the homes they need.
quotes.speaker: David Myles
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister, Minister responsible for Official Languages and to the Secretary
quotes.article_title: Canada and New Brunswick invest in housing-enabling infrastructure to help build more homes in Fredericton

quotes.quote_text: Strong communities are built on the infrastructure that allows them to grow. This investment will extend essential services into Fredericton’s newest neighbourhood, opening the door to new housing opportunities while supporting the city’s long-term growth and economic development.
quotes.speaker: Luke Randall
quotes.speaker_title: Minister responsible for Opportunities NB, Economic Development and Small Business, NB Liquor and Cannabis NB, and the Regulatory Accountability and Reporting Act and Member of Legislative Assembly for Fredericton North
quotes.article_title: Canada and New Brunswick invest in housing-enabling infrastructure to help build more homes in Fredericton

quotes.quote_text: This funding agreement is an important step forward in preparing the infrastructure needed for Fredericton’s growth. We are grateful for the support from the federal and provincial governments as we work to extend water, wastewater, and storm sewer infrastructure to the city’s southeast new neighbourhood. Aligned with the City of Fredericton’s Municipal Plan this critical work will help unlock new opportunities for housing, strengthen connectivity within our community, and ensure we are planning responsibly for the city’s future .
quotes.speaker: Steve Hicks
quotes.article_title: Canada and New Brunswick invest in housing-enabling infrastructure to help build more homes in Fredericton

quotes.quote_text: Eddie Goldenberg devoted his life to advancing Canada’s ambitions and strengthening our place in the world. His vision and unwavering belief in the power of research, innovation and talent helped shape the institutions and investments that continue to fuel our country’s success. Renaming our world-class international research chairs program in his honour is a fitting tribute to his extraordinary legacy and a commitment to carrying his vision forward by inspiring the next generation of global research leaders to choose Canada.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada renames Canada Impact+ Research Chairs program in honour of Eddie Goldenberg

quotes.quote_text: Research is one of Canada’s greatest strengths. Throughout his career, Eddie Goldenberg helped foster an environment where bold ideas could grow into lasting impact. The renaming of this program honours his contributions to strengthening Canada’s research ecosystem and advancing discovery.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada renames Canada Impact+ Research Chairs program in honour of Eddie Goldenberg

quotes.quote_text: When we invest in Canadian workers, businesses and innovation, we are strengthening our economy and our sovereignty. By supporting Canadian expertise and technology in Northern Ontario, we are strengthening our defense sector and ensuring Canada is equipped with tools we need, when it matters most. These investments are helping build a stronger, more resilient Canada, and we are building it right here at home.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests $2.7 million to strengthen Northeastern Ontario’s defence sector

quotes.quote_text: This $2.7 million investment in ITPS and the SKADI Cyber Defense Corporation will strengthen the economy, bolster Canada’s defence sector and create more than 60 high-quality jobs here at home in Northern Ontario. The RDII is a generational opportunity to reinforce our sovereignty and grow the links that keep our communities and industries connected. Today’s announcement is helping to achieve exactly that by training the next generation of military pilots in Northern Ontario and developing new cyber security solutions to preserve and protect our data and digital infrastructure.
quotes.speaker: Pauline Rochefort
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Secretary to the Secretary, and Member of Parliament for Nipissing-Timiskaming
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests $2.7 million to strengthen Northeastern Ontario’s defence sector

quotes.quote_text: We appreciate the support of FedNor and the Government of Canada. This investment is an important step in ITTC’s relocation to North Bay and in building a sovereign Canadian tactical aviation training capability. North Bay’s airspace, aviation infrastructure and military heritage give us the right operating environment to prepare pilots for modern operations. It will strengthen Canada’s capacity to support NATO and allied readiness while creating highly skilled aerospace and defence jobs in Northern Ontario.
quotes.speaker: Dave Lohse
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests $2.7 million to strengthen Northeastern Ontario’s defence sector

quotes.quote_text: We are pleased that FedNor is stepping up to support the evolution of Frostbow™ so we can make this cybersecurity solution stronger and more accessible to businesses and the Canadian military. Our proprietary system continuously detects, investigates, and responds to cyber threats in seconds so we can safeguard digital infrastructure, business information and protect Canada’s defence sector. The Canadian military and businesses across the country deserve world-class cybersecurity that keeps their data safe and on home soil - that’s exactly what Frostbow™ delivers.
quotes.speaker: Rachel Clark
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests $2.7 million to strengthen Northeastern Ontario’s defence sector

quotes.quote_text: The federal government is on a mission to build strong, connected and affordable communities. Projects like the Scarborough Subway Extension will make it easier for more people to access good jobs, affordable homes, and better opportunities. Working with the Province of Ontario we will build Toronto and Scarborough strong.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, on behalf of the Honourable Gregor Robertson, Minister
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario mark another milestone for the Scarborough Subway Extension

quotes.quote_text: Once complete, the Scarborough Subway Extension will reduce travel times for thousands of residents, connecting more people to good jobs, schools and vital appointments. Our government will continue to deliver for the people of Scarborough through our historic investments to expand public transit and health care, create jobs and lower costs for families.
quotes.speaker: Doug Ford
quotes.speaker_title: Premier of the Province of Ontario
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario mark another milestone for the Scarborough Subway Extension

quotes.quote_text: The Scarborough Subway Extension will cut commute times, connect people to jobs and healthcare, and make life more affordable for families. I'm proud to see shovels in the ground and this project moving forward for Scarborough—Woburn.
quotes.speaker: Michael Coteau
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario mark another milestone for the Scarborough Subway Extension

quotes.quote_text: We’re bringing world-class rapid transit to Scarborough by extending the TTC’s Line 2 subway service almost eight kilometres farther east. Under Premier Ford’s leadership, we’re building the infrastructure we need to support one of the fastest growing regions in Ontario, and we’re keeping thousands of workers on the job during construction.
quotes.speaker: Prabmeet Sarkaria
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario mark another milestone for the Scarborough Subway Extension

quotes.quote_text: Our government is committed to standing up for Canadian manufacturers and workers in the face of global trade disruptions. This provisional safeguard measure will help ensure that Canada’s wood cabinets and vanities industry can compete on a level playing field, maintain good jobs, and continue contributing to the strength of our economy.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: Canada imposes provisional safeguard tariff on imports of wood cabinets and vanities to protect Canadian manufacturers and workers

quotes.quote_text: Our thoughts remain with everyone continuing to navigate the aftermath of this tragedy. While every person's experience is different, we know that the impacts of such events can be felt long after they occur and that ongoing support is essential. This funding will help ensure individuals, families and community members affected by the tragedy have access to the services and assistance they need to support their well-being.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces funding to support those affected by the Tumbler Ridge tragedy

quotes.quote_text: The people of Tumbler Ridge continue to face the profound impacts of this tragedy, and recovery will take time. We are grateful to the Government of Canada for this funding, which will help the Canadian Red Cross provide practical support, work alongside local partners, and respond to the evolving needs identified by the community.
quotes.speaker: Conrad Sauvé
quotes.speaker_title: President and CEO, Canadian Red Cross
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces funding to support those affected by the Tumbler Ridge tragedy

quotes.quote_text: In the wake of this terrible tragedy, the people of Tumbler Ridge continue to face unimaginable loss. Our government is working with the province to strengthen local victim services with funding that will help ensure victims, families and community members can access the support they need to recover from this tragedy, while strengthening local supports that communities can rely on for years ahead.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces funding to support those affected by the Tumbler Ridge tragedy

quotes.quote_text: Our hearts remain with the families in Tumbler Ridge and everyone in the community that will carry the impacts of this tragedy for the rest of their lives. We are grateful to the Government of Canada for providing funding that supports the crucial work being done in the community of Tumbler Ridge. Victim service workers and local service providers have been working tirelessly to support the community and the families that were directly impacted by the tragedy, and this funding will allow them to continue helping people recover.
quotes.speaker: Nina Krieger
quotes.speaker_title: B.C. Minister of Public Safety and Solicitor General
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces funding to support those affected by the Tumbler Ridge tragedy

quotes.quote_text: These investments for Fortune and Burin small craft harbours are important for the region as a whole. These projects enhance safety, improve operational capacity, and help secure the future of essential harbours that support local communities. Our government is proud to invest in infrastructure that not only meets today's needs but also lays the foundation for prosperity and resilience for decades to come.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Minister announces small craft harbour improvement projects on the Burin Peninsula, Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: Strengthening Northern and Arctic sovereignty is essential to our national security and is a priority for the Government of Canada. Through the Defence Industrial Strategy, the Defence Investment Agency is leveraging our strategic partnerships to invest in our security and our economy. The contract awarded today as part of the ESCP-P initiative will provide enhanced situational awareness and a strong presence in the North while empowering Canada to respond to evolving threats amid a shifting geopolitical environment.
quotes.speaker: Stephen Fuhr
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada awards a military communications contract to support Arctic sovereignty and national security

quotes.quote_text: By investing in the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project – Polar, we are giving the Canadian Armed Forces next generation military satellite communications, so our personnel have secure, resilient, and reliable connectivity in the Arctic and other high-latitude regions where they need it most. Through this project, we are accelerating the delivery of critical capabilities, defending Canada's sovereignty and security, and strengthening our domestic defence industrial base to deliver for Canadians for years to come.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada awards a military communications contract to support Arctic sovereignty and national security

quotes.quote_text: This project is Canada's Defence Industrial Strategy and the Defence Investment Agency in action, a clear example of delivering the 'Build' pillar of the 'Build-Partner-Buy' approach at speed. By partnering with Canada's space industry, we are delivering critical capabilities to the Canadian Armed Forces while strengthening Canada's sovereign industrial base. This investment will help drive innovation, support high-value jobs, and build the resilient industrial capacity needed to meet Canada's defence and security priorities for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Doug Guzman
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada awards a military communications contract to support Arctic sovereignty and national security

quotes.quote_text: Secure, sovereign communications are essential to the Canadian Armed Forces’ ability to operate across Canada’s North, work seamlessly with our allies and partners, and contribute to continental defence. The Enhanced Satellite Communications Project – Polar will strengthen our ability to connect, command and coordinate in the Arctic and other high-latitude regions, while supporting NORAD modernization and ensuring our personnel have the capabilities they need to meet today’s threats and those of the future.
quotes.speaker: LGen Jamie Speiser-Blanchet
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada awards a military communications contract to support Arctic sovereignty and national security

quotes.quote_text: Telesat is honoured to support the Government of Canada in strengthening Northern and Arctic sovereignty. This contract ensures the Canadian Armed Forces will have access to secure, resilient and sovereign connectivity years earlier than originally planned, at a great value for money, and with a scalable architecture designed to meet future global operational requirements and support interoperability with Canada’s allies and partners.
quotes.speaker: Dan Goldberg
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada awards a military communications contract to support Arctic sovereignty and national security

quotes.quote_text: At a time when the Canadian Armed Forces urgently need secure and sovereign connectivity in the North, the Government of Canada is committing significant financial resources and tapping our country’s world-leading space industrial base to ensure Canada’s defence in the strategic region of the Arctic. We commend the government’s commitment to sovereign connectivity and for a remarkably agile, rapid and responsive procurement process, which involved advancing from the options analysis and definition phase of the program to development and procurement in only a matter of months.
quotes.speaker: Mike Greenley
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada awards a military communications contract to support Arctic sovereignty and national security

quotes.quote_text: Supporting victims and survivors of gender-based violence, and their families, means making sure help is there the moment it’s needed. Across Canada, crisis hotlines are a critical connection to safety, support and trusted information. Through this investment, we are strengthening these essential services in every province and territory and supporting frontline organizations so that no matter where someone lives, they can access support when they need it most.
quotes.speaker: Rechie Valdez
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez announces federal support for crisis hotlines responding to gender-based violence in Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: For someone facing violence, abuse, overwhelming fear or isolation, the voice on the other end of the phone can be the difference between facing a crisis alone and finding a path toward safety, hope, and healing. Investing in crisis hotlines is an investment in people, ensuring that trained professionals are available to listen without judgement, provide compassionate support, and help navigate complex and often dangerous situations. Crisis helplines also help remove barriers to accessing assistance, particularly for those living in rural, remote, and underserved communities, where other services may not be immediately available.
quotes.speaker: Lela Evans
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez announces federal support for crisis hotlines responding to gender-based violence in Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: Crisis hotlines provide an essential connection to support for people experiencing gender-based violence, especially in a province where distance and geography can make accessing services more difficult. Every call answered is an opportunity to help someone find safety, information, and support. Strengthening these services means more people in Newfoundland and Labrador and across Canada can access compassionate support when they need it most.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez announces federal support for crisis hotlines responding to gender-based violence in Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: The Toronto Caribbean Carnival is a vibrant celebration of Caribbean culture, heritage and creativity that shapes Canada’s identity, enriches our communities and brings communities together through a shared cultural experience. With this investment, we are supporting the artists and performers whose talent and dedication bring Caribbean-Canadian traditions to life.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports the Toronto Caribbean Carnival

quotes.quote_text: The Toronto Caribbean Carnival is one of the most popular cultural events in our city and a powerful expression of the diversity that makes Toronto strong. This funding supports thousands of local artists and performers while ensuring that visitors can continue to experience the music, dance, storytelling and traditions that make Carnival such an important celebration.
quotes.speaker: Karim Bardeesy
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports the Toronto Caribbean Carnival
