Securing investments of this nature requires significant effort behind the scenes, and this funding is a direct reflection of our team’s commitment to strengthening our infrastructure and delivering value for Mapleton.
quotes.speaker: Manny Baron
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in enhancement and expansion to the PMD Arena and Community Centre

quotes.quote_text: Investing in Gagetown is an investment in the readiness of the Canadian Army and in the people who serve Canada. This major modernization will give our soldiers the infrastructure and training environment they need to prepare for the most demanding missions, while supporting good jobs here in New Brunswick. We are rebuilding the foundations of Canada’s defence capabilities — with modern, resilient infrastructure that will serve the Canadian Armed Forces for decades to come.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Canada marks start of major infrastructure upgrades at 5th Canadian Division Support Base Gagetown

quotes.quote_text: Today’s groundbreaking marks an important step forward for 5th Canadian Division Support Base Gagetown and our community. These investments will modernize roads, bridges and training facilities that our Canadian Armed Forces members rely on every day, while creating jobs and supporting New Brunswick businesses. Gagetown is a cornerstone of our local community and a critical part of Canada’s defence infrastructure, and I’m proud to see this significant investment moving forward.
quotes.speaker: David Myles
quotes.speaker_title: Member, and Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister of Canadian Identity and Culture and Minister responsible for Official Languages and to the Secretary of State (Nature)
quotes.article_title: Canada marks start of major infrastructure upgrades at 5th Canadian Division Support Base Gagetown

quotes.quote_text: This important investment reflects the value of strong collaboration between the Department of National Defence, Defence Construction Canada and industry partners. Together, we are helping deliver the modern, resilient infrastructure that will support safe and effective training at 5th Canadian Division Support Base Gagetown and deliver long-term value for the Canadian Armed Forces.
quotes.speaker: Derrick Cheung
quotes.article_title: Canada marks start of major infrastructure upgrades at 5th Canadian Division Support Base Gagetown

quotes.quote_text: Southern Ontario businesses are the engine of our economy, and our government is committed to helping them succeed. Through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative, we are providing the support businesses need to stay competitive, protect jobs and continue growing. By investing in companies like Ideal Roofing, we are strengthening southern Ontario's economy for the future.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support to strengthen Canadian workers and businesses

quotes.quote_text: Canadian businesses are navigating a period of significant trade and economic challenges. Through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative and investments announced today, we are helping companies like Ideal Roofing invest in new capabilities, strengthen domestic supply chains, support skilled workers, and build a more resilient and competitive Canadian economy.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support to strengthen Canadian workers and businesses

quotes.quote_text: We thank the Government of Canada and FedDev Ontario for their support through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative. This investment will strengthen our manufacturing capabilities, enhance our resilience in a changing trade environment, and position Ideal Roofing for continued growth across Canada as we navigate an increasingly complex global trade environment.
quotes.speaker: Philippe Laplante
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces support to strengthen Canadian workers and businesses

quotes.quote_text: Operation NANOOK-NUNAKPUT reflects the Canadian Armed Forces’ enduring commitment to the Arctic and the North. Working closely with northern partners, federal agencies, and international allies, we are strengthening our ability to monitor activity across the Canadian Arctic Archipelago, deter threats to regional stability, and defend Canada’s sovereignty in this strategically vital region. Through a permanent presence and near-persistent operation, the Canadian Armed Forces remains ready, capable, and engaged in protecting Canada’s northern approaches and advancing security in the Arctic.’’
quotes.speaker: Lieutenant-General Steve
quotes.speaker_title: Boivin, Commander, Canadian Joint Operations Command
quotes.article_title: Canadian Armed Forces Launch Operation NANOOK NUNAKPUT to Strengthen Security Along the Canadian Arctic Archipelago

quotes.quote_text: Operation NANOOK-NUNAKPUT highlights the strength of the partnerships that enable us to operate successfully in Canada's Arctic. Working alongside northern Indigenous communities, the Canadian Coast Guard, and other mission partners, Joint Task Force North is strengthening relationships, enhancing readiness, and improving the Canadian Armed Forces ability to respond effectively across the Canadian Arctic Archipelago when called upon.
quotes.speaker: Brigadier-General Marc
quotes.speaker_title: Parent, Commander, Joint Task Force North
quotes.article_title: Canadian Armed Forces Launch Operation NANOOK NUNAKPUT to Strengthen Security Along the Canadian Arctic Archipelago

quotes.quote_text: Canadians deserve a food system that is strong, resilient and ready to meet the challenges of today and tomorrow. Through our investment in CAAIN, we are accelerating the commercialization and adoption of innovative agricultural technologies that improve productivity and strengthen food supply chains. Our government is taking decisive actions to enhance Canada’s food security and support long-term affordability for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces major investment in the Canadian Agri-Food Automation and Intelligence Network to strengthen Canada’s agri-food sector

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s agri-food sector has a long history of innovation, and CAAIN reflects that strength. This investment will help farmers and food processors across Canada test and adopt new technologies that improve productivity and reduce costs. Through this national network, based in Edmonton, we’re supporting the growth of a more resilient and competitive food system for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Corey Hogan
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces major investment in the Canadian Agri-Food Automation and Intelligence Network to strengthen Canada’s agri-food sector

quotes.quote_text: In our six years of operation, CAAIN has invested over $42 million in 56 exciting agri-food innovation projects on behalf of the Government of Canada. The new ISED funding will allow us to build on our track record of success that has seen several of our project partners successfully develop and commercialize their innovations. We look forward to continuing to support agricultural innovation and the producers who benefit from the new technologies.
quotes.speaker: Darrell Petras
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces major investment in the Canadian Agri-Food Automation and Intelligence Network to strengthen Canada’s agri-food sector

quotes.quote_text: At this difficult time, Canada stands with the people of Colombia. Canada is supporting efforts to help meet immediate humanitarian needs and assist the communities hit hardest by the disaster.
quotes.speaker: Randeep Sarai
quotes.article_title: Canada provides humanitarian assistance in response to earthquake in Colombia

quotes.quote_text: Through this humanitarian assistance, Canada is supporting trusted partners in delivering life-saving aid to those affected by this devastating earthquake. Canada stands with the people of Colombia and is committed to helping communities respond to this crisis.
quotes.speaker: Anita Anand
quotes.article_title: Canada provides humanitarian assistance in response to earthquake in Colombia

quotes.quote_text: Our heritage is at the heart of our identity. It helps us understand where we came from and shapes where we are going. By supporting this exhibition at l’Odyssée des Bâtisseurs, we are investing in the culture and economy of Lac-Saint-Jean, while giving local residents and visitors an opportunity to discover our regions and our stories.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Lac-Saint-Jean historical society for the creation of exhibit at l’Odyssée des Bâtisseurs museum

quotes.quote_text: I welcome our government’s investment supporting the design and creation of this original exhibition on camping in Canada. Camping is also a part of our culture in Canada. Our museums allow us to understand our history while stimulating our local economies and attracting visitors from near and far. This travelling exhibition will be able to attract a much larger audience and allow them to discover this facet of our history and heritage.
quotes.speaker: Madeleine Chenette
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Lac-Saint-Jean historical society for the creation of exhibit at l’Odyssée des Bâtisseurs museum

quotes.quote_text: This new exhibition will allow l’Odyssée des Bâtisseurs to help visitors at museums across Canada discover the history of camping. It is a well-known cultural practice that has not really been studied. The history of its evolution is rich and spans both the occupation and development of the territory, the traditional way of life of the first inhabitants, the evolution of customs and leisure activities, and environmental protection. When they see the exhibition, visitors will discover or rediscover this history through photographs and artifacts, as well as a diverse and engaging presentation.
quotes.speaker: Anne-Julie Néron
quotes.speaker_title: Executive Director. Société d’histoire du Lac-Saint-Jean
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Lac-Saint-Jean historical society for the creation of exhibit at l’Odyssée des Bâtisseurs museum

quotes.quote_text: The Pleasant Camp port of entry is an economic and cultural link between remote communities in British Columbia, the Yukon and Alaska in the United States. This redevelopment will enhance the border crossing experience for travellers and commercial carriers, and strengthen security by providing Border Services Officers with modern infrastructure and the latest technologies.
quotes.speaker: Nina Patel
quotes.article_title: The CBSA starts construction at Pleasant Camp port of entry

quotes.quote_text: Sport has the power to shape lives and connect people in ways that very few things can. The Bolton High Performance Athletics Centre will create more opportunities for Canadians to play, train, and proudly wear the maple leaf on the world stage. By investing in this project, the Government of Canada is strengthening athlete performance, expanding access to sport and creating more local hosting opportunities. We’re building Canada Strong, from playground to podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam Van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investment in Bolton, Ontario

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today’s investment will help build the foundation our athletes need to reach their full potential. This world class facility will bring expert coaching, sports science all under one roof, will reduce barriers to participation and sustain long-term regional sport.
quotes.speaker: Ruby Sahota
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investment in Bolton, Ontario

quotes.quote_text: On behalf of Athletics Canada, I want to thank the Government of Canada for its significant investment in the Bolton High Performance Athletics Centre through the Build Communities Strong Fund. Quality and access to facilities are cornerstones of the continued growth and success of sport in Canada. Athletics is truly a foundational sport, from playground to the podium, developing the fundamental skills that underpin so many other sports. Investments in facilities like this create a lasting legacy, providing community participants, local track and field clubs, developing athletes and Canada’s high performance athletes with the environments they need to participate, train and pursue excellence. This investment will strengthen athletics in the region and across the country for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Mathieu Gentès
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investment in Bolton, Ontario

quotes.quote_text: The Bolton High Performance Athletics Centre is a true testament to what partnerships and community can accomplish. More than two years of planning and fundraising are culminating in the creation of a special Athletics and community hub. This facility will change the landscape for track and field in Canada for generations. By Investing in this project, the Gov’t of Canada recognizes the need and helps pave the ‘pathway to the podium’.
quotes.speaker: Doug Wood
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada makes major investment in Bolton, Ontario

quotes.quote_text: Black entrepreneurs and business owners are shaping a more dynamic and competitive economy across southern Ontario. Today’s investments will help organizations strengthen the programs, expertise and partnerships that entrepreneurs need to move their businesses forward, creating lasting benefits for communities across the region.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment to strengthen opportunities for Black entrepreneurs and businesses across southern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: Today, Nobellum has launched over 121 companies, generating more than $30 million in revenue for Black STEM ventures across Canada. The CanBlack STEM Project builds on that track record, giving us the infrastructure to do it again, at scale. With this investment from the Government of Canada, we’re not starting from zero. We’re taking a model that already works and equipping it with more intentional programming, facility access, commercialization and capital pathways to build the next generation of high-growth STEM companies.
quotes.speaker: Melisa Ellis
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment to strengthen opportunities for Black entrepreneurs and businesses across southern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: Today’s investment will make homes more affordable for Vaughan families and help keep workers on the job in the face of President Trump’s tariffs. Mayor Del Duca and Vaughan council’s early leadership in lowering development charges, along with today’s provincial and federal funding, shows what Team Canada can do when we work together to protect workers and families.
quotes.speaker: Doug Ford
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: By partnering with Ontario and municipalities like the City of Vaughan through the Development Charge Reduction Program, our government is helping families save up to $230,000 on the purchase of a new home when combined with the removal of the HST. We're also unlocking over 120,000 new housing units while investing in the infrastructure that our communities need. This is what building strong at home looks like.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: By partnering with Ontario and municipalities like the City of Vaughan through the Development Charge Reduction Program, our government is helping families save up to $230,000 on the purchase of a new home when combined with the removal of the HST. We're also unlocking over 120,000 new housing units while investing in the infrastructure that our communities need. This is what building strong at home looks like.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: Across Ontario, there is a need for critical infrastructure and housing of all types to support our fast-growing communities. Our government is tremendously appreciative of partners like Vaughan, who took early action to reduce development charges and kickstart the local housing sector. Together, we will continue building on this momentum.
quotes.speaker: Rob Flack
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: Making life more affordable for Vaughan residents is a top priority. Vaughan has been at the forefront of addressing housing affordability by taking decisive action to reduce development charges and lower the costs that too often get passed on to homebuyers. I want to thank Premier Ford, Minister Rob Flack and the Government of Canada for recognizing the leadership Vaughan has shown and for supporting our city through the Canada—Ontario Development Charge Reduction Program. This funding represents an important step toward a more collaborative approach to building the infrastructure needed to support responsible growth. At the City of Vaughan, we will continue taking bold action to get more homes built, create more good-paying construction jobs and make home ownership more attainable for young families, while ensuring Vaughan remains a place where residents and families can live, grow and thrive for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Steven Del Duca
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: The next generation deserves the dream of homeownership just like generations before them. Ontario is taking action by cutting development charges by up to 50 per cent or more through the DCRP and removing the HST on new homes, immediately lowering costs by as much as $230,000 in cities like Vaughan. Ontario is proud to deliver an unprecedented level of funding to the City of Vaughan as we work together to reduce development charges, part of our plan to make housing affordable and communities more livable for every family. We are proud to announce our government's funding will deliver the widening of Huntington Road, Kirby Road and Teston Road between Pine Valley Drive and Kleinburg Summit Way to four lanes.”
quotes.speaker: Stephen Lecce
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement represents a significant step forward in making housing more affordable, improving community infrastructure, and creating new good-paying job opportunities for the people of Vaughan. As Ontario faces attacks on our economy from President Trump’s unjust tariffs, our government, in partnership with federal and municipal leaders, is meeting the challenge directly and putting in the work to protect Ontario.
quotes.speaker: Michael Tibollo
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: Our government is taking action to make homeownership more attainable while ensuring communities have the infrastructure they need to grow. By reducing development charges and investing in critical infrastructure, we are helping unlock new housing opportunities right here in Thornhill, lowering costs for homebuyers, and supporting the construction of complete communities where families can live, work and thrive.
quotes.speaker: Laura Smith
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: The Building Industry and Land Development Association (BILD) welcomes the announcement today by the Federal and Provincial governments and the City of Vaughan on the funding of $697.2 million and the reduction of development charges by 50 per cent for three years under the Development Charges Reduction Program (DCRP). This change will improve new housing project economic viability, resulting in increased housing supply and mix to meet the needs of growing communities, and will help support the hundreds of thousands of jobs in the residential and non-residential construction sectors in Ontario.
quotes.speaker: Dave Wilkes
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Vaughan

quotes.quote_text: Each year, farmers make careful decisions to prepare for the upcoming growing season, but extreme weather can disrupt even the best plans. When that happens, we are proud to stand with producers by providing the flexibility they need to make the best decisions for their operations and remain resilient in the face of uncertainty.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Helping Alberta farmers facing extreme moisture

quotes.quote_text: These extreme wet conditions demonstrate that one growing season can look very different from the next, making it difficult for farmers to predict what risks their operations may face. Our government is committed to advocating for producers to make sure they have access to tools and programs that are timely, reactive and help them manage business risk in times of stress and uncertainty.
quotes.speaker: Tara Sawyer
quotes.article_title: Helping Alberta farmers facing extreme moisture

quotes.quote_text: We know many producers are facing incredibly challenging conditions this year with record levels of moisture leaving some unable to access their fields and complete essential farming activities. We've heard directly from producers about the significant stress and uncertainty these circumstances create. AgriStability is designed to provide whole-farm protection during situations like this, helping producers manage the financial impacts of events that are beyond their control and supporting the long-term resilience of their operations.
quotes.speaker: Darryl Kay
quotes.article_title: Helping Alberta farmers facing extreme moisture

quotes.quote_text: The Cold Lake region has played an important role in Canada’s story for generations, from powering our economy to supporting our national defence. As our government responds to the realities of a rapidly changing world, there is an opportunity to build on the region’s strengths to create a stronger, more secure country, while creating good jobs and delivering lasting benefits for the people who call this region home. These investments will help ensure that Cold Lake and Cold Lake First Nations benefit from the opportunities ahead.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in Cold Lake’s energy and aviation sectors to build a stronger, more secure Canada

quotes.quote_text: The City of Cold Lake and Cold Lake First Nations are well positioned to help meet some of Canada’s most pressing economic and sovereignty needs. Our government is supporting them to realize that potential through infrastructure, skill development opportunities, and strategic investments. The federal funding announced today will advance Indigenous participation in resource development, provide spaces that strengthen specialized aviation training capacity, and help build a highly skilled workforce that can drive prosperity across Northeastern Alberta for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Matt Jeneroux
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in Cold Lake’s energy and aviation sectors to build a stronger, more secure Canada

quotes.quote_text: This investment represents an important step forward for Cold Lake First Nations and for the continued growth of Etthen Energy. For too long, our Nation has participated in resource development largely from the sidelines; Etthen is changing that by placing CLFN in a leading role and giving our Nation greater control over how its resources are developed. Access to capital is critical to advancing that vision and creating long-term economic benefits for our community. We thank PrairiesCan for supporting this important community economic development initiative.
quotes.speaker: Chief Kelsey Jacko
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in Cold Lake’s energy and aviation sectors to build a stronger, more secure Canada

quotes.quote_text: This investment from PrairiesCan is a strong vote of confidence in Cold Lake and in the important role our community will play in the future of Canada’s aviation and aerospace industry. As the proud home of 4 Wing Cold Lake, aviation is an integral part of our community’s history. This project builds on that foundation, and through strong partnerships, will help develop the skilled workforce our region and Canada’s aviation industry need to thrive well into the future.
quotes.speaker: Bob Mattice
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in Cold Lake’s energy and aviation sectors to build a stronger, more secure Canada

quotes.quote_text: Seniors are an important part of our social fabric, and we are committed to helping them live a secure and dignified retirement. The New Horizons for Seniors Program is helping seniors build stronger, more connected communities for all. Working in partnership with organizations like the South Granville Seniors Friendship Centre Society, we are ensuring that older persons can continue to share their knowledge and experience with the greater Vancouver community for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Stephanie McLean
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State McLean announces funding for 12 projects in Vancouver Granville through the New Horizons for Seniors Program

quotes.quote_text: Through the New Horizons for Seniors Program, the Government of Canada is providing a wide range of opportunities for seniors in Vancouver to participate in meaningful activities where they can share knowledge, skills and experience to the benefit of others.
quotes.speaker: Taleeb Noormohamed
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State McLean announces funding for 12 projects in Vancouver Granville through the New Horizons for Seniors Program

quotes.quote_text: Canada did not choose this trade conflict with the United States, but we will stand up for the workers, businesses and communities under pressure. For more than 35 years, Mercer Peace River has been an anchor of northern Alberta’s economy. This $20 million investment will help the mill modernize, compete and protect the good jobs that families across the region depend on as we build a stronger, more resilient Canadian economy.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Federal investment helps defend Alberta’s forest sector against U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s forest sector creates good jobs and drives economic growth in hundreds of communities across the country, including in Peace River. Our government is proud to invest in Mercer Peace River’s modernization, so the Canadian forest sector can not only survive but thrive, and become stronger, more competitive more resilient for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Federal investment helps defend Alberta’s forest sector against U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: The Mercer Peace River mill has been a cornerstone of the Peace region economy for more than three decades, and our government wants to see that continue. In addition to the federal investment, Alberta is providing $17.1 million in relief to help Mercer on their proven a path to viability. Innovation has long been the path to success in Alberta and Mercer is well positioned to transition to a new and diversified business model that will sustain its operations for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Todd Loewen
quotes.article_title: Federal investment helps defend Alberta’s forest sector against U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Mercer Peace River Pulp has anchored our regional economy for more than 30 years, supporting hundreds of local jobs and thousands more across Alberta's forest supply chain. As the MLA for Peace River, I welcome any investment that helps our mill modernize and stay competitive through a tough time for global trade. Our workers and our community deserve nothing less.
quotes.speaker: Dan Williams
quotes.article_title: Federal investment helps defend Alberta’s forest sector against U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Council for the County of Northern Lights has a strong and longstanding relationship with industry partners such as Mercer Peace River, and we recognize the tremendous socioeconomic benefits they bring to our region. The importance of today’s announcement cannot be overstated. It represents a significant investment in our region, our people, and our future, and we are proud to be part of this important milestone.
quotes.speaker: Terry Ungarian
quotes.article_title: Federal investment helps defend Alberta’s forest sector against U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Mercer Peace River plays an important role in northern Alberta’s forest products economy, and these investments are intended to improve the mill’s efficiency and competitiveness. This support will help us modernize important infrastructure while preparing the facility for potential future expansion of bioenergy production and carbon capture and storage. We appreciate the Government of Canada and PrairiesCan’s support, and I want to recognize our Peace River team for the work they continue to do to move these improvements
quotes.speaker: Juan Carlos Bueno
quotes.article_title: Federal investment helps defend Alberta’s forest sector against U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: We’re making historic investments in Hamilton to lower costs for families, keep workers on the job and get more homes built faster. Today’s investment will support new transportation and housing infrastructure across the city, enabling the construction of tens of thousands of new homes. Congratulations to Mayor Horwath and Hamilton City Council for demonstrating incredible leadership and working with us to bring the dream of home ownership in reach for Hamilton families.
quotes.speaker: Doug Ford
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Together, we’re building Ontario and Canada strong. By partnering with Ontario, the federal government is helping speed up housing construction by lowering up front costs and investing in housing-enabling infrastructure projects – building strong, resilient communities that boost housing supply and drive economic opportunities.
quotes.speaker: Wayne Long
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Canadian families are concerned about the cost of housing. The Government of Canada is working collaboratively with provinces, municipalities and homebuilders to directly reduce the price of new homes. Together, we are cutting government fees, getting more homes built, supporting thousands of good paying local homebuilding jobs, and investing in the roads, water, parks and other local infrastructure necessary for new development.
quotes.speaker: John-Paul Danko
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Across Ontario, there is a need for critical infrastructure and housing of all types to support our fast-growing communities. That is why our government continues to deliver programs like the Development Charge Reduction Program alongside our federal partners, which helps provide municipalities like Hamilton with the funding they need to ensure their city remains a desirable place to live, work and raise a family.
quotes.speaker: Rob Flack
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: This is a historic investment in Hamilton’s future and one I have worked hard as Mayor to make happen. It represents the single largest investment in roads, water and wastewater infrastructure in our city’s history, and I welcome the support of our provincial and federal partners. We know Hamilton needs more housing. That means creating the conditions to get more homes built, support local construction and get people back to work, while making housing more affordable for Hamiltonians. By eliminating residential development charges for three years and investing in the infrastructure our growing communities need, we can get shovels in the ground, increase housing supply and reduce costs for people looking to call Hamilton home.
quotes.speaker: Andrea Horwath
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement is a major win for Hamilton families, workers, and businesses. By eliminating residential development charges and investing in the infrastructure needed to support growth, we are removing barriers to build more homes and create opportunities for local workers. Through Premier Ford's leadership, our government is making it more attainable for people who work in Hamilton to build a future here and call our city home.
quotes.speaker: Monica Ciriello
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: By helping cut Development Charges in Hamilton, Ontario's government is protecting families and workers in Hamilton who are working to achieve the dream of home ownership. Tens of thousands of dollars will stay in workers’ pockets, while we simultaneously fund infrastructure the City of Hamilton needs to get more homes built. This is good news for local jobs and growth, supporting the growing population of the city.
quotes.speaker: Sam Oosterhoff
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Hamilton is a great place to live and raise a family, but the cost of delivering new housing has made it increasingly difficult to bring projects to market at prices buyers can afford. Today’s announcement tackles both sides of that challenge: lowering the cost of building while investing in the roads, water and wastewater infrastructure needed to support new communities. As a local builder, I know what a difference that can make in determining whether homes get built. This is a meaningful investment in Hamilton’s future and in the people and families who want to call this community home.
quotes.speaker: Dani Gabriele
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: This is exactly the kind of action Ontario’s housing market needs. Development charges have become one of the largest upfront costs of building a new home, and reducing them while investing directly in the infrastructure needed to support growth is a much more sustainable approach. Hamilton’s participation in the Development Charge Reduction Program will make a meaningful difference to project viability, housing affordability and the ability to get more shovels in the ground. We commend the governments of Ontario and Canada, and the City of Hamilton, for working together on a solution that lowers the cost of building while ensuring communities have the infrastructure they need to grow.
quotes.speaker: Scott Andison
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement is a significant and welcome step toward improving affordability, accelerating new housing supply and ensuring the infrastructure needed to support growing communities continues to be built. Just as importantly, these savings must reach homebuyers directly, not stop at the development stage. We welcome the strong consumer protections built into the program to ensure that happens. Cornerstone has consistently advocated to all levels of government to reduce development charges and remove barriers to attainable housing, and we are pleased to see governments working together to deliver meaningful action.
quotes.speaker: Sandra Longden
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: We’re making historic investments in Hamilton to lower costs for families, keep workers on the job and get more homes built faster. Today’s investment will support new transportation and housing infrastructure across the city, enabling the construction of tens of thousands of new homes. Congratulations to Mayor Horwath and Hamilton City Council for demonstrating incredible leadership and working with us to bring the dream of home ownership in reach for Hamilton families.
quotes.speaker: Doug Ford
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Together, we’re building Ontario and Canada strong. By partnering with Ontario, the federal government is helping speed up housing construction by lowering up front costs and investing in housing-enabling infrastructure projects – building strong, resilient communities that boost housing supply and drive economic opportunities.
quotes.speaker: Wayne Long
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Canadian families are concerned about the cost of housing. The Government of Canada is working collaboratively with provinces, municipalities and homebuilders to directly reduce the price of new homes. Together, we are cutting government fees, getting more homes built, supporting thousands of good paying local homebuilding jobs, and investing in the roads, water, parks and other local infrastructure necessary for new development.
quotes.speaker: John-Paul Danko
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Across Ontario, there is a need for critical infrastructure and housing of all types to support our fast-growing communities. That is why our government continues to deliver programs like the Development Charge Reduction Program alongside our federal partners, which helps provide municipalities like Hamilton with the funding they need to ensure their city remains a desirable place to live, work and raise a family.
quotes.speaker: Rob Flack
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: This is a historic investment in Hamilton’s future and one I have worked hard as Mayor to make happen. It represents the single largest investment in roads, water and wastewater infrastructure in our city’s history, and I welcome the support of our provincial and federal partners. We know Hamilton needs more housing. That means creating the conditions to get more homes built, support local construction and get people back to work, while making housing more affordable for Hamiltonians. By eliminating residential development charges for three years and investing in the infrastructure our growing communities need, we can get shovels in the ground, increase housing supply and reduce costs for people looking to call Hamilton home.
quotes.speaker: Andrea Horwath
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement is a major win for Hamilton families, workers, and businesses. By eliminating residential development charges and investing in the infrastructure needed to support growth, we are removing barriers to build more homes and create opportunities for local workers. Through Premier Ford's leadership, our government is making it more attainable for people who work in Hamilton to build a future here and call our city home.
quotes.speaker: Monica Ciriello
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: By helping cut Development Charges in Hamilton, Ontario's government is protecting families and workers in Hamilton who are working to achieve the dream of home ownership. Tens of thousands of dollars will stay in workers’ pockets, while we simultaneously fund infrastructure the City of Hamilton needs to get more homes built. This is good news for local jobs and growth, supporting the growing population of the city.
quotes.speaker: Sam Oosterhoff
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

Today’s announcement tackles both sides of that challenge: lowering the cost of building while investing in the roads, water and wastewater infrastructure needed to support new communities. As a local builder, I know what a difference that can make in determining whether homes get built. This is a meaningful investment in Hamilton’s future and in the people and families who want to call this community home.
quotes.speaker: Dani Gabriele
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: This is exactly the kind of action Ontario’s housing market needs. Development charges have become one of the largest upfront costs of building a new home, and reducing them while investing directly in the infrastructure needed to support growth is a much more sustainable approach. Hamilton’s participation in the Development Charge Reduction Program will make a meaningful difference to project viability, housing affordability and the ability to get more shovels in the ground. We commend the governments of Ontario and Canada, and the City of Hamilton, for working together on a solution that lowers the cost of building while ensuring communities have the infrastructure they need to grow.
quotes.speaker: Scott Andison
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement is a significant and welcome step toward improving affordability, accelerating new housing supply and ensuring the infrastructure needed to support growing communities continues to be built. Just as importantly, these savings must reach homebuyers directly, not stop at the development stage. We welcome the strong consumer protections built into the program to ensure that happens. Cornerstone has consistently advocated to all levels of government to reduce development charges and remove barriers to attainable housing, and we are pleased to see governments working together to deliver meaningful action.
quotes.speaker: Sandra Longden
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario making homes more affordable in Hamilton

quotes.quote_text: Local and regional airports are lifelines for many communities across British Columbia. These investments will help maintain safe and efficient airport operations, improve the movement of people and goods, and strengthen the transportation links that connect British Columbians to jobs, services, and the rest of the country. By investing in our airports, we are building a stronger and more resilient Canada.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada Invests over $23.5 Million to Strengthen B.C. Airports and Keep Communities Connected

quotes.quote_text: This investment from Transport Canada is critical to the continued operation and future growth of our airport. Without this funding, we would be unable to make the necessary improvements needed to support our community’s economic development and its role within the national economy.
quotes.speaker: Antonio Vera
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada Invests over $23.5 Million to Strengthen B.C. Airports and Keep Communities Connected

quotes.quote_text: We are honoured to work alongside Prince Rupert Airport Authority, the City, and Transport Canada on this important project. Through thoughtful planning and design, our team is helping deliver modern airfield infrastructure that strengthens airport operations, improves safety, and supports the long-term connectivity of Northern British Columbia.
quotes.speaker: Peter Hatcher
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada Invests over $23.5 Million to Strengthen B.C. Airports and Keep Communities Connected

quotes.quote_text: Countries around the world are moving quickly to build their own space capabilities, and Canada cannot afford to be left behind. Space is becoming more important to our economy, our security and our sovereignty. By investing in NordSpace, we are helping build Canadian launch capacity, attract private investment to Newfoundland and Labrador and create highly skilled jobs in a global industry expected to reach $2 trillion by 2040.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.speaker_title: P.C., K.C., Member, Minister, we are supporting a project that will create high-skilled jobs, attract private-sector investment, - The Honourable Lin Paddock, Minister, Growth and Rural Development, from Canadian soil, predict wildfires, connect remote communities, -, Rahul Goel, Founder and CEO
quotes.article_title: $10M investment advances Canada’s sovereign space-launch capacity in Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: By working with partners such as the Nature Conservancy of Canada, we are helping to protect the natural environment in Newfoundland and Labrador and across Canada. Federal investments through programs like the Natural Heritage Conservation Program have helped conserve important habitats, protect species, and strengthen ecosystems, while bringing us closer to our goal of conserving 30% of Canada’s lands and waters by 2030.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Canada, Nature Conservancy of Canada and Teck Resources Limited partner to conserve 1,600 hectares in Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: The Beothuk Lake Nature Reserve is a great example of what can be accomplished when strong partnerships come together to deliver lasting conservation results and protect nature for future generations. By protecting 1,600 hectares of boreal forests, wetlands and important fish habitat, we are helping safeguard the ecosystems and species that make Newfoundland and Labrador unique. Canada is home to some of the world’s most significant natural landscapes, and partnerships like this are essential to conserving them for future generations.
quotes.speaker: Nathalie Provost
quotes.article_title: Canada, Nature Conservancy of Canada and Teck Resources Limited partner to conserve 1,600 hectares in Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: This partnership has helped protect 1,600 hectares of boreal forest, wetlands and river habitat within one of Newfoundland’s most important watersheds. NCC’s work now turns to developing a long-term stewardship plan that will help sustain salmon, wildlife and the communities connected to this landscape. This is what’s possible when industry, government and communities decide together that a place is worth protecting.
quotes.speaker: Piers Evans
quotes.article_title: Canada, Nature Conservancy of Canada and Teck Resources Limited partner to conserve 1,600 hectares in Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: Through the legacy of Teck’s Duck Pond operation, this investment helped transform a unique conservation opportunity into permanent protection for a landscape that is deeply important to the people of central Newfoundland, its forests, its waterways and the salmon that have sustained local communities for generations. We’re proud to support the Nature Conservancy of Canada and its partners, and to ensure that the benefits created by Duck Pond continue through lasting conservation outcomes for the province.
quotes.speaker: Brock Gill
quotes.speaker_title: Senior Vice President, Operations, North America, Teck
quotes.article_title: Canada, Nature Conservancy of Canada and Teck Resources Limited partner to conserve 1,600 hectares in Newfoundland and Labrador

quotes.quote_text: I’ve had the chance to see Cape Breton’s strong and vibrant performing arts community firsthand on many occasions. Local presenters and festivals bring people together, showcase our incredible artists and contribute to a strong local economy. By supporting them, we’re helping more people experience the arts while strengthening the communities that make Cape Breton such a special place to live and visit.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports live arts and cultural experiences across Cape Breton

quotes.quote_text: Cape Breton audiences know the value of great live performances, and these organizations consistently deliver memorable cultural experiences for our communities. I’m pleased to see federal support for such a diverse range of programming, from jazz and seasonal performances to the presentation series at Highland Arts Theatre and the Savoy Theatre. These investments help ensure that Cape Breton remains a place where artists can thrive and audiences can enjoy exceptional live arts close to home.
quotes.speaker: Mike Kelloway
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports live arts and cultural experiences across Cape Breton

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today's investment in a new road as well as water and wastewater infrastructure in Antigonish County will help address the need for more affordable housing in the area.
quotes.speaker: Jaime Battiste
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in water and wastewater infrastructure in the Municipality of the County of Antigonish

quotes.quote_text: We are grateful for this federal investment, which recognizes the important role infrastructure plays in supporting growth in our community. The new road, sidewalk, and expanded municipal services will help enable 150 much-needed residential units, including affordable and supportive housing. This investment helps address a significant housing need while creating new opportunities for development in our community.
quotes.speaker: Warden Nicholas MacInnis
quotes.speaker_title: Municipality of the County of Antigonish
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in water and wastewater infrastructure in the Municipality of the County of Antigonish

quotes.quote_text: This announcement provides the fundamental infrastructure needed to forge ahead with the Sugarloaf project; creating desperately needed capacity in affordable housing in Antigonish County. This is a rapidly expanding community and we know how important it is to have the infrastructure to support this growth. Along with our architect partners, we have done the due diligence to plan this work correctly. We are grateful for the Building Communities Strong Fund to enable us to start with a strong foundation.
quotes.speaker: Terry MacIsaac
quotes.speaker_title: Board Chair, Antigonish Affordable Housing Society
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in water and wastewater infrastructure in the Municipality of the County of Antigonish

quotes.quote_text: We are committed to supporting Indigenous-led initiatives that drive economic growth and food security. Through this project, we are honouring the traditions and knowledge of the Inuvialuit community while fostering a sustainable future that celebrates and preserves their unique identity and way of life. It's a testament to the power of collaboration between the Government of Canada and Indigenous communities to build a more resilient and prosperous future for the North.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Indigenous-led effort to create reindeer herd agribusiness in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region

quotes.quote_text: For nearly a century, the Mackenzie Delta reindeer herd has been an important source of food, opportunity, and connection for Inuvialuit families. This investment ensures the continued success of a vital cultural practice by advancing the community's vision for a self-sustaining agribusiness that will strengthen northern food security and Indigenous economic development. Our government is proud to support this initiative and continue our work in partnership with Inuvialuit to promote self-determination, long-term prosperity, and ensure this unique northern tradition thrives for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Alty
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Indigenous-led effort to create reindeer herd agribusiness in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region

quotes.quote_text: For Inuvialuit, food security is about more than access to food — it is about our right to make decisions for ourselves, to strengthen our communities and to carry forward the knowledge and practices that have sustained us for generations. This investment supports Inuvialuit-led solutions that build food sovereignty, create opportunity and help ensure our people can continue to rely on healthy, local and culturally important foods now and into the future.
quotes.speaker: Jordan McLeod
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Indigenous-led effort to create reindeer herd agribusiness in the Inuvialuit Settlement Region

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is committed to supporting businesses and workers across southern Ontario as they address challenges related to tariffs, supply chains, and changing trade conditions. Today’s investment for these five businesses in Etobicoke, through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative, will help strengthen local supply chains, support workers, and build long‑term prosperity to ensure we are building a strong Canadian economy.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Etobicoke businesses to drive growth and boost competitiveness

quotes.quote_text: Etobicoke is home to a dynamic and hardworking business community. Today’s announcement will help local companies expand, create jobs, and continue contributing to the economic strength of our region. I’m happy to see our government supporting innovation and growth right here in Etobicoke.
quotes.speaker: James Maloney
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Etobicoke businesses to drive growth and boost competitiveness

quotes.quote_text: FedDev Ontario’s support enables SWTCH to deploy our technology across new Canadian market segments while accelerating our strategic growth abroad. Expanding in these key areas empowers SWTCH to achieve its full potential as a leading Canadian EV solutions provider.
quotes.speaker: Carter Li
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Etobicoke businesses to drive growth and boost competitiveness

quotes.quote_text: In a more uncertain world, Canada is investing in our greatest strengths: our people, our innovation and our capacity to compete. Kardium and Evonik’s projects will position them as industry leaders and strengthen Canada and British Columbia’s position as a global hub for advanced manufacturing and life sciences. By investing in these projects, we are creating good jobs for Canadians, strengthening our economic sovereignty and bringing Canadian innovation to global markets.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces over $99 million investment in Canada’s life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: British Columbia is increasingly establishing itself as a driving force behind Canadian innovation, with the talent, ambitious businesses and world-class ideas needed to sustain that momentum. This investment by the Government of Canada will strengthen B.C.’s position as a global hub for innovation and advanced manufacturing, creating good jobs, attracting further investment and helping Canadian companies grow, compete and succeed on the world stage.
quotes.speaker: Wade Grant
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces over $99 million investment in Canada’s life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: From advanced manufacturing and life-sciences to forestry and agri-food production, B.C.'s businesses have always been resilient, innovative, and ready to adapt to change. That is why the Government of Canada is stepping up with investments like the one today – to help these businesses build more resilient supply chains, grow productivity, and open doors to new markets.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces over $99 million investment in Canada’s life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: With unprecedented attacks on our sovereignty, it’s never been more important to support the Canadian companies and researchers that are solving real world health challenges, creating jobs, and making life better for people here at home. Through British Columbia's Look West strategy, we have a 10-year goal to double the number of jobs in B.C.’s life sciences sector to 40,000, and to boost its economic impact by 75%, and this is another positive step forward in that goal.
quotes.speaker: Adrian Dix
quotes.speaker_title: British Columbia Minister of Jobs and Economic Growth
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces over $99 million investment in Canada’s life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: This investment marks a significant milestone in Evonik’s commitment to pharmaceutical innovation. The new manufacturing facility will expand our ability to help customers bring life-changing lipid-based therapies to patients faster and at a larger scale. The expansion builds on Vancouver Labs’ long-standing expertise and strengthens our position in a leading life sciences ecosystem. We are grateful to the Canadian government for its support and recognition of the important role these therapies play in shaping the future of medicine.
quotes.speaker: Guido Skudlarek
quotes.speaker_title: head of Evonik’s Health Care business line
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces over $99 million investment in Canada’s life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: Kardium is proud to be developing and manufacturing our innovative medical technology here in British Columbia. The Government of Canada’s investment is an important step in our continued growth and will help us expand our manufacturing capabilities as we bring our technology to more physicians and patients around the world.
quotes.speaker: Kevin Chaplin
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Joly announces over $99 million investment in Canada’s life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: At a time when parts of the world are turning away from science, Canada is doubling down. Attracting top talent will deliver breakthroughs that improve Canadians’ lives and advance Canada’s position as a global leader in science and innovation. By expanding Canada’s talent pipeline and research capacity in areas that are vital to our prosperity and sovereignty, we are helping build the strongest economy in the G7.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces results for Intake 1 of the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders

quotes.quote_text: Canada benefits from one of the strongest research ecosystems in the world. Last fall, we announced $1.7 billion to bring the best researchers, scientists and world-leading talents to Canada, and we have already started to welcome them. We are creating a conducive environment where innovation moves at the speed patients need.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces results for Intake 1 of the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders

quotes.quote_text: Through the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders programs, we are attracting world-class talent whose work will generate new ideas, technologies and evidence to help address complex challenges. These investments will strengthen Canada’s research capacity, support the next generation of leaders and deliver practical solutions that improve the quality of life for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces results for Intake 1 of the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders

quotes.quote_text: Canada is a place where ambitious researchers can build exceptional teams and pursue transformative ideas. These investments are creating the conditions for researchers to put down roots, build deep connections and contribute their expertise, delivering lasting benefits to Canada for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Karim Bardeesy
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces results for Intake 1 of the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders

quotes.quote_text: Canada is already home to world-class health research, and attracting exceptional researchers from around the world helps us build on that strength. By bringing new expertise, perspectives and ideas into our research ecosystem, we are strengthening our capacity to address complex health challenges and translate discoveries into better health and care for people across Canada.
quotes.speaker: Maggie Chi
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces results for Intake 1 of the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders

quotes.quote_text: Research excellence thrives when different ideas, disciplines and perspectives come together. By attracting leading researchers across a wide range of fields, we are creating new opportunities for collaboration, strengthening Canada’s research community and building the connections that can lead to the discoveries of tomorrow.
quotes.speaker: Wade Grant
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces results for Intake 1 of the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders

quotes.quote_text: These exceptional researchers are tackling complex challenges and generating knowledge that will help strengthen communities, inform decision-making and improve the lives of people across Canada. I have no doubt the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders programs will help cement Canada’s place as a world leader in key research fields—from AI to biotechnology and beyond. We are proud to support these world-class researchers and are confident their innovative work will translate into concrete economic and social benefits for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Normand Labrie
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces results for Intake 1 of the Eddie Goldenberg Research Chairs of Canada and Canada Impact+ Emerging Leaders

quotes.quote_text: Our government is committed to standing up for Canadian workers, farmers, families, and businesses during these difficult times. With these dollar-for-dollar, rate for rate counter-tariffs as well as our multi-billion dollar support package, we are protecting them as we continue our work to build a stronger, more resilient, and more diversified Canadian economy.
quotes.speaker: Wayne Long
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada highlights targeted countermeasures and substantive support for workers and businesses in response to U.S. tariffs in Sarnia

quotes.quote_text: While Canada did not choose this trade conflict, our government is responding swiftly to provide a level playing field to our businesses. We are also moving forward with support measures to help our workers, businesses and families during these challenging times.
quotes.speaker: Marilyn Gladu
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada highlights targeted countermeasures and substantive support for workers and businesses in response to U.S. tariffs in Sarnia

quotes.quote_text: Canadians expect a justice system that keeps communities safe and helps prevent future crime. This investment supports an Indigenous-led approach that promotes accountability and rehabilitation while connecting individuals with the tools, services and cultural supports they need to make positive changes in their lives. Through collaboration with justice and community partners, the MKO Gladue Pathways to Healing Initiative will help reduce reoffending and contribute to safer communities across Manitoba.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Chartrand
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces funding for Indigenous-led alternatives to incarceration in Manitoba

quotes.quote_text: This investment is an important step toward addressing the unacceptable overrepresentation of Indigenous Peoples in the criminal justice system. The MKO Gladue Pathways to Healing Initiative will advance First Nations-led solutions that recognize the impacts of colonialism and trauma while supporting accountability and healing. By grounding justice services in trauma-informed, culturally responsive approaches, we can help our citizens reconnect with culture, family, and community and pursue a meaningful path forward.
quotes.speaker: Grand
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces funding for Indigenous-led alternatives to incarceration in Manitoba

quotes.quote_text: The opening of CANXPORT is a major step forward for Canada's export network. By creating new capacity at the Port of Prince Rupert, this facility will help Canadian products reach customers around the world more efficiently and reliably. Investments like this strengthen our transportation system, support businesses and workers, and help position Canada to seize new trade opportunities in a changing global economy.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada marks the grand opening of the CANXPORT facility

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s resources and workers are our strengths in an uncertain world – and attracting the investments that allow us to turn those strengths into long-term prosperity, security and climate action is how we are building Canada Strong. I congratulate Glencore, Ontario, and every worker, contractor, and company along the supply chain who have helped us reach today’s milestone. We are giving ourselves more – more jobs, opportunities, and ambition – than anyone can take away.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Canada attracts a $2 billion mining investment in Sudbury’s Craig Mine

quotes.quote_text: Climate action and economic strength go hand in hand. By supporting the development and adoption of cleaner industrial technologies, our federal government is giving Canadian businesses the tools they need to reduce emissions, compete globally, and lead in the industries of tomorrow.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Canada attracts a $2 billion mining investment in Sudbury’s Craig Mine

quotes.quote_text: Sudbury has helped build Canada for generations, and our government is making sure it remains at the heart of Canada’s economic future. By supporting projects like Onaping Depth, we are creating good jobs here at home, strengthening our domestic supply chains and putting Canadian resources and Canadian workers at the centre of a stronger, more independent economy. At a time when Canada must be more resilient and more in control of its economic future, Sudbury is once again leading the way.
quotes.speaker: Viviane Lapointe
quotes.article_title: Canada attracts a $2 billion mining investment in Sudbury’s Craig Mine

quotes.quote_text: The Onaping Depth Project at Craig Mine reflects Glencore Canada's commitment to advanced automation, remote operations, battery-electric mining technology, and modern safety systems. Most importantly, this project is the result of millions of hours put in by thousands of employees and contractors, safely, that establishes a blueprint for the next generation of sustainable and technologically advanced mining operations here in Ontario and across Canada.
quotes.speaker: Peter Xavier
quotes.article_title: Canada attracts a $2 billion mining investment in Sudbury’s Craig Mine

quotes.quote_text: British Columbians are feeling the effects of this trade uncertainty, and we need to hear directly from the workers, businesses and industries on the front lines. Their insights will help ensure our response reflects the realities businesses are facing. The federal government is stepping up with new support to help workers, families, and businesses navigate these challenges while strengthening Canada’s long-term economic resilience.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Minister Robertson convenes tariff response meeting with B.C. industry leaders to discuss ongoing U.S. trade situation

quotes.quote_text: Today is a great day for Nipigon Bay, the Great Lakes, and freshwater in Canada. The delisting of Nipigon Bay as an Area of Concern reflects decades of dedicated work by our government and partners to restore water quality, habitats, and ecosystem health. By working together, we have transformed a once-degraded area into a healthier ecosystem that will benefit local communities, Indigenous people and future generations. It shows that environmental restoration is possible when governments and communities work toward common goals.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Ministers Dabrusin and Hajdu announce successful restoration of Nipigon Bay

quotes.quote_text: For nearly 40 years, local partners, Indigenous communities, and different levels of government worked to bring Nipigon Bay back to health. A healthier bay means a healthier lake with a better ecosystem for all. That’s how you build a strong Canada - determined and sustainable action that leaves a cleaner, healthier future for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Ministers Dabrusin and Hajdu announce successful restoration of Nipigon Bay

quotes.quote_text: Returning Nipigon Bay in Northern Ontario to a vibrant, healthy ecosystem is a major conservation victory made possible through the dedicated efforts of our two governments, along with the many Great Lakes partners and local residents who supported this work. By working together to restore the health of the Great Lakes - we are delivering on our promise to protect Ontario and support the resilience of our communities and local economies for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Todd McCarthy
quotes.speaker_title: Ontario Minister of the Environment, Conservation and Parks
quotes.article_title: Ministers Dabrusin and Hajdu announce successful restoration of Nipigon Bay

quotes.quote_text: Since time immemorial, the lands and waters of Nipigon Bay have sustained my people and remain an important part of who we are. After nearly four decades of work to restore the bay and address the impacts of industry, we are seeing the results through cleaner water, restored habitat, and stronger, healthier fish communities. Today is an important milestone, but our responsibility to these lands and waters does not end with the removal of this designation. Red Rock Indian Band will continue to protect and care for Nipigon Bay, ensuring these lands and waters remain clean, healthy, and capable of sustaining our people for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Chief Allan Odawa
quotes.article_title: Ministers Dabrusin and Hajdu announce successful restoration of Nipigon Bay

quotes.quote_text: Together with leadership, Canadian Tire Jumpstart Charities, kids and community members, we’re celebrating Beardy’s & Okemasis’ Cree Nation’s 150th Treaty Day, marking an important milestone and investing in the next generation through sport. From local matches to dreams of playing on the world stage, this free-to-use community soccer pitch will give local kids a new place to play outside, participate in sport and build a lifelong connection to the game, from the playground to the podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports soccer in Beardy’s & Okemasis’ Cree Nation

quotes.quote_text: Meaningful investment in community sport infrastructure helps ensure more children and youth can experience the confidence, connection and sense of belonging that come through play. We’re grateful to Sport Canada and Beardy’s & Okemasis’ Cree Nation for their partnership in advancing this new community soccer pitch, and we’re honoured to celebrate the community’s 150th Treaty Day as we make this announcement together.
quotes.speaker: Marco Di Buono
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports soccer in Beardy’s & Okemasis’ Cree Nation

quotes.quote_text: This project represents much more than a soccer field. It is an investment in our children, families and future generations. The grand opening of this pitch is an opportunity to celebrate what can be achieved when partners work together to create meaningful opportunities for our youth.
quotes.speaker: Chief Edwin Ananas
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports soccer in Beardy’s & Okemasis’ Cree Nation

quotes.quote_text: Small craft harbours are often the lifeblood of coastal communities. Harvesters need infrastructure they can count on, and the work at 4th Street Harbour gives the Tofino fleet a safer, more reliable place to tie up and land a catch. I want to thank the Tofino Harbour Authority and the harbour users who worked around the construction while it was underway.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada completes small craft harbour improvements in Tofino, British Columbia

quotes.quote_text: In response to President Trump’s latest tariffs, our government is doing everything we can to lower costs for families, keep workers on the job and get shovels in the ground faster on new homes. Today’s investment will support infrastructure projects that enable the construction of tens of thousands of new homes, creating good-paying jobs and make the dream of homeownership a reality for families in Bradford West Gwillimbury.
quotes.speaker: Doug Ford
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Bradford West Gwillimbury

quotes.quote_text: Together, we’re building Ontario and Canada strong. By partnering with Ontario, the federal government is helping speed up housing construction by lowering up front costs and investing in housing-enabling infrastructure projects — building strong, resilient communities that boost housing supply and drive economic opportunities.
quotes.speaker: Jennifer McKelvie
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Bradford West Gwillimbury

quotes.quote_text: Across Ontario there is a need for critical infrastructure and housing of all types to support our fast-growing communities. That is why our government continues to deliver programs like the Development Charge Reduction Program alongside our federal partners, which helps provide municipalities like Bradford West Gwillimbury with the funding they need to ensure their city remains a desirable place to live, work and raise a family. Congratulations to Mayor Leduc and the Bradford West Gwillimbury Town Council for demonstrating incredible leadership and working with us to bring the dream of homeownership with reach for more Bradford West Gwillimbury families.
quotes.speaker: Rob Flack
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Bradford West Gwillimbury

quotes.quote_text: This partnership is a major investment in BWG ’s future. The $ 94.8 milli on funding will allow us to develop the water, road, and fire infrastructure our growing community needs for responsible growth. We thank the Province of Ontario and the Government of Canada for their continued partnership and commitment to Bradford West Gwillimbury.
quotes.speaker: James Leduc
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Bradford West Gwillimbury

quotes.quote_text: Investments like this are exactly what municipalities need right now. At a time of global uncertainty, Ontario will continue to protect this province by providing infrastructure investments that support the workers and businesses that truly drive our economy forward. The $94.8 millio n in infrastructure funding for Bradford West Gwillimbury will help unlock new housing development while supporting the creation of good-paying jobs. Together, we can make homeownership more attainable for young families.
quotes.speaker: Dawn Gallagher Murphy
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Bradford West Gwillimbury

quotes.quote_text: The Building Industry and Land Development Association applauds all three levels of government for working together on an infrastructure investment solution that will support homes and employment opportunities in the growing community of Bradford West Gwillimbury. This is exciting news for local jobs and growth, while supporting new homebuyers, and helping to assist project viability. The Ontario government is again standing by their commitment to protect families and workers with this significant and meaningful investment for the sustainable future of the people and communities of Bradford West Gwillimbury.
quotes.speaker: Dave Wilkes
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario Making Homes More Affordable in Bradford West Gwillimbury

quotes.quote_text: Investments in cybersecurity help strengthen Canada’s economy by supporting innovation, collaboration and the development of skilled talent. By supporting the PST Cybersecurity Summit 2026, we are helping bring together experts from across sectors to share knowledge, advance research and strengthen Canada’s growing cybersecurity ecosystem.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Federal investment strengthens cybersecurity collaboration and innovation in Atlantic Canada

quotes.quote_text: Fredericton has earned a strong reputation as a centre of excellence for cybersecurity research and innovation. The PST Cybersecurity Summit 2026 brought together experts, researchers, businesses and students to share knowledge and build relationships that support the continued growth of this important sector in our community and across Atlantic Canada.
quotes.speaker: David Myles
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Secretary to the Prime Minister and Member
quotes.article_title: Federal investment strengthens cybersecurity collaboration and innovation in Atlantic Canada

quotes.quote_text: CIC’s annual Cybersecurity Summit brought together leading experts to explore how cybersecurity and AI are reshaping our digital future. Strengthening Canada’s capabilities in these areas is essential to our national security, economic prosperity, and global competitiveness.
quotes.speaker: Ali Ghorbani
quotes.article_title: Federal investment strengthens cybersecurity collaboration and innovation in Atlantic Canada
