quotes.article_title: Secretary of State McLean announces funding for Alberta seniors

quotes.quote_text: Canada needs a strong and highly skilled workforce to meet the growing challenges posed by extreme weather and a changing climate. By supporting students pursuing studies in meteorology and atmospheric science, we are helping develop the talent and expertise that will shape the future of weather forecasting and warning services across the country. I look forward to seeing the positive impacts this year’s recipients will make.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Investing in Canada’s next generation of meteorologists

quotes.quote_text: Growing up in Saint-Jean-sur-Richelieu, I developed a passion for meteorology that I was able to combine with my interests in electronics and video production. This scholarship will allow me to dedicate more time to my studies in atmospheric sciences and support personal research projects that advance my understanding of weather forecasting.
quotes.speaker: Eddie Pelletier
quotes.speaker_title: Environment and Climate Change Canada Meteorology Award recipient and Université du Québec à Montréal student
quotes.article_title: Investing in Canada’s next generation of meteorologists

quotes.quote_text: Investing in the Wildseed Centre means investing in Black artists, communities, and a space where people can come together, create and share their stories. By making the Centre more accessible and improving its facilities, we are contributing to a strong cultural life in Toronto and across Canada, while supporting Wildseed’s important work to address anti-Black racism and foster inclusion.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Wildseed Centre for Art & Activism in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: The Wildseed Centre for Art & Activism nurtures the creative expression of artists from diverse backgrounds. Our government values diversity and creativity, and this investment will further support the development of artistic expression driven by Black communities. Moreover, it will provide an opportunity to all Canadians to better appreciate the richness of our arts and cultural heritage, which is an essential part of our shared identity.
quotes.speaker: Madeleine Chenette
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Wildseed Centre for Art & Activism in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Nestled in the heart of the historic neighborhood of The Black Grange, the Wildseed Centre for Art & Activism, a vessel that seeks to nurture Black Creativity and experimentation, stands tall. At 10,000 square feet, this historic building and hub for art and activism birthed by Black Lives Matter artivists, whose hope of building an enduring space that cultivates transformative and radical ideas announces, and with deep gratitude funding awarded to our organization from the Canada Cultural Spaces Fund. With this support, we can continue to provide this incredible incubator, this container, this space that holds dreams and helps them flourish, into several generations into the future. We look forward to celebrating this announcement with Parliamentary Secretary Madeline Chenette and MP Martin.
quotes.speaker: Ravyn Wngz
quotes.speaker_title: Interim Executive Director of programming and Co-founder of Black Lives Matter - Canada and the Wildseed Centre for Art & Activism
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Wildseed Centre for Art & Activism in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Since its launch last year, the Canada Disability Benefit has helped support the financial security of hundreds of thousands of working-age Canadians with disabilities. This new supplemental payment will help cover the cost of getting the disability tax credit, so more people can access the support they are entitled to. We are breaking down barriers so more Canadians can get the help they need, building a Canada where no one is left behind.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Supplemental Canada Disability Benefit payments to begin in September

quotes.quote_text: The Great Lakes are vital to Canada’s economy, our communities and our security. With the CCGS Judy LaMarsh , we are strengthening the Canadian Coast Guard’s ability to keep these waters safe and open year-round. This vessel will give Coast Guard crews another important tool to deliver for Canadians across the region — from icebreaking and maintaining navigation routes to supporting safe and reliable maritime operations.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Canadian Coast Guard welcomes first additional large vessel on the Great Lakes in over thirty years

quotes.quote_text: Through the National Shipbuilding Strategy, the Government of Canada is equipping the Canadian Coast Guard with the modern ships needed to carry out vital operations right across the country. The CCGS Judy LaMarsh is a major asset in maintaining safe and accessible waterways in the Great Lakes, St. Lawrence Seaway, and Atlantic Canada. Its return to service following conversion and refit work at Newdock St. John’s Dockyard Limited is a great example of how Canada is strengthening its world-class knowledge and expertise in shipbuilding, offering opportunities for Canadian shipyards, creating skilled jobs, and reinvigorating domestic supply chains.
quotes.speaker: Joël Lightbound
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Public Works and Procurement and Quebec Lieutenant
quotes.article_title: Canadian Coast Guard welcomes first additional large vessel on the Great Lakes in over thirty years

quotes.quote_text: The Canadian Coast Guard Ship Judy LaMarsh is an important addition to our fleet. The capable and multipurpose vessel will provide a wide range of services and bolster our year-round, essential operations across one of the busiest maritime environments in Canada, safeguarding our waters and economy, and supporting our sovereignty.
quotes.speaker: Kevin Brosseau
quotes.article_title: Canadian Coast Guard welcomes first additional large vessel on the Great Lakes in over thirty years

quotes.quote_text: Community organisations are at the heart of Canada's HIV response, helping to reach those most affected by HIV. Providing safe, reliable, and confidential HIV screening helps reduce barriers to care caused by stigma and discrimination. Together with partners, stakeholders, community organisations, and leaders, we will continue to put people first and enhance culturally-safe access to testing, treatment and care for HIV.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands access to HIV self-testing and peer support services

quotes.quote_text: Scientific advances have transformed HIV treatment, making it possible for people living with HIV to live long and healthy lives. But knowing your HIV status remains the essential first step to accessing treatment, care and support. By expanding access to HIV self-test kits and community-based peer support, this investment will help more people receive an earlier diagnosis, and connect with the treatment and prevention services that meet their needs—particularly in communities most affected by HIV.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Joss Reimer
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands access to HIV self-testing and peer support services

quotes.quote_text: As a physician, I know that early diagnosis and treatment can make an enormous difference in a person's health and quality of life. Yet too many people continue to face barriers to HIV testing, including stigma, discrimination, and limited access to health-care services. By expanding access to self-testing and strengthening peer support, we can make it easier for people to know their status and connect with the care and support they need. Community organizations are at the heart of this work, and I am proud that our government is supporting their efforts to reach people where they are, in Manitoba and across Canada.
quotes.speaker: Doug Eyolfson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands access to HIV self-testing and peer support services

quotes.quote_text: Expanding access to HIV self-testing is an important and practical way to help Canadians take charge of their health and connect with care on their own terms without shame or stigma. This investment will help strengthen the work of trusted community organizations and peer-support networks across the country, helping make testing more available and accessible for the people and communities who need it the most.
quotes.speaker: Senator Kristopher Wells
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands access to HIV self-testing and peer support services

quotes.quote_text: Everyone deserves access to HIV testing, treatment and care without stigma or judgment. This investment is good news and will help trusted community organizations reach more people and break down barriers to care, particularly in rural, northern and underserved communities. But we know there is much more work to do. We will continue to take action here in Manitoba and advocate for strong federal partnership and investment so that everyone living with or at risk of HIV can get the prevention, testing, treatment and care they need.
quotes.speaker: Uzoma Asagwara
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Seniors and Long-Term Care for Manitoba
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands access to HIV self-testing and peer support services

quotes.quote_text: Expanding access to HIV self tests and peer support services will help improve access to low barrier testing modes, particularly in rural, remote, and Northern communities where stigma has the greatest impact on access to testing and linkage to care for HIV. Putting tools in the hands of trusted community based organisations will support meaningful engagement while providing opportunities to reduce stigma through education and knowledge sharing.
quotes.speaker: Shohan Illsley
quotes.speaker_title: Executive Director, Manitoba Harm Reduction Network
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands access to HIV self-testing and peer support services

quotes.quote_text: Our grape growers work incredibly hard. By supporting the right technology, we help safeguard the crops that support our communities and local economies. Investing in Vivid Machine Inc.’s smart imaging tools will help producers be more resilient so they can continue growing the top-quality grapes that Canadians, and the world, love.
quotes.speaker: The
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in machine learning technology to improve crop management and disease detection in vineyards

quotes.quote_text: Growing top-quality grapes takes skill and determination. Canadian grape growers have shown their resilience time and time again in the face of challenges, from crop diseases and unpredictable weather to shifting markets and yields. This investment in crop monitoring technology will give them the insights they need to protect their vineyards and keep our grape and wine sector thriving.
quotes.speaker: Karim Bardeesy
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in machine learning technology to improve crop management and disease detection in vineyards

quotes.quote_text: This $1.69M investment from the Government of Canada through the AgriScience Program is a vote of confidence in Canadian-made innovation. It allows us to take the computer vision technology we've built for apple growers and adapt it to tackle some of the toughest challenges facing grape growers such as crop load estimation, and early disease detection. It also means we can keep growing our team right here in Toronto, building the kind of high-skilled agtech jobs that keep Ontario at the forefront of precision agriculture.
quotes.speaker: Jenny Lemieux
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in machine learning technology to improve crop management and disease detection in vineyards

quotes.quote_text: The Royal George Theatre is an important part of Niagara-on-the-Lake and a place where generations of Canadians and visitors from around the world have come together to enjoy great performances. This investment will help ensure this cherished theatre can continue to entertain and inspire audiences for years to come. I’m proud that the federal government is helping preserve a cultural institution that means so much to our community.
quotes.speaker: Chris Bittle
quotes.article_title: Canada invests in rebuilding the historic Royal George Theatre in Niagara-on-the-Lake

quotes.quote_text: Strong communities are created when they are able to bring people together. We are deeply grateful to the Government of Canada for recognizing the essential role the arts play in strengthening such communities and deepening real, human connection. This extraordinary investment through the Build Communities Strong Fund will help create a new Royal George Theatre that honours the site’s wonderful and varied history while setting a new standard for accessibility and environment sustainability. More than a theatre, the new Royal George will be a place where communities come together to connect, engage and be inspired.
quotes.speaker: Tim Jennings
quotes.article_title: Canada invests in rebuilding the historic Royal George Theatre in Niagara-on-the-Lake

quotes.quote_text: Canada is the best sport-hosting nation in the world. As we celebrate 2026 as Canada’s Year of Sport, we continue to welcome the world, highlighting the very best of Canada, boosting local tourism, strengthening our economy, and cheering on Canadian athletes, right here at home. It builds on our legacy, brings communities together, and supports the next generation, from playground to podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces support to strengthen sport hosting in Canada

quotes.quote_text: Water is life-giving, irreplaceable, and fundamental to public safety and economic security. Healthy freshwater ecosystems are vital to sustaining Canada and all who call it home. These investments will support local action to protect and restore this culturally and economically significant waterbody in Canada—advancing shared stewardship and safeguarding our fresh water for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Wade Grant
quotes.article_title: PS Grant Highlights Launch of Public Engagement on Canada’s National Water Security Strategy and Announces New Projects to Protect the Fraser River

quotes.quote_text: As one of the youngest members of Parliament, I know the decisions we make on water today are ones my generation will live with the longest. That is a responsibility I take seriously. This investment, and the national water strategy Canadians can now help shape, is how we protect the Fraser before problems become harder and more costly to fix.
quotes.speaker: Jake Sawatzky
quotes.article_title: PS Grant Highlights Launch of Public Engagement on Canada’s National Water Security Strategy and Announces New Projects to Protect the Fraser River

quotes.quote_text: In Richmond, our history, our livelihoods, and our responsibilities all flow from the Fraser River. Everything that happens upstream ends up at our doorstep. This funding protects a river that shaped our fishing heritage in Steveston Village and continues to anchor our regional economy. Being strong stewards of our waterways is a responsibility we all share, and we need to lead by example for the next generation. I encourage everyone to participate in the consultations and contribute to Canada’s National Water Security Strategy to protect these waters for future generations.
quotes.speaker: Parm Bains
quotes.article_title: PS Grant Highlights Launch of Public Engagement on Canada’s National Water Security Strategy and Announces New Projects to Protect the Fraser River

quotes.quote_text: Healthy waters sustain fish, wildlife and people in the Fraser River watershed. Raincoast Conservation Foundation is thrilled and humbled to be a recipient of Canada Water Agency funding that will build community-based capacity to monitor and protect this important watershed. The Raincoast mobile water pollution lab ('Tracker') will serve as a platform for safe water quality monitoring and training in Fraser waterways from the Interior to the Pacific coast. Our mission is to protect and celebrate healthy waters through a braided approach to western science and Indigenous Knowledge,and create a basis for innovative solutions and best practices.
quotes.speaker: Peter S. Ross
quotes.article_title: PS Grant Highlights Launch of Public Engagement on Canada’s National Water Security Strategy and Announces New Projects to Protect the Fraser River

quotes.quote_text: Canada is the world’s largest producer of potash. This agreement to supply Bangladesh with more high-quality potash builds on a trading relationship that saw our exports grow by over 25% this past year. It supports good-paying jobs for Canadian workers, advances our trade diversification agenda and reinforces Canada’s position as a reliable trading partner.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canadian contract helps strengthen global fertilizer supply through new potash agreement with Bangladesh

quotes.quote_text: In an increasingly uncertain global landscape, CCC’s government-to-government contracting model helps ensure Canada’s trading partners have reliable access to critical minerals like potash. By enabling direct, government-backed agreements, we create stable, predictable supply arrangements that benefit Canadian exporters and their government buyers.
quotes.speaker: Robert Kwon
quotes.article_title: Canadian contract helps strengthen global fertilizer supply through new potash agreement with Bangladesh

quotes.quote_text: This agreement is a strong example of how reliable access to Canadian potash can support food security and strengthen Canada’s long-standing overseas trade relationships. We’re proud to continue our partnership with CCC and BADC to deliver high-quality Canadian potash with the consistency and reliability that farmers depend on. Partnerships like this also underscore the importance of resilient infrastructure, trade corridors and supply chains that connect critical Canadian resources with customers in overseas markets.
quotes.speaker: Gordon McKenzie
quotes.speaker_title: President and Chief Executive Officer, Canpotex
quotes.article_title: Canadian contract helps strengthen global fertilizer supply through new potash agreement with Bangladesh

quotes.quote_text: Over 200 Canadian companies joined us at MSPO in Poland, our largest ever delegation, in a market where our defence exports have grown over 300%. I saw firsthand how CAE, a company that supports over 4,500 jobs here in Canada, is partnering with WB Group to unlock new opportunities in Poland as we grow our presence here. That kind of momentum across our defence sector will diversify our trade while creating 125,000 more jobs for Canadians over the next decade.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canada advances defence partnerships in Poland

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s defence industry is central to our security, our sovereignty and our economic strength. At MSPO, we are showing our Allies that Canada is ready to do more: to build more at home, deepen industrial cooperation and deliver the capabilities our collective defence demands. As NATO Allies, Canada and Poland are investing in a stronger, more-resilient defence industrial base that creates opportunities for Canadian workers and businesses while making our Alliance stronger.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Canada advances defence partnerships in Poland

quotes.quote_text: Canadians recognize that climate change is increasing wildfire risks across the country. By investing in a new National Fire Equipment Cache for Parks Canada, we’re helping to protect people, communities, and the natural places Canadians love and cherish. Strengthening Parks Canada’s ability to respond to wildfires supports the long-term protection of communities and natural ecosystems while enhancing the ability to support partners across the country.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces substantial completion of a new $34.6M Parks Canada National Fire Equipment Cache

quotes.quote_text: Canadians need to know that their governments are ready to act when wildfires threaten their communities. This new National Fire Equipment Cache is a major federal investment in that readiness. It puts critical equipment where it can be mobilized quickly, strengthens Parks Canada’s ability to protect people and places, and gives us greater capacity to support our provincial, territorial, Indigenous and international partners when they need us most.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces substantial completion of a new $34.6M Parks Canada National Fire Equipment Cache

quotes.quote_text: The Canada- U.S. trading relationship has changed dramatically, and Canadian businesses are responding by strengthening domestic supply chains, diversifying markets, and investing in their long-term competitiveness. Atom-Jet Industries is a strong example of that leadership, bringing more production in-house and expanding into new markets. Through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative, our government is helping businesses make the investments they need to adapt, create good jobs, and build a stronger, more resilient Canadian economy.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Atom-Jet Industries expands production and reaches new markets in response to unjustified U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Atom-Jet is doing what Prairie businesses do best: adapting, investing and finding new opportunities. By bringing more production home to Brandon and reaching new customers across Canada, the company is becoming more resilient in a chancing trade environment. We're proud to support businesses like Atom-Jet as they respond to tariff pressures, diversify their markets and create the conditions for long-term growth.
quotes.speaker: Ginette Lavack
quotes.article_title: Atom-Jet Industries expands production and reaches new markets in response to unjustified U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Atom-Jet is privileged to be part of the initiatives and funding PrairiesCan has put forward. Atom-Jet’s goal is to grow nationally and globally, adding new equipment and technology is a major part of our strategy, and it is great to have the support and same mindset from our federal government by way of PrairiesCan.
quotes.speaker: Barry LaRocque
quotes.article_title: Atom-Jet Industries expands production and reaches new markets in response to unjustified U.S. tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s beef producers deliver safe, high‑quality products trusted around the world. The Dominican Republic is an important and growing market in the Americas, and re-opening access creates new opportunities for our farmers and processors to expand their reach, strengthen their operations, and support jobs across Canada. Our government will continue working with industry and international partners to open doors, drive growth, and showcase the best of Canadian agriculture globally.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Canada regains market access for beef exports to the Dominican Republic

quotes.quote_text: Securing approval for Canadian beef processing establishments to export to the Dominican Republic is a pivotal step in diversifying Canada’s red meat trade and expanding our presence in global markets. The Canadian Meat Council has been advocating for this access since 2023, and we were proud to host and fund the Dominican audit team during its visit to Canada to help make it possible. Without the audit — and ultimately the Dominican Republic’s approval — Canadian establishments could not export to this market. The Dominican Republic is a significant meat import market, with more than $200 million in beef imports in 2025. With market access now granted, Canadian processors can compete to supply Dominican consumers with high-quality Canadian beef. This achievement is a testament to Canada’s world-class food safety standards and to what strong collaboration between government and industry can accomplish. This is a meaningful breakthrough for Canada’s meat sector, opening the door to new export opportunities, greater market diversification and growth across the entire supply chain.
quotes.speaker: Kyle Larkin
quotes.article_title: Canada regains market access for beef exports to the Dominican Republic

quotes.quote_text: Sport has the power to shape lives and connect people in ways that very few things can. Our government believes sport is our strength and our ultimate nation builder. Today’s support for Alpine Canada is another step forward, and it’s only the beginning. As we strengthen Canada’s sport system, support for national-level sport organizations will continue to roll out. Advancing our Playground to Podium vision also requires strong private-sector champions. Look no further than Capital Power, which stepped up and joined our efforts. Their support for Alpine Canada reflects the private sector’s commitment to Building Canada Strong through sport.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces key measures to Build Canada Strong through sport

quotes.quote_text: On behalf of Canada’s National Ski Team, our coaches and staff, and young ski racers across the country, thank you to Prime Minister Mark Carney and to the Honourable Adam van Koeverden, Secretary of State (Sport), for believing in our athletes and our sport. Ski racing is part of who we are as a winter sport nation. It brings families together on ski hills, communities together to host races, and Canadians together from all provinces and territories to cheer on our athletes as they proudly represent Canada on the world stage. This investment will help strengthen our sport from the first turns on a local ski hill to the Olympic and Paralympic podiums, inspiring the next generation of Canadian champions.
quotes.speaker: Andrew Baker
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces key measures to Build Canada Strong through sport

quotes.quote_text: Sport has the power to bring Canadians together, inspire young people, build future leaders, and strengthen communities and our country. Alongside the Government of Canada, we’re proud to back Alpine Canada as it opens skiing to more Canadians, equips athletes and coaches to compete at the highest level, and brings partners together to support a more ambitious future for winter sport as we build to the 2030 Olympic and Paralympic Winter Games.
quotes.speaker: Avik Dey
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces key measures to Build Canada Strong through sport

quotes.quote_text: Alberta’s agriculture and agri-food sector plays a vital role in communities across the province and in Canada’s economy. It is so important to hear directly from producers, processors, and industry partners about their experiences, priorities, and ideas for growth. By working together across provinces and territories, we can build a stronger, more connected food system that delivers for Canadians and puts high-quality Canadian food on tables across the country.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald concludes successful outreach to southern Alberta

quotes.quote_text: Sport has the power to shape lives and connect people in ways that very few things can. Canada Strong through sport: The Playground to Podium Summit represents an inflection point in Canada’s Year of sport. It will bring the sport community together around our shared goals: build, perform, protect, participate and host, create opportunities for new ideas and collaboration, and set the stage for transformation. At the Summit, we will advance the ambitious vision we laid out in April to strengthen our sport system and build Canada Strong, from the playground to the podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces Canada Strong through sport: The Playground to Podium Summit

quotes.quote_text: On behalf of Statistics Canada, I thank all respondents for making the 2026 Census a success. I also want to extend our gratitude to the many partners and stakeholders who helped promote and support participation within their communities. Our overall response rate for the Census of Population is one of the highest in the world for such an exercise, making the data it provides as accurate and reliable as can be. The information obtained from the census provides invaluable insights into the evolving characteristics of our country that are needed to make well-informed, fact-based decisions. We look forward to sharing the results with all Canadians.
quotes.speaker: André Loranger
quotes.article_title: Statistics Canada thanks Canadians for their exceptional participation in the 2026 Census

quotes.quote_text: Every young person deserves the chance to make good choices, feel supported, and see a positive path ahead. This funding is about reaching youth early — before they start heading down the wrong path — and making sure they have safe spaces, trusted people and real opportunities around them. By investing in prevention and in the local organizations doing this work every day, we’re helping young people build brighter futures while creating safer, stronger communities across the CBRM.
quotes.speaker: Mike Kelloway
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in gun violence prevention in Cape Breton, Nova Scotia

quotes.quote_text: Strong communities are built when young people can see opportunity ahead of them and know they have people in their corner. This investment will help strengthen the local organizations that give youth safe places to belong, trusted adults to turn to, and positive pathways forward.
quotes.speaker: Cecil Clarke
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in gun violence prevention in Cape Breton, Nova Scotia

quotes.quote_text: When investors are considering major projects, certainty matters. By prioritizing advance tax rulings for investments of $1 billion or more, we are giving them the clarity and predictability they need to invest with confidence, create opportunities and help build Canada’s economic future.
quotes.article_title: Greater tax certainty for major investments in Canada

quotes.quote_text: A strong economy depends on Canadians being able to participate fully in it. The Menstrual Equity Fund has helped millions of Canadians access essential products while easing affordability pressures for individuals and families. By improving access to a basic necessity, we are removing barriers that prevent Canadians from participating fully in school, work and their communities. Our government is taking action to make life more affordable, strengthen our economy and build a Canada where everyone can succeed.
quotes.speaker: Rechie Valdez
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez highlights $60 million investment advancing menstrual equity and improving affordability through access to essential menstrual products

quotes.quote_text: Here in Mississauga and across Canada, this program is helping make sure people can access the menstrual products they need without adding pressure to their household budgets. By supporting food banks and community organizations that are closest to the people they serve, we are helping remove barriers and making life more affordable for Canadians. As we build a stronger economy, we are making sure people and families have the support they need to participate and succeed.
quotes.speaker: Peter Fonseca
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez highlights $60 million investment advancing menstrual equity and improving affordability through access to essential menstrual products

quotes.quote_text: Across the network of organizations affiliated with Food Banks Canada, staff and volunteers see period poverty regularly, so we’re extremely pleased with the federal funding for this initiative and the important impacts it has delivered. This project is reaching millions of people in need across every province and territory. Food bankers have learned from appreciative community members that reliable access to menstrual products relieves financial strain, alleviates physical and mental health challenges, and enables full participation in society. We’re eager to continue working with the government toward a strong country where nobody’s potential is held back by unmet essential needs.
quotes.speaker: Kirstin Beardsley
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez highlights $60 million investment advancing menstrual equity and improving affordability through access to essential menstrual products

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today’s investment in water and wastewater infrastructure in the Township of Selwyn will help ensure that critical infrastructure keeps pace with development, supporting a safe, healthy, and resilient community for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Emma Harrison
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in water and wastewater systems in Selwyn

quotes.quote_text: Investing in the infrastructure that supports growth is an investment in the future of Lakefield and the entire Township of Selwyn. This funding will help us make the critical water and wastewater upgrades needed for the Lakefield South Development Area, while ensuring our systems can reliably serve existing and future residents. We are grateful to the Government of Canada for recognizing the importance of this project and for partnering with us to build the infrastructure needed to support housing, and economic growth. These upgrades will not only enable new homes but also support the creation of a stronger, more sustainable Lakefield for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Her Worship
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in water and wastewater systems in Selwyn

quotes.quote_text: Extortion and organized crime threaten the safety of our communities. The Government of Canada is committed to disrupting these activities through strong collaboration with law enforcement partners and decisive enforcement action. By identifying and removing inadmissible individuals involved in criminal activity, we are strengthening public safety.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: CBSA efforts to disrupt extortion networks led to over 100 removals

quotes.quote_text: The removal of more than 100 individuals linked to extortion activities reflects CBSA’s sustained efforts to identify, investigate and take action against those who pose a threat to our communities. These results also demonstrate the impact of strong collaboration with law enforcement partners across Canada and our shared commitment to combatting organized crime.
quotes.speaker: Erin O’Gorman
quotes.article_title: CBSA efforts to disrupt extortion networks led to over 100 removals

quotes.quote_text: Canada has an opportunity right now to generate prosperity, diversify trade, secure global energy markets and enhance our sovereignty by working with partners across the Asia-Pacific region. With abundant resources, strong energy expertise and a Pacific coast that connects us directly to global markets, Canada can deliver both conventional and clean energy to the Asia- Pacific region in a way that creates economic opportunity for Canadians and shows how we can give ourselves more than anyone can take away.
quotes.speaker: Corey Hogan
quotes.article_title: Canada strengthens energy collaboration with Indo-Pacific countries to attract investment, create jobs and diversify trade

quotes.quote_text: Around the world, Canada’s audiovisual sector is known for its world-class talent, innovation, and stories that showcase our values and diversity and resonate with millions of people. We’re proud to see this shine at the Toronto International Film Festival. As we build a more resilient sector at home, ensuring it remains competitive in an increasingly digital world is key. These modernized coproduction agreements will make it easier for our filmmakers to collaborate with partners around the world, bring Canadian stories to new audiences, and strengthen our audiovisual industry as a pillar of our cultural and economic sovereignty.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada strengthens Canada’s audiovisual sector at home and abroad with modernized audiovisual coproduction treaties with the United Kingdom and Spain

quotes.quote_text: The cultural, historical and economic bonds between Britain and Canada are already incredibly strong and, thanks to this new agreement, we will be able to forge even deeper ties. Both Britain and Canada have world-class film and TV industries, and I look forward to seeing what we create together following this landmark deal.
quotes.speaker: Ian Murray
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada strengthens Canada’s audiovisual sector at home and abroad with modernized audiovisual coproduction treaties with the United Kingdom and Spain

quotes.quote_text: We’ve come to Toronto at one of the best moments for the Spanish film and television industry, following our recent success at Cannes and with a very promising festival season ahead. Historically, our bilateral relations with Canada have been excellent, even more so over the past decade, with the implementation of the EU-Canada Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement (CETA). We believe this is the time to be ambitious and update the current bilateral film coproduction treaty from 1985. This new coproduction treaty will make it easier for Spanish and Canadian production companies to collaborate with real guarantees and access to public funds from both countries, within a modern and up-to-date legal framework. International audiovisual collaboration is a top priority for the Instituto de la Cinematografía y de las Artes Audiovisuales (ICAA) backed by years of continuous work in this area. Spanish cinema is becoming increasingly international, as reflected by the strong representation at TIFF 2026, which has consolidated its growing international presence.
quotes.speaker: Marta Serrano
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada strengthens Canada’s audiovisual sector at home and abroad with modernized audiovisual coproduction treaties with the United Kingdom and Spain

quotes.quote_text: This expanded air transport agreement with Tunisia is a significant step in strengthening the ties between our two countries. By opening new opportunities for airlines, businesses, and travellers with this growing market, we are deepening our economic partnership and creating the conditions for greater mobility, trade, and cultural exchange .
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada announces expanded air transport agreement between Canada and Tunisia

quotes.quote_text: Canada is strengthening its connection with one of our North African partners. The expanded air transport agreement with Tunisia will support commercial and investment ties between our countries, helping Canadian businesses access new opportunities, diversify our trade partnerships, and contribute to economic growth and shared prosperity.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada announces expanded air transport agreement between Canada and Tunisia

quotes.quote_text: Our government is focused on strengthening Canada’s food system so Canadians can count on a reliable supply of high-quality, affordable food. This new $1 billion fund, combined with the $150 million investment in Velocity Agri-Capital Partners, will help Canadian agri‑food businesses bring ambitious projects to life, expand processing capacity, and grow value here at home. By investing in innovation and infrastructure, we’re supporting producers and ensuring Canada’s food system is resilient for the future.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces Farm Credit Canada’s $1 billion Agri-food Project Finance Fund and $150 million to Velocity Agri-Capital Partners to strengthen food security and grow the economy

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s agriculture and food industry has a generational opportunity to meet the growing demand at home and around the world for reliable, safe, and nutritious food. Agri-food Project Finance is a critical financing tool which will unlock the right projects to help Canada build the infrastructure and processing capacity we need for a stronger, more resilient, and more self-reliant food system. This launch rounds out FCC’s full complement of capital solutions, ensuring Canadian producers and agri-businesses have the financing and investment tools they need to seize this generational opportunity.
quotes.speaker: Justine Hendricks
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces Farm Credit Canada’s $1 billion Agri-food Project Finance Fund and $150 million to Velocity Agri-Capital Partners to strengthen food security and grow the economy

quotes.quote_text: Canada's agri-food sector is strategically important to our global brand and our trading relationships. The world needs what we grow and produce and it’s time for us to build on our strength in commodities and into higher-value add products. Velocity Capital is in discussions with Canadian and International investors regarding additional capital commitments of up to $350 million . The fund will help move Canada up the value chain, and into active capital deployment with Canadian companies ready to export to Southeast Asia and attract foreign investment from Southeast Asian companies looking to domicile and build jobs here.
quotes.speaker: Arlene Dickinson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces Farm Credit Canada’s $1 billion Agri-food Project Finance Fund and $150 million to Velocity Agri-Capital Partners to strengthen food security and grow the economy

quotes.quote_text: London is home to world-class agri-food businesses that are creating jobs, driving innovation, and contributing to Canada’s food system. This investment will help businesses take ambitious projects from the drawing board to reality, while strengthening our local economy and creating new opportunities across the region. Supporting the growth of Canada’s agri-food sector means supporting good jobs and a stronger economy in London and across the country.
quotes.speaker: Peter Fragiskatos
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces Farm Credit Canada’s $1 billion Agri-food Project Finance Fund and $150 million to Velocity Agri-Capital Partners to strengthen food security and grow the economy

quotes.quote_text: From Arva Flour Mills to businesses across London and the surrounding region, our agri-food sector is an important part of our local economy. This new fund will help Canadian businesses invest, grow and bring more food processing and manufacturing opportunities home. By strengthening businesses in our community, we’re helping create good jobs and a more resilient food system for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: The
quotes.speaker_title: Honourable Arielle Kayabaga, Deputy House Leader and Member of Parliament for London West
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces Farm Credit Canada’s $1 billion Agri-food Project Finance Fund and $150 million to Velocity Agri-Capital Partners to strengthen food security and grow the economy

quotes.quote_text: Artificial intelligence is transforming the global economy, and the countries that build the infrastructure will shape what comes next. Canada has the energy, talent and ambition to lead. We are building sovereign AI capacity here at home so that Canadian workers, businesses and researchers can seize the opportunities of AI, with infrastructure governed by Canadian laws and built in the Canadian interest.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada welcomes major new investment in sovereign AI infrastructure in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Today’s announcement, the largest private-sector investment in Saskatchewan’s history, shows what is possible when Canadian energy can provide the electricity needed to support new computing capacity at scale, unlock tens of billions of dollars in investment, and create thousands of good jobs. Our government is proud to work with provinces and territories, energy utilities and providers, and industry to make investments like this possible, while protecting reliable and affordable power for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada welcomes major new investment in sovereign AI infrastructure in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: This investment demonstrates that Canada is attracting major projects, creating high-quality jobs and competing for the industries that will define the future. Our government is focused on bringing investment to Canada and ensuring that Canadian workers and businesses benefit.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada welcomes major new investment in sovereign AI infrastructure in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Canada has everything it takes to be a global leader in critical minerals. Copper and palladium are essential to Canada’s economic future—supporting everything from clean energy and critical infrastructure to advanced manufacturing. The Canada Growth Fund investment announced today helps paves the way for construction of the Marathon Project, strengthening Canada’s critical minerals supply chains, creating good-paying jobs and supporting long-term prosperity in Northwestern Ontario and across the country.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: Minister Champagne welcomes Canada Growth Fund investment in Ontario copper and palladium mine

quotes.quote_text: Canada has the minerals the world wants, and our government is focused on getting major projects built that unlock those resources and get them to markets at home and abroad. This investment by the Canada Growth Fund will help unlock private capital for the Marathon Project, a fully permitted, shovel-ready critical minerals project. By advancing a new Canadian source of copper and palladium, we are strengthening North American supply chains, supporting good jobs in Northwestern Ontario, and building the projects that will power Canada’s economy for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Minister Champagne welcomes Canada Growth Fund investment in Ontario copper and palladium mine

quotes.quote_text: The Marathon Project is a strong example of how Northern Ontario is helping drive Canada’s economic future. This investment will create good-paying jobs, attract new economic opportunities, and deliver lasting benefits for the people and communities of Northwestern Ontario. By advancing responsible critical minerals development, we are strengthening Canada’s role in global supply chains, supporting the transition to a clean economy, and ensuring that the benefits are felt across the North and throughout the country.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Minister Champagne welcomes Canada Growth Fund investment in Ontario copper and palladium mine

quotes.quote_text: With the Build Communities Strong Fund, the Government of Canada is building infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. The Cody Banks Arena is an important hub that has hosted community and recreational events for thousands of Islanders. Today’s investment in retrofits to the facility will support the local economy and create more fond memories for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Sean Casey
quotes.article_title: Building Canada Strong by investing in retrofits to the Cody Banks Arena

quotes.quote_text: This investment supports the goals and actions of our Climate Action Plan by helping us reduce energy use and greenhouse gas emissions in City facilities, while breathing new life into an important piece of community recreation infrastructure. By investing in renewable energy and modern, energy-efficient systems at Cody Banks Arena, we’re extending the life of the facility and ensuring it can continue to serve our community in a more sustainable way for years to come. We’re grateful to the Government of Canada for supporting this important work.
quotes.speaker: Philip Brown
quotes.article_title: Building Canada Strong by investing in retrofits to the Cody Banks Arena

quotes.quote_text: In an evolving global landscape, Canada’s government is focused on what we can control. We’re extending the pause on the federal fuel tax to provide immediate support to Canadians amid global economic change. Companies in Newfoundland and Labrador, like Akita Equipment, contribute to our economy, and we’re taking action to help businesses grow and build a more resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: Tom Osborne
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada extends the federal fuel excise tax relief on gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuels for Canadians

quotes.quote_text: With many families still feeling the pressure of higher costs, we’re extending the federal fuel tax suspension to keep more money in Canadians’ pockets. This will provide meaningful relief for families and businesses and help make everyday life more affordable.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada extends the federal fuel excise tax relief on gasoline, diesel, and aviation fuels for Canadians

quotes.quote_text: When Canadian innovators succeed, Canadian workers and communities benefit. Investments like these help companies grow, attract investment, create good-paying jobs and strengthen Canada's position in rapidly growing clean technology markets. That’s how we’re building our way to becoming a clean and conventional superpower, right here in the GTA.
quotes.speaker: Ruby Sahota
quotes.article_title: Canada invests in clean fuels innovation in Ontario

quotes.quote_text: Building Canada's energy future depends on building and scaling the technologies that will power our economy for decades to come. Investments in Canadian innovators like Next Hydrogen and CERT Systems are strengthening our energy security, supporting growth and turning Canadian expertise into real-world solutions. By supporting innovation today, we are building the stronger, more competitive energy sector Canada needs for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Canada invests in clean fuels innovation in Ontario

quotes.quote_text: Today’s investment in watermain infrastructure for the Mohawks of the Bay of Quinte will connect currently unserviced areas of Tyendinaga Mohawk Territory to the existing water treatment plant. It will help end the community’s long-term drinking water advisory, improve water security, enhance fire protection, support future growth, and contribute to the long-term health, safety, and well-being of community members.
quotes.speaker: Chris Malette
quotes.article_title: Investing in water infrastructure for the Mohawks of the Bay of Quinte

quotes.quote_text: On behalf of Tyendinaga Mohawk Council we sincerely appreciate and welcome this funding that increases the adaptability of the community to mitigate severe climate change impacts while providing access to communal potable water and improved fire protection for the remaining un-serviced areas of our community. We applaud the federal government for their commitment to eliminating long-term drinking water advisories on First Nations, as well as the dedication of Tyendinaga Mohawk Council, Todd Kring and our MBQ Infrastructure Department for their coordination and the community for their patience. This funding approval enables the Mohawks of the Bay of Quinte to complete water connections to the remaining 305 un-serviced homes, providing safe, reliable drinking water and fire protection for all in our community.
quotes.speaker: R. Donald Maracle
quotes.article_title: Investing in water infrastructure for the Mohawks of the Bay of Quinte

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Border Services Agency works tirelessly to detect and disrupt drug smuggling at our borders. The strategic cooperation between the CBSA, RCMP, and other law enforcement partners demonstrates Canada’s unrelenting commitment to combat organized crime and to protect Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: CBSA officers seize over 215 kg of cocaine from two commercial trucks at Coutts

quotes.quote_text: CBSA officers are the first line of defense at ports of entry across the country. These significant cocaine seizures at the Coutts port of entry demonstrate the vigilance, expertise and dedication of our border services officers in preventing illegal drugs and other contraband from entering Canada and causing harm to our communities.
quotes.speaker: Janalee Bell-Boychuk
quotes.article_title: CBSA officers seize over 215 kg of cocaine from two commercial trucks at Coutts

quotes.quote_text: Collaboration is fundamental to preventing illicit drugs from entering Canada and strengthening our collective ability to protect Canadians. At every stage, our focus remains on safeguarding the health, safety, and well-being of the communities we serve.
quotes.speaker: Chief Superintendent Brad Wirachowsky
quotes.article_title: CBSA officers seize over 215 kg of cocaine from two commercial trucks at Coutts

quotes.quote_text: In today’s world, high-speed Internet is essential infrastructure. For rural households like the 1,833 across Alberta being connected by this funding, it helps level the playing field—connecting people to health care, education and business. This project brings us another step closer to our goal of connecting every Canadian to high-speed Internet by 2030 and is another great example of what we can accomplish when Canada and Alberta work together.
quotes.speaker: Buckley Belanger
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada and Alberta are expanding high-speed Internet access in the province

quotes.quote_text: No matter where Albertans live, they should have access to reliable, high-speed Internet. This investment will help connect more rural and remote communities, support local businesses, create new opportunities and improve access to the services people rely on every day. Together with the Government of Canada, we are building the infrastructure needed to keep Alberta communities connected.
quotes.speaker: Nate Glubish
quotes.speaker_title: Alberta’s Minister of Technology and Innovation
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada and Alberta are expanding high-speed Internet access in the province

quotes.quote_text: In the face of ongoing trade uncertainty and tariff pressures, the Government of Canada is taking decisive action to help Canadian businesses adapt, grow and compete. Through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative, we are providing targeted support that will help businesses strengthen productivity, build more resilient supply chains, and protect jobs in the North and across Canada.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Chartrand
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada invests over $1.9 million to support workers and strengthen businesses in the Yukon

quotes.quote_text: Yukon businesses have always demonstrated resilience and ingenuity in the face of challenges. Through investments that help businesses grow, innovate and access new markets, the Government of Canada is ensuring they have the tools they need to succeed. Together, we are protecting jobs, strengthening supply chains and building a more resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Brendan Hanley
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada invests over $1.9 million to support workers and strengthen businesses in the Yukon

quotes.quote_text: Tariff pressure on our U.S. growth plans could have been a setback — instead, it redirected our focus and engineering talent back home. With support from CanNor's Regional Tariff Response Initiative, Solvest is expanding our design-build portable solar and battery storage offerings to include a system purpose-built for Yukon's placer mines. This prototype will prove the business case for moving small- to medium-sized camps off diesel, while integrating seamlessly with existing systems and providing full operations and maintenance support. This expansion will allow us to meet the needs of a wider range of Yukoners, create skilled local jobs, and provide opportunities to partner with local businesses as we make northern-built clean technology more accessible.
quotes.speaker: Lauren Humble
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada invests over $1.9 million to support workers and strengthen businesses in the Yukon

quotes.quote_text: No matter where they live, Canadians should be able to access important services in their own communities. The new passport printer at the Charlottetown Service Canada Centre will make it easier for people in Prince Edward Island to access more passport services closer to home. By bringing services closer to the people who rely on them, we are making it easier for Canadians to get the support they need, when they need it.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands passport service offerings at Charlottetown Service Canada Centre

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is committed to making life more convenient. That’s why we’re modernizing the way we deliver key services and making passport services more accessible for Islanders and all Canadians. With the new passport printer in Charlottetown, we are responding to the needs of residents across Prince Edward Island and providing the province with onsite passport printing services for the first time ever. This is a critical step forward that builds on previous service improvements, including the online passport renewal service that opened to all eligible Canadian adults earlier this summer.
quotes.speaker: Lena Metlege Diab
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands passport service offerings at Charlottetown Service Canada Centre

quotes.quote_text: Promise made, promise kept. We have steadily improved passport services for Islanders, and today we’re putting the cherry on top with a new passport printer at the Charlottetown Service Canada Centre. Islanders who need a passport urgently will no longer have to travel off-Island to get one. PEI now has the same level of passport service available in every other province in Canada — and that is great news for Islanders.
quotes.speaker: Sean Casey
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada expands passport service offerings at Charlottetown Service Canada Centre

quotes.quote_text: Lasting change happens when communities have the opportunity to lead. Through the Fund, Black-led organizations are helping people overcome barriers and build better futures for themselves and their families. Their work is strengthening communities today and shaping a more resilient and inclusive Canada for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in lasting change through fourth call for proposals under Black-led Philanthropic Endowment Fund

quotes.quote_text: What FFBC and our partners have built together is proof that when Black communities are trusted with resources, we deliver, not just for ourselves, but for all of Canada. The B.I.G. 4.0 is more than another funding round, it is an investment in the ideas, institutions and leadership already driving change in Black communities across Canada — and a reminder of what becomes possible when those ideas are backed with the resources they deserve.
quotes.speaker: Kimahli Powell
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in lasting change through fourth call for proposals under Black-led Philanthropic Endowment Fund

quotes.quote_text: Canada has what the world wants, and Ksi Lisims LNG’s third international deal being signed the same week as some of the world’s largest capital allocators gather in Toronto shows that it is our moment — if we choose to seize it. Amidst energy market disruptions, international demand for reliable energy only continues to grow, and projects like this — developed in partnership with Indigenous Peoples and providing best-in-class low-carbon energy — demonstrate how Canada can be a leading energy superpower for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Canadian LNG project signs third international offtake deal

quotes.quote_text: Santos has built one of the most significant LNG businesses in the Asia-Pacific, and their decision to secure long-term supply from Ksi Lisims LNG reflects a shared commitment to responsible energy development and a clear view that supply diversity is essential to long-term energy security. The level of interest we are seeing from leading global energy companies like Santos reflects a growing global role for reliable, low-carbon, Canadian LNG. This HOA is a strong signal of confidence in our project as we move into the final stages of commercialization and toward a final investment decision.
quotes.speaker: Davis Thames
quotes.speaker_title: Founder, President and Chief Executive Officer, Western LNG
quotes.article_title: Canadian LNG project signs third international offtake deal

quotes.quote_text: Every vessel we bring into service makes Canada's maritime response stronger and our waters safer. The Canadian Coast Guard Ship Groswater Bay will help our crews protect mariners off Newfoundland's coast for years to come and reflects our commitment to a modern coast guard fleet, built here in Canada.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: The Canadian Coast Guard welcomes the CCGS Groswater Bay into service

quotes.quote_text: Through the National Shipbuilding Strategy, we are creating good Canadian jobs, strengthening our shipbuilding industry, and delivering the vessels our Coast Guard needs. Built in Ontario and ready to serve Newfoundland and Labrador, the CCGS Groswater Bay is a strong example of Canadian expertise and of our commitment to building a stronger, more sovereign Canada.
quotes.speaker: Joël Lightbound
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Public Works and Procurement and Quebec Lieutenant
quotes.article_title: The Canadian Coast Guard welcomes the CCGS Groswater Bay into service

quotes.quote_text: For the people of Labrador, the sea is part of who we are it shapes our communities and our way of life. Dedicating the Canadian Coast Guard Ship Groswater Bay is deeply meaningful as this search and rescue lifeboat will stand as a vital safeguard for those who travel, work, and live along our coast, strengthening safety in the waters our families rely on every day.
quotes.speaker: Philip Earle
quotes.article_title: The Canadian Coast Guard welcomes the CCGS Groswater Bay into service

quotes.quote_text: Today, as we dedicate the Canadian Coast Guard Ship Groswater Bay into service, we celebrate a commitment to service, safety, and community. The addition of this vessel holds special significance for Newfoundlanders and Labradorians, whose lives and livelihoods are closely tied to the ocean.
quotes.speaker: Kevin Brosseau
quotes.article_title: The Canadian Coast Guard welcomes the CCGS Groswater Bay into service

quotes.quote_text: Artificial intelligence is creating extraordinary new opportunities for Canadian businesses, and Atlantic Canada has the talent, ambition, and know-how to become a major player. These 37 companies are bringing innovative ideas and technologies to ALL IN, and they’ll use this forum to connect with the customers, investors, and partners they need to grow. Helping Canadian companies build those relationships across the country is how we build one Canadian economy that can compete with the best in the world.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Canada joins forces to showcase AI companies at ALL IN 2026

quotes.quote_text: New Brunswick is proud to join the rest of Atlantic Canada to showcase the impressive technology being built right here in our region. As artificial intelligence continues to transform the way the world works, New Brunswick companies are capitalizing on both the opportunities and the potential of this digital transformation. The ALL IN event is getting our companies in front of customers and investors from across the country and around the world, creating more opportunities for our technology companies to grow, reach new markets, and create good jobs here at home.
quotes.speaker: Luke Randall
quotes.speaker_title: Minister responsible for Opportunities NB and for Economic Development and Small Business
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Canada joins forces to showcase AI companies at ALL IN 2026

quotes.quote_text: Atlantic Canadian companies are really moving the needle when it comes to AI, and that work deserves a global audience. What often makes the biggest difference is getting into the right rooms and connecting with the people who can help them take the next step. This investment through ATIGA gives 37 companies that access and signals real confidence in what our region has to offer. We’re grateful for that support and proud to lead a delegation that puts Atlantic Canadian companies in the conversations shaping where AI goes next.
quotes.speaker: Owen Sagness
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Canada joins forces to showcase AI companies at ALL IN 2026

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s security depends on our ability to build at home. As our government rebuilds, rearms and reinvests in the Canadian Armed Forces, we must also rebuild the domestic industrial capacity. Manitoba has the workers, expertise, and innovation to help lead that work. Through RRC Polytech and its partners, this investment will help more Manitoba businesses enter defence supply chains, bring Canadian technologies to market and create good jobs—all while strengthening our sovereignty and security.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: New initiative harnesses Manitoba expertise to strengthen Canada’s defence industrial base and defend our sovereignty

quotes.quote_text: Winnipeg has a strong aerospace and advanced manufacturing sector, with local companies that have the skills, technology and expertise to take on more defence work. Through this partnership between RRC Polytech, Manitoba Aerospace and Canadian Manufacturers & Exporters – Manitoba, more businesses will get the support they need to prepare for new opportunities, connect with customers and compete for contracts. This will help local companies grow, create skilled jobs and strengthen our city’s role in Canada’s defence industry.
quotes.speaker: MP Doug Eyolfson
quotes.article_title: New initiative harnesses Manitoba expertise to strengthen Canada’s defence industrial base and defend our sovereignty

quotes.quote_text: We are thrilled by PrairiesCan’s investment in Manitoba’s innovation and defence ecosystem. Through the Manitoba Defence and Dual-Use Innovation Bridge, RRC Polytech is bringing together applied research, industry innovation, and business readiness supports to help Manitoba companies develop new technologies and access opportunities within the defence supply chain. This unique model serves as a true force multiplier by connecting company-led research and development with supplier readiness, procurement awareness, and supply chain integration. By combining RRC Polytech’s applied research capabilities with the expertise of Manitoba Aerospace and Canadian Manufacturers and Exporters, we are creating an accelerated pathway from innovation to commercialization and market growth. Together we are strengthening Manitoba’s role in Canada’s defence industrial base while creating new opportunities for businesses, investments, and economic growth throughout the province.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Jolen Galaugher
quotes.speaker_title: Executive Director Research Partnerships & Innovation, RRC Polytech
quotes.article_title: New initiative harnesses Manitoba expertise to strengthen Canada’s defence industrial base and defend our sovereignty

quotes.quote_text: Manitoba Aerospace is excited to play a key role in the Defence and Dual-Use Innovation Bridge, helping Manitoba companies build the capabilities, connections and readiness they need to compete and grow in Canada’s defence supply chain. This initiative brings industry, research and expertise together in a practical way that will strengthen our aerospace and defence ecosystem, create new opportunities for Manitoba businesses, and position our province for long-term growth in this rapidly expanding sector.
quotes.speaker: Beverlie Stuart
quotes.article_title: New initiative harnesses Manitoba expertise to strengthen Canada’s defence industrial base and defend our sovereignty

quotes.quote_text: Canadian Manufacturers & Exporters is proud to partner on the Defence and Dual-Use Innovation Bridge to help Manitoba manufacturers strengthen their capabilities, adopt new technologies, and access opportunities in Canada’s growing defence supply chain. This initiative will support companies in building the skills, connections and operational readiness needed to compete in both defence and dual-use markets, while also helping to grow a stronger, more innovative manufacturing ecosystem in Manitoba
quotes.speaker: Brittany Scarrow
quotes.speaker_title: VP, Prairies Operations and Business Services, Canadian Manufacturers & Exporters
quotes.article_title: New initiative harnesses Manitoba expertise to strengthen Canada’s defence industrial base and defend our sovereignty

quotes.quote_text: This investment will improve access to essential services, eliminate reliance on trucked water delivery and household cisterns on Wiikwemkoong Unceded Territory, and support new housing development. This investment in critical infrastructure will bring clean, piped water to the community, helping build a stronger, healthier future while addressing growing housing and infrastructure needs.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Investing in watermain infrastructure in Wiikwemkoong Unceded Territory

quotes.quote_text: Our community is growing, and we need infrastructure that grows with us. This project means reliable water services for families, while also creating the infrastructure needed to build more homes and support future development. This is the kind of investment that makes a real difference in people’s daily lives and helps us keep building Wiikwemkoong for the next generation. The investment opens up more of our community for housing and future development. By extending water services to Rabbit Island Road and Ojibway Heights, we can support hundreds of existing and future homes while putting the infrastructure in place for these areas to grow. This is the kind of long-term investment Wiikwemkoong needs to build for the next generation.
quotes.speaker: Ogimaa Tim Ominika
quotes.article_title: Investing in watermain infrastructure in Wiikwemkoong Unceded Territory

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today’s investment in water and wastewater infrastructure in Mount Pearl will ensure our water systems are ready to serve residents today and allow for growth for the decades to come.
quotes.speaker: Tom Osborne
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in water and wastewater infrastructure in Mount Pearl

quotes.quote_text: Upgrading water and wastewater infrastructure along Park Avenue will not only improve the reliability of essential services for residents, but it will also create new opportunities for housing development and future growth. We are grateful to the Government of Canada for recognizing the importance of investing in the infrastructure communities need to build strong, sustainable communities for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Dave Aker
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in water and wastewater infrastructure in Mount Pearl

quotes.quote_text: Since 2018, the Canada Nature Fund for Aquatic Species at Risk has helped our partners restore habitat and reduce threats for almost 200 species. That work is paying off, and our government is making sure it continues with $15.5 million a year for the next five years. Indigenous communities and local conservation groups are leading this work on the ground. Coastal communities depend on a healthy ocean. Their work helps keep it that way.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada calls for projects to protect and recover aquatic species at risk

quotes.quote_text: Protecting aquatic species at risk means protecting the waters and ecosystems that sustain life across Canada. The Canada Nature Fund for Aquatic Species at Risk supports the partnerships and conservation work needed to help recover these species and safeguard Canada’s biodiversity. Through A Force of Nature , we are building on this work to deliver lasting results for nature and Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Nathalie Provost
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada calls for projects to protect and recover aquatic species at risk

quotes.quote_text: Whether travelling for work, visiting family and friends, or moving goods to market, people and businesses rely on Windsor International Airport every day. This investment will help ensure the airport continues to provide safe and reliable service while supporting its role as an important transportation and trade hub for southwestern Ontario. Investments like this are helping to build a stronger transportation network, improve regional connectivity, and ensure communities have the infrastructure they need to stay connected and grow.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests nearly $7.5 million in Windsor International Airport for critical infrastructure projects

quotes.quote_text: For communities like Windsor, airports are more than transportation hubs. They connect people, support local businesses, welcome visitors, and help drive economic growth. Investments in our airports will strengthen those important connections and help ensure that Canadians and travellers can rely on safe reliable air transportation for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Mike Kelloway
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests nearly $7.5 million in Windsor International Airport for critical infrastructure projects

quotes.quote_text: Southwestern Ontario is home to growing communities, businesses and industries that depend on strong transportation connections. Windsor International Airport plays an important role in connecting the region to the rest of Canada and the world. This investment will strengthen the airport and help ensure Southwestern Ontario has the transportation infrastructure it needs to grow and prosper.
quotes.speaker: Arielle Kayabaga
quotes.speaker_title: Deputy House Leader and Member of Parliament for London West
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests nearly $7.5 million in Windsor International Airport for critical infrastructure projects

quotes.quote_text: The nearly $7.5 million to Windsor International Airport through the Airports Capital Assistant Program allows for YQG to enhance safety and ensure that Windsor International Airport can continue to connect communities and be an economic and social driver for the region.
quotes.speaker: Mark Galvin
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests nearly $7.5 million in Windsor International Airport for critical infrastructure projects

quotes.quote_text: AI technologies have the potential to deliver a generational boost to the productivity of the Canadian economy. By investing in LawZero, a Canadian organization advancing safe, high‑impact AI, we are building domestic capacity, supporting good jobs and helping to ensure that advanced technologies are developed responsibly and in ways that benefit Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada and Germany invest in LawZero to build a new approach to safe, sovereign AI

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s future in AI depends on developing advanced systems that reflect our values and protect our interests. By investing in homegrown innovation like Scientist AI, we are strengthening Canada’s sovereign AI capacity and ensuring that the next generation of AI is built safely, responsibly and on Canadian terms.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada and Germany invest in LawZero to build a new approach to safe, sovereign AI

quotes.quote_text: With Scientist AI, we are deepening the proven partnership between Canada and Germany. This project pursues a novel, mathematically grounded approach: to develop an inherently safe AI. The safe-by-design model offers an alternative to potentially uncontrollable autonomous AI agents. It works purely on the basis of facts—like an objective scientist—and does not pursue its own goals. By building advanced AI research capabilities in Canada and Europe, we are strengthening our technological sovereignty.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Karsten Wildberger
quotes.speaker_title: Germany’s Federal Minister for Digital Transformation and Government Modernisation
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada and Germany invest in LawZero to build a new approach to safe, sovereign AI

quotes.quote_text: As AI risks multiply and accelerate, our priority must be building solutions to make this technology safe and providing alternative models people can genuinely trust. Recent events demonstrate that safety is itself a core capability; scientific innovation and public safety can and must advance together. LawZero’s mission is to address this critical scientific challenge by developing reliable, safe-by-design AI. This backing from Canada and Germany is a defining moment, moving us into the next phase of developing safe AI on a global scale while improving both nations’ technological sovereignty.
quotes.speaker: Yoshua Bengio
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada and Germany invest in LawZero to build a new approach to safe, sovereign AI

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building reliable, resilient infrastructure at a speed and scale not seen in generations. Through PacifiCan, we are investing in the places British Columbians rely on every day — generating lasting economic benefits, supporting local jobs, and building vibrant, connected communities across the province.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: PacifiCan invests in passenger rail opportunities connecting Victoria West and Langford

quotes.quote_text: This investment demonstrates the federal government's commitment to the residents of B.C.'s Capital Region and their vision for a more integrated, accessible community.
