With growing public support for passenger rail and urgent transportation challenges from the West Shore to Victoria, federal engagement in this planning process is critical to turning that vision into reality. It is especially encouraging that this process is done in full partnership with First Nations, local governments and community leaders, built on a shared recognition of each other’s needs and a willingness to work together. This is exactly what is possible when governments come to the table ready to listen, collaborate and invest in solutions.
quotes.speaker: Stephanie McLean
quotes.article_title: PacifiCan invests in passenger rail opportunities connecting Victoria West and Langford

quotes.quote_text: Passenger rail has the potential to give residents a reliable way to move between the West Shore and Victoria while strengthening our regional economy and making better use of an existing transportation corridor. This investment will support the feasibility and technical work needed to move towards a new era of transportation and growth – all in partnership with the Songhees and Esquimalt Nations and communities along the corridor.
quotes.speaker: Will Greaves
quotes.article_title: PacifiCan invests in passenger rail opportunities connecting Victoria West and Langford

quotes.quote_text: The Province has been a steadfast partner with the Island Corridor Foundation, First Nations and local governments on the future of this corridor. In 2023, we committed $18 million to support planning and engagement with Indigenous communities and regional districts, including $300,000 toward this important technical planning work. PacifiCan’s investment today complements that contribution and helps us move forward to determine the best use for the corridor that meets the needs and priorities of this growing region.
quotes.speaker: Mike Farnworth
quotes.article_title: PacifiCan invests in passenger rail opportunities connecting Victoria West and Langford

quotes.quote_text: We are grateful for the federal government's support of this feasibility work, and for recognizing the value of exploring transportation solutions for our region. The Reconciliation Corridor Initiative project is not only a possible solution to our regional transportation challenges, but also an opportunity to help right historic damages to First Nations and bring economic benefit to First Nations and communities of the region. It's a template for partnerships in the future, with First Nation leadership and a grounding in community.
quotes.speaker: Barb Desjardins
quotes.article_title: PacifiCan invests in passenger rail opportunities connecting Victoria West and Langford

quotes.quote_text: Canadian companies are developing innovative solutions that can help make agriculture more sustainable and resilient. Through the ACT – Research and Innovation Stream, Lucent Bio is developing technologies that could help farmers use nitrogen more efficiently while reducing fertilizer use, emissions, and microplastics. By supporting the development of clean technologies like this, our government is helping Canadian farmers reduce costs, protect the environment and build a more sustainable agriculture sector.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests up to $1.98 million to develop sustainable fertilizer technology to reduce emissions and microplastics

quotes.quote_text: Burnaby is quickly becoming the center of B.C.'s push into sustainable agriculture, and farmers across Canada stand to benefit. The tools being developed locally will help Canadian farmers save money, reduce emissions and work more efficiently. Our government is committed to supporting innovation and building a strong, environmentally responsible, and independent agricultural economy.
quotes.speaker: Terry Beech
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests up to $1.98 million to develop sustainable fertilizer technology to reduce emissions and microplastics

quotes.quote_text: Federal government funding gives Lucent Bio the opportunity to take the technology we have been developing and move it into a new area with significant potential in agriculture. We’re applying our biodegradable biopolymer technology to controlled-release nitrogen to help growers get more value from the nitrogen they apply while reducing nutrient losses to the environment. Support from the federal government allows us to improve this work faster and brings us one step closer to putting a Canadian-developed solution into the hands of growers.
quotes.speaker: Farah Nour
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests up to $1.98 million to develop sustainable fertilizer technology to reduce emissions and microplastics

quotes.quote_text: Canada has what the world wants: the resources, expertise and ambition needed to support economic growth and energy security around the world. My discussions at the G20 strengthened relationships with key partners, advanced collaboration on bilateral trade and investment and demonstrated Canada’s leadership and stability during a moment of change.
quotes.speaker: Corey Hogan
quotes.article_title: Canada strengthens global energy partnerships at the G20 Energy Abundance Ministerial Meeting

quotes.quote_text: In partnership with Nova Scotia Power, and the Mi'kmaw Nation, our government is working to increase clean power capabilities in the Atlantic, and across the nation. Energy storage is essential for Nova Scotia’s move towards more renewable electricity and as demand for electricity continues to grow, Canada is building on its position as a global leader in clean power by investing in the infrastructure needed to keep our electricity systems reliable, affordable and resilient for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Canada celebrates the inauguration of Atlantic Canada’s largest energy storage facilities

quotes.quote_text: Today marks an important milestone for Nova Scotia and Atlantic Canada. We already have a strong electricity system, and clean electricity will ensure that we can keep that energy reliable, affordable, and secure. By building and improving our power grid, we’re creating the infrastructure needed to support Canada’s future growth and competitiveness.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Canada celebrates the inauguration of Atlantic Canada’s largest energy storage facilities

quotes.quote_text: The completion of energy storage facilities in Bridgewater, Waverley and White Rock marks another step forward in Nova Scotia’s transition to renewable energy sources. Working alongside Nova Scotia Power and WMA, we’re proud to support infrastructure that creates jobs, strengthens reliability and a cleaner energy future for Nova Scotians.
quotes.speaker: Ehren Cory
quotes.article_title: Canada celebrates the inauguration of Atlantic Canada’s largest energy storage facilities

quotes.quote_text: The successful completion of all three battery sites is an exciting milestone and reflects years of planning, engineering, community engagement and teamwork. These projects strengthen the reliability of the electricity system for our customers while enabling the continued growth of renewable energy across the province. We are grateful for the strong partnerships and collaboration that made this achievement possible and are pleased to celebrate this success today. Together, we are building a cleaner, more reliable energy future for Nova Scotians.
quotes.speaker: Vivek Sood
quotes.speaker_title: President and CEO, Nova Scotia Power
quotes.article_title: Canada celebrates the inauguration of Atlantic Canada’s largest energy storage facilities

quotes.quote_text: The WMA is proud to participate as equity partners in developing reliable energy solutions for our province. Energy storage is part of our path toward a greener future, and our First Nations need to be part of this ongoing transition. Inclusion in such projects opens pathways toward economic reconciliation and ensures that traditional Indigenous values are considered in major project development.
quotes.speaker: Crystal Nicholas
quotes.article_title: Canada celebrates the inauguration of Atlantic Canada’s largest energy storage facilities

quotes.quote_text: Sport has the power to shape lives and connect people in ways that very few things can. As we continue our nation’s monumental year of sport, the Government of Canada is investing to establish the new home of Canadian basketball at Humber. The Hub will strengthen Canada’s sport system, help athletes at every level pursue excellence, expand participation and create more opportunities to host major sporting events here at home, proving once again that Canada is the best sport-hosting nation in the world. We’re building Canada Strong, from playground to podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada invests in a new home for Canadian basketball

quotes.quote_text: This new Athletic and Community Recreation Hub at Humber Polytechnic will give young people across our community - including Rexdale, Jamestown, Mount Olive-Silverstone-Jamestown, Humber Summit, Smithfield, West Humber-Clairville, and surrounding communities - greater access to year-round sport and recreation, while helping athletes pursue their goals. From playground to podium, this facility will strengthen Etobicoke for years to come.
quotes.speaker: John Zerucelli
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada invests in a new home for Canadian basketball

quotes.quote_text: For more than forty years, Humber Polytechnic has given Canada Basketball's athletes a place to train, today, we lay the permanent foundation for basketball in Canada. It is our objective to be Best in the world, when our teams take to the court, and Best for Canada, in how our sport represents our nation's values. With this historic investment and partnership, we will soon have a home to ensure both of those promises are kept. We are grateful to the Government of Canada for recognizing basketball as a sport of national importance, and to Humber Polytechnic for continuing to help make the game accessible.
quotes.speaker: Michael Bartlett
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada invests in a new home for Canadian basketball

quotes.quote_text: Today’s investment is a significant milestone for Humber, Canada Basketball and the future of sport in Canada. We are deeply grateful to the federal government for their commitment to playground to podium, and their support in bringing this transformative facility to life. As the new home of Canada Basketball and a much-needed community resource, Humber is proud to build on our tradition of athletic excellence while creating a dynamic living laboratory where students can gain hands-on experience through training, applied research and cross-disciplinary collaboration.
quotes.speaker: Ann Marie Vaughan
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong from playground to podium — Government of Canada invests in a new home for Canadian basketball

quotes.quote_text: Canada has a strong, lasting relationship with oceans. The oceans define the culture and identity of our coastal communities and drive economic prosperity for our people. Canada's independent owner-operators, harvesters, and coastal communities are not only economic drivers but also long-standing stewards of our oceans, helping to sustain marine ecosystems for future generations. As host of the 12 th Our Ocean Conference, Canada has an opportunity to showcase its leadership in ocean conservation, sustainable fisheries, ocean science and Indigenous-led stewardship. I look forward to working with Diana Fox Carney on this important conference for Canada.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Minister Thompson announces Ocean Envoy and Chair of Our Ocean Conference

quotes.quote_text: I am honoured to take on the role of Canada’s Ocean Envoy and to help convene the Our Ocean Conference in Halifax. I look forward to working closely with Minister Thompson and to engaging partners from Canada and around the world. The conference will provide an opportunity to deepen cooperation, share knowledge and experience, and secure commitments to ensure healthy and sustainable oceans for future generations.
quotes.speaker: Mme. Diana Fox Carney
quotes.article_title: Minister Thompson announces Ocean Envoy and Chair of Our Ocean Conference

quotes.quote_text: The opening of the Tsē Zūl Camp is a proud moment for the Ross River Dena Council. Our people have a long history with this land, and the impacts of the Faro Mine have been felt by our community for generations. Today, we are seeing a different approach—one where our people are not standing on the sidelines but are participating, building capacity, and creating opportunities from the work happening on our Traditional Territory. Dena Nezziddi Development Corporation’s ownership of this camp is an important step toward greater economic self-determination for our Nation and ensuring that the remediation of Tsē Zūl creates lasting benefits for our citizens. We are proud of what has been accomplished, and we see this as the beginning of an even greater role for Ross River Dena in the work ahead.
quotes.speaker: Dylan Loblaw
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ross River Dena Council celebrate reconciliation in action with Tsē Zūl Camp opening at the Faro Mine Site

quotes.quote_text: I’m honoured to join Chief Dylan Loblaw and the Ross River Dena Council to celebrate the opening of Tsē Zūl Camp. This is an important achievement for the community and demonstrates what can happen when Indigenous leadership, economic opportunity, and major remediation work come together. Congratulations to Dena Nezziddi Development Corporation and everyone who helped make this camp a reality. As work on the Faro Mine Remediation Project advances, Canada will continue working with Ross River Dena Council and our partners to support local jobs, build capacity, and ensure that the benefits of this important work are felt in the North.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Chartrand
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ross River Dena Council celebrate reconciliation in action with Tsē Zūl Camp opening at the Faro Mine Site

quotes.quote_text: By investing in women, we are investing in our future and the world. With 2X Global and FinDev Canada is shaping a more inclusive economy with far-reaching benefits for women and girls that will last for decades to come.
quotes.speaker: Randeep Sarai
quotes.article_title: Canada co-hosts the 2026 2X Global Summit and announces funding for inclusive finance

quotes.quote_text: Canada helped found the 2X Challenge at the G7 in 2018, and we take immense pride in the traction that this global standard has gained. There's no better proof of this traction than bankable deals in emerging markets. These two transactions this week plus our portfolio of gender-lens investments showcase what is possible when we combine international collaboration across development finance and private investors with Canadian leadership.
quotes.speaker: Lori Kerr
quotes.article_title: Canada co-hosts the 2026 2X Global Summit and announces funding for inclusive finance

quotes.quote_text: It’s truly special to bring our community to meet in Canada for this year’s 2X Global Summit. Canada is integral to 2X Global’s origins, from the first 2X Challenge in 2018, and has remained a champion of financing women. I can think of no better place to meet this moment and move forward together.
quotes.speaker: Jessica Espinoza
quotes.article_title: Canada co-hosts the 2026 2X Global Summit and announces funding for inclusive finance

quotes.quote_text: Protecting, restoring, and valuing nature is a foundation of our economy, sovereignty, and well-being. Monitoring and conserving birds contributes to understanding environmental change, assessing the impacts of climate change, and protecting biodiversity. It’s an essential piece to ensure healthy ecosystems for present and future generations.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests $2.6 million to support migratory bird monitoring and conservation programs across the country

quotes.quote_text: From our backyards to our forests, wetlands, and coastlines, birds are an important part of Canada’s biodiversity. They are also powerful indicators of the health of our ecosystems, and monitoring their populations helps us understand how nature is changing. Data from this initiative will inform conservation efforts across Canada and help us take action to protect birds and the habitats they depend on. Through A Force of Nature: Canada’s Strategy to Protect Nature, we are building the knowledge we need to protect nature and deliver lasting results for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Nathalie Provost
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests $2.6 million to support migratory bird monitoring and conservation programs across the country

quotes.quote_text: Canadians have a special fondness for migratory birds. From our smallest community parks to our largest national parks, birds are part of the landscapes and places we cherish. I am inspired by the leadership of citizen scientists and organizations like Birds Canada that are helping build a stronger, more nature-positive future.
quotes.speaker: Wade Grant
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests $2.6 million to support migratory bird monitoring and conservation programs across the country

quotes.quote_text: This five-year agreement with Environment and Climate Change Canada empowers tens of thousands of Canadians to make meaningful contributions to nature conservation. The scientific evidence collected by these skilled volunteers will help conserve and steward important habitats so that the birds we love can thrive.
quotes.speaker: Patrick Nadeau
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests $2.6 million to support migratory bird monitoring and conservation programs across the country

quotes.quote_text: I look forward to joining my negotiating teams in India and the Philippines for the ASEAN Economic Ministers–Canada Consultations, as we build momentum and work towards concluding trade agreements with each of these partners. India, ASEAN, and the Philippines are among the fastest-growing economies in the world. I will be meeting with government and business leaders to strengthen our trade relationships and attract new investment to Canada. We already have preferential access to a market of 1.5 billion consumers, and by concluding agreements with these partners, we will double that reach to 3 billion.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canada advances trade talks on agreements with India, ASEAN, and the Philippines

quotes.quote_text: Canadian pork is recognized around the world for its high standards of quality, safety and production. This investment will support the sector’s ability to strengthen its position in international markets, create new opportunities for Canadian producers and processors, and contribute to a strong and resilient food system.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald announces support for the growth of Canadian pork in international markets

quotes.quote_text: Canada Pork greatly appreciates the Government of Canada's partnership investing in the future of our industry. Support through Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada's AgriMarketing Program helps put Canadian pork at the center of the plate both in Canada and around the world. Diversification is core to Canada Pork's mandate, and this investment helps us build and maintain international markets, reach new global customers, and keep our industry strong at home.
quotes.speaker: Hans Kristensen
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald announces support for the growth of Canadian pork in international markets

quotes.quote_text: Building a strong Canada starts with building strong communities. Every child deserves a community where they can play, make friends, try new things and simply enjoy being a kid. For children living with cancer or serious illness, Campfire Circle makes that possible while giving families the reassurance that the medical support they need is close by. This investment will help create a place where kids can make memories and experience the joy of camp, making a real difference for them and their families.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in healthcare infrastructure for kids

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is building infrastructure at a speed and scale not seen in generations – the type of infrastructure projects that support stronger, safer, more connected communities across the country. Investing in projects like Campfire Circle Overnight Camp is vital for the well-being of our communities and our children. I am thrilled to see this investment in Campfire Circle, and am honoured that they’ve chosen Prince Edward County to create a haven for children and families who are facing one of life’s most daunting challenges. This investment helps ensure children facing a serious illness will still have an opportunity to enjoy the simple, but oh so special pleasure of just being a kid.
quotes.speaker: Chris Malette
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in healthcare infrastructure for kids

quotes.quote_text: For 43 years, Campfire Circle has created camp experiences for children with cancer or serious illness and their families, combining expert medical care with joy, connection, and a sense of belonging during some of life’s most difficult moments. As the only medical camp in Canada that can administer IV chemotherap y and blood transfusions on site, we are incredibly grateful for this historic investment. It will help expand access to our unique model of medical care, play, and community, ensuring more children and families across eastern Ontario can experience the transformative impact of camp, sooner.
quotes.speaker: Alex Robertson
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in healthcare infrastructure for kids

quotes.quote_text: Controlled environment agriculture is key to building a resilient, stable food system in Canada. This investment in Kinghaven Farms' innovative greenhouse technology will boost local production, reduce reliance on imports and ensure Canadians have reliable access to high-quality, locally grown greens year-round. This project strengthens food security and reinforces Canada as a leader in sustainable agricultural practices.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald announces support toward innovative technologies at greenhouse in King City

quotes.quote_text: Ontario is a leader in Canada's agriculture and agri-food sector, and innovative operations like Kinghaven Farms are helping show what the future of food production can look like. This investment will support cutting-edge greenhouse technology that strengthens local production, creates a more reliable supply of fresh produce year-round, and helps position Ontario at the forefront of agricultural innovation.
quotes.speaker: Michael Ma
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald announces support toward innovative technologies at greenhouse in King City

quotes.quote_text: We're honoured to receive support through the AgriInnovate Program as we continue advancing the automation and climate-control technologies behind Haven Greens. This investment will help us further strengthen local food resilience and bring more fresh, sustainably grown produce to Canadians year-round, while continuing to push what's possible for controlled-environment agriculture domestically.
quotes.speaker: Jay Willmot
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald announces support toward innovative technologies at greenhouse in King City

quotes.quote_text: These are exciting times for Peepeekisis, as this project represents another step toward sovereignty. For years, our community has needed a facility where we can come together to celebrate the lives of our loved ones, and today's grand opening brings us one step closer to that goal. We are grateful for ISC's support with this funeral home project and look forward to collaborating with ISC on future opportunities. This facility is inspired by our First Nation heritage, but we aim for it to be accessible to everyone. Peepeekisis is unique in that we embrace a diverse range of races, cultures, and religions, and our community has always been welcoming to all.
quotes.speaker: Chief Francis Dieter
quotes.article_title: Peepeekisis Cree Nation opens first Indigenous owned funeral home in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: Losing someone you love is one of the hardest moments a family can go through. Being able to say goodbye close to home, surrounded by your community, your culture, and the people who know you, matters. This new funeral home will give families that space while creating jobs and building an Indigenous-owned business that will serve the community for years to come. Congratulations to Chief Dieter and Peepeekisis Cree Nation on making this vision a reality.
quotes.speaker: Mandy Gull-Masty
quotes.article_title: Peepeekisis Cree Nation opens first Indigenous owned funeral home in Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: We have heard from our territorial partners and northern firearm owners on the critical need for a northern Chief Firearms Officer to better respond to the needs of northern communities regarding geography, governance and cultural sensitivity. This appointment will not only improve services in the territories, but also promote community and firearms safety.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada creates a dedicated Chief Firearms Officer to serve northerners

quotes.quote_text: A dedicated northern Chief Firearms Officer will bring greater awareness of the unique needs and perspectives of northern communities. This role will help strengthen relationships, enhance responsiveness and support services that reflect the realities and priorities of the North.
quotes.speaker: Brendan Hanley
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada creates a dedicated Chief Firearms Officer to serve northerners

quotes.quote_text: Whether you live in a large city or a rural community, you should be able to count on reliable transportation to get where you need to go. In Pemberton, this investment will help strengthen local and regional transit and better connect people to work, school, health care and essential services. The Government of Canada is investing more than $10.6 million across British Columbia to support a wide range of projects that reflect the unique transportation needs of rural and Indigenous communities.
quotes.speaker: Patrick Weiler
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in rural transit projects for communities across British Columbia

quotes.quote_text: We are thrilled to receive this funding and to move forward with the next phase of the Multi-Modal Transportation Hub. This investment will enhance how people move throughout the Pemberton Valley by making transit more accessible, supporting active transportation, and creating a welcoming space for residents and visitors. These improvements will strengthen connections throughout the region and contribute to a more accessible, sustainable, and resilient transportation network for years to come. We are grateful to our funding partners for helping bring this vision to life.
quotes.speaker: Mike Richman
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in rural transit projects for communities across British Columbia

quotes.quote_text: Young people are crucial to Northern Ontario’s future. These internships will help youth gain valuable experience and develop the confidence they need to succeed in the workforce. By connecting talented young people with local employers, we are helping them build rewarding careers close to home while contributing to the future of their communities
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests $835,777 to create youth employment and accelerate economic development in Northern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: Northern Ontario thrives when we can attract and keep talented young people living and working in the region. Through this project and many others just like it, we’re giving Indigenous youth the chance to gain hands-on experience, while helping local employers grow and innovate. Everyone wins — young professionals launch their careers, and our communities and businesses gain access to skilled workers with the energy they need to succeed in a competitive economy.
quotes.speaker: Sean Spenrath
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests $835,777 to create youth employment and accelerate economic development in Northern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s AI advantage starts with our people, our researchers and our entrepreneurs. At ALL IN, we brought those strengths together with new investments and international partnerships that will help Canadian businesses adopt AI, support the development of safer systems and create new opportunities for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: AI leadership takes centre stage at ALL IN 2026

quotes.quote_text: Canadian researchers and entrepreneurs are at the forefront of some of the world’s most exciting advances in AI. Through investments in innovation, commercialization and talent, the government is helping Canadian companies grow, compete globally and turn breakthrough ideas into economic opportunities. ALL IN, an initiative of Scale AI, one of Canada’s global innovation clusters, demonstrates why Canada remains a destination of choice for AI investment and innovation.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: AI leadership takes centre stage at ALL IN 2026

quotes.quote_text: Canada and Germany are strong partners. At ALL IN, we further deepened our close cooperation. The merger of Cohere and Aleph Alpha and the financing commitments and collaboration with LawZero clearly demonstrate that our shared path leads to AI that is safe, builds trust and benefits our citizens and businesses.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Karsten Wildberger
quotes.speaker_title: Germany’s Federal Minister for Digital Transformation and Government Modernisation
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: AI leadership takes centre stage at ALL IN 2026

quotes.quote_text: Young people want the opportunity to contribute and be part of building a stronger Canada for future generations. By helping more young Canadians pursue careers in skilled trades, we are opening the door to meaningful work that will help build the homes, infrastructure and major projects Canada needs. The next generation has an important role to play in shaping Canada's future, and we want to ensure they have the opportunity to be part of that work.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Minister Hajdu outlines progress in implementing Team Canada Strong to recruit, train, and hire the next generation of skilled trades workers

quotes.quote_text: A strong life sciences sector is essential to protecting the health and security of Canadians while supporting economic growth, jobs and innovation. We are investing in the research, industrial capacity and cutting-edge solutions that will improve the lives of Canadians, respond to emerging threats and strengthen Canada’s resilience and competitiveness for future generations.
quotes.speaker: Mélanie Joly
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces major contribution to strengthen Canada’s dual-use life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: The health care and life sciences sector is one of the fastest-growing in the country. Canada stands at a pivotal moment and is strengthening its sovereignty and its position as a global leader in the life sciences. We are creating opportunities for researchers, industry leaders and workers for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces major contribution to strengthen Canada’s dual-use life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s life sciences sector drives innovation well beyond health care. We are investing in dual-use technologies that protect Canadians and the forces who serve them, support economic growth, and grow a resilient and competitive defence industrial base. This is how we build sovereign capability at home, create well-paying jobs for Canadians and reinforce Canada’s health security, sovereignty and defence capacity.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada announces major contribution to strengthen Canada’s dual-use life sciences sector

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s story is built on the journeys of generations of people who have made this country home. The Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21 plays an important role in preserving and sharing those experiences. I am pleased to welcome Mr. Quan-Watson as Chair as the Museum continues to preserve and share the experiences that have helped shape Canada.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Minister Miller announces appointment of Daniel Quan-Watson as the next Chairperson of the Board of Trustees of the Canadian Museum of Immigration at Pier 21

quotes.quote_text: In the face of global uncertainty, Canada is building strength at home. The Deep Geological Repository Project is the type of strategic, nat ion-b uilding infrastructure that can strengthen Canada's clean energy future, support investment, and provide lasting benefits for Indigenous communities and future generations. The publication of this notice reflects our commitment to transparency, consultation, and responsible decision-making as we consider projects that are in the national interest.
quotes.speaker: Dominic LeBlanc
quotes.speaker_title: President, da-, U.S., Trade, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy
quotes.article_title: Canada takes next step in potential listing of Deep Geological Repository project under Building Canada Act

quotes.quote_text: Canada is a Ti er 1 nuclear nation and bringing that leadership into the 21 st century under our Nuclear Energy Strategy means managing every part of the nuclear fuel cycle – so we can not only build big things, but do it safely. The proposed Deep Geological Repository Project would support the lo ng-te rm sustainability of Canada's nuclear sector, strengthen energy security, and create lasting economic opportunities for local communities and across Ontario and beyond. As this process moves forward, we remain committed to meaningful Indigenous engagement, public participation, and rigorous decis ion-maki ng on behalf of Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Canada takes next step in potential listing of Deep Geological Repository project under Building Canada Act

quotes.quote_text: Our government is strengthening the forest sector in the face of U.S. tariffs, helping workers gain new skills and supporting businesses as they modernize and diversify their products. Today’s support to Conifex continues our government’s steadfast defence of Canada’s forest sector by protecting the livelihoods of those living in Mackenzie, while we position our industry to focus on more reliable markets.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada commits financial support to Conifex Timber Inc.

quotes.quote_text: Our softwood lumber industry is facing real challenges, and our government is making sure Canada meets them with resilience. Through these targeted supports, our government is protecting jobs and communities, and ensuring Canadian lumber companies can compete and succeed amidst uncertain times.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada commits financial support to Conifex Timber Inc.

quotes.quote_text: During my visit to multiple cities across southern Ontario, I saw firsthand how Canada’s agriculture and agri-food sector is one of our country’s greatest economic opportunities. By investing in food production and processing, supporting innovation, strengthening supply chains and opening new markets, we can create more opportunities for farmers, producers, and businesses across Canada. That means a stronger food system, stronger economy and ultimately more choice, more control, more Canada.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald concludes tour of southern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: Across Canada, Black organizations and community leaders are doing incredible work to support families, create opportunities, and strengthen their communities. The Black Canadian Communities Program builds on that leadership by investing in community-driven solutions that help remove barriers and create a more inclusive and prosperous future for Black Canadians and for all Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada launches Black Canadian Communities Program

quotes.quote_text: A strong agricultural sector depends on the well-being of its workforce. This investment provides farmers, their families, and farm workers with the tools, training, and resources they need to stay safe on the job every day. Reducing on-farm risks protects lives and builds a more sustainable future for Canadian agriculture.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in safety on Canadian farms

quotes.quote_text: Canadian farmers are critical to our economic success and a key part of our national food security. Keeping farm families safe in support of the work they do is critical. By investing in practical safety resources, we are helping protect the people who work tirelessly to keep food on our tables. It gives producers the confidence they need to run their operations while keeping safety at the forefront.
quotes.speaker: Ben Carr
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in safety on Canadian farms

quotes.quote_text: At CASA, we know that meaningful progress in agricultural safety requires collaboration and sustained investment. We are incredibly grateful for the support of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada, through the AgriCompetitiveness program. This funding commitment enables us to deliver programs and resources that help prevent injuries, save lives, and strengthen the safety culture across Canada's agricultural sector. Together, we are creating a Canada where no one is harmed in agriculture.
quotes.speaker: Sandra Miller
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in safety on Canadian farms

quotes.quote_text: Canada has what the world wants, and better geoscience data will help us unlock our full potential — and with today’s announcement, our work is only just getting started. By making Canada’s geological data easier to access and use, we are leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to reduce exploration risk, catalyze investment and accelerate the development of critical minerals projects.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Canada advances the Canadian Digital Core Library with new funding and the start of core scanning

quotes.quote_text: As global demand for critical minerals grows, the Northwest Territories is ready to play a larger role in supplying the resources Canada and its allies need. The first core scanned through the Canadian Digital Core Library initiative came from the Northwest Territories, helping unlock geological data that supports investment, exploration and responsible resource development.
quotes.speaker: Caitlin Cleveland
quotes.speaker_title: Northwest Territories Minister of Industry, Tourism and Investment
quotes.article_title: Canada advances the Canadian Digital Core Library with new funding and the start of core scanning

quotes.quote_text: This investment will provide new data from mineral exploration cores stored in Regina and will make Saskatchewan’s geological data more accessible and useful, supporting exploration, innovation and investment across the province. Saskatchewan will continue to work with partners to build a modern digital library that showcases Saskatchewan’s resource potential to the world.
quotes.speaker: Chris Beaudry
quotes.speaker_title: Saskatchewan’s Minister of Energy and Resources
quotes.article_title: Canada advances the Canadian Digital Core Library with new funding and the start of core scanning

quotes.quote_text: Canada has generations of valuable geological information stored in drill core across the country. The Canadian Digital Core Library is about bringing that information above ground and into the digital age. By turning physical core into high-quality digital data, we can give geoscientists, explorers and investors new ways to understand Canada’s mineral potential and identify opportunities that will drive our economy for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Claude Guay
quotes.article_title: Canada advances the Canadian Digital Core Library with new funding and the start of core scanning

quotes.quote_text: Farm and Food Awareness Week is an opportunity to recognize the farmers, producers and food workers who help put safe, high-quality food on our tables every day. The Government of Canada is proud to work with Manitoba and partners across the country to support a strong, resilient, and innovative food system, and agriculture and agri-food sector.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Governments of Canada and Manitoba celebrate local food and agriculture awareness

quotes.quote_text: Farm and Food Awareness Week is a chance to celebrate the people who grow and produce our food and the communities that support them. Agriculture is an important part of Manitoba’s economy and our communities, and choosing local food helps strengthen those connections.
quotes.speaker: Ron Kostyshyn
quotes.article_title: Governments of Canada and Manitoba celebrate local food and agriculture awareness

quotes.quote_text: Canadians expect us to create jobs and grow the economy while protecting the environment and advancing reconciliation through meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. This project demonstrates how we can achieve those objectives through a rigorous assessment process, substantive Indigenous participation, and strong environmental safeguards.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Major Milestone Completed

quotes.quote_text: This decision sends a clear signal that, through a "one project, one review" with B.C., Canada can efficiently and responsibly develop the infrastructure we need to strengthen our economy, reduce emissions, and enhance our energy security. By advancing projects that meet high environmental standards and are rooted in Indigenous consultation, we can deliver tangible benefits to all Canadians on a timeline that builds Canada Strong.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Major Milestone Completed

quotes.quote_text: My discussions with Minister Goyal this week are driving real progress toward an agreement that will double our two-way trade to $70 billion by 2030. India's rapid growth and Canada's advantage in energy, critical minerals, aerospace, AI and more mean enormous potential for our businesses and workers. By expanding our trade and investment relationship, we can diversify our exports and unlock new opportunities in one of the world's largest economies.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Canada advances trade talks on comprehensive economic partnership agreement with India

quotes.quote_text: Our National Action Plan on Combatting Auto Theft is delivering results. The continued decline in auto theft demonstrates what can be achieved through coordinated action and strong partnerships between governments, law enforcement agencies and industry partners. Our government remains committed to disrupting organized crime, preventing vehicle theft, and ensuring our response remains strong, coordinated and effective.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada reports on continued progress in fight against auto theft

quotes.quote_text: Canada is a country of high standards, but high standards do not require slow decisions. Our government is bringing speed, certainty, and predictability to how we build, so investors know that when Canada says it wants something built, Canadians will get it built. In a more uncertain world, we will control our own future.
quotes.speaker: Mark Carney
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada introduces legislation to transform how Canada builds

quotes.quote_text: Canada is building big and creating certainty for a stronger, more competitive, and independent Canadian economy. We have already begun by accelerating major nation building projects through the Major Projects Office, and now we will apply the same efficiency more broadly through this Act. Our standards are simple: one project, one review, one year.
quotes.speaker: Dominic LeBlanc
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada introduces legislation to transform how Canada builds

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s success depends on growing our economy and getting Canadian products to global markets efficiently and affordably. By modernizing our transportation system and reducing red tape, we are helping move goods more quickly, strengthening supply chains, attracting investment, and reinforcing Canada’s position as a reliable trading partner. These measures would help create jobs, support businesses, and build a stronger economy for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada introduces legislation to transform how Canada builds

quotes.quote_text: Strong labour relations are essential to the success of Canadian workers, businesses and our economy. As workplaces continue to evolve, our labour laws must keep pace to ensure workers are protected and workplaces remain fair and safe. This legislation will protect the right to strike while reinforcing the responsibility of unions and employers to negotiate in good faith, helping ensure workers and employers can continue to navigate challenges together.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada introduces legislation to transform how Canada builds

quotes.quote_text: Canadians expect us to build the projects that grow our economy while protecting the environment and advancing reconciliation through meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. This legislation maintains rigorous assessments and strong environmental safeguards while giving proponents the certainty they need to invest, including in the clean energy projects that are a building block of a net zero economy.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada introduces legislation to transform how Canada builds

quotes.quote_text: We’re strengthening Canada’s sport system by getting much-needed resources quickly to National Sport Organizations so they can put them in motion. For Wheelchair Basketball Canada, this means fewer barriers to participation, more support for Canadian athletes from playground to podium, and additional investment to host world-class competition, right here at home. The IWBF World Championships were made possible by coaches, volunteers, athletes and families who gave so much to make them happen. Congratulations to our men’s and women’s teams on an amazing showing, and to everyone who helped make these championships a success. You gave Canadians so much to be proud of.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces over $1 million in new funding for Wheelchair Basketball

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada’s support has been an important part of making these Championships possible, but our partnership goes well beyond this event. For Wheelchair Basketball Canada, working with the federal government has meant having a shared commitment to growing the sport of wheelchair basketball, creating opportunities for Canadians with disabilities, and showing what is possible when we invest in high-performance and inclusive sport. Hosting the World Championships in Ottawa is a tremendous opportunity to showcase wheelchair basketball on the world stage and to create a lasting legacy here at home. We are grateful for the Government of Canada’s investment and, just as importantly, for its continued partnership as we work together to grow the sport and create more opportunities for Canadians to experience the power of sport.
quotes.speaker: Wendy Gittens
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces over $1 million in new funding for Wheelchair Basketball

quotes.quote_text: Global conflict and supply disruptions are driving up fuel prices around the world, and Canadians are feeling the impact when they drive to work, take their kids to activities, or transport goods across the country. By extending the federal fuel tax suspension, we’re saving Canadians $5 on a typical 50-litre fill-up while helping farmers, truckers, builders, and businesses manage higher costs.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: Minister Champagne introduces legislation to extend the federal fuel excise tax relief for Canadians

quotes.quote_text: The agreement with Empire removes barriers to competition and will support new entry and increased competition from retailers selling everyday essential items. The Bureau is committed to identifying and addressing barriers that limit competition across the food supply chain so that Canadians see the benefits of competition in the form of lower prices, greater choice and increased innovation.
quotes.speaker: Jeanne Pratt
quotes.article_title: Competition Bureau reaches agreement with Sobeys’ parent company Empire to address grocery property controls

quotes.quote_text: The response to our Responsible Data Centre Development Principles has been overwhelmingly positive. With 19 additional organizations signing on, the industry is sending a clear message: Canada can build the digital infrastructure needed for AI growth while protecting communities, supporting ratepayers and delivering lasting economic benefits. If we don’t build it here, we’ll have to buy it from someone else. These principles ensure Canada expands its compute capacity responsibly, transparently and in a way that earns Canadians’ trust.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada welcomes 19 additional signatories to Canada’s Responsible Data Centre Development Principles

quotes.quote_text: Canada Army Run showcases the people who make the Canadian Army what it is today. From Canadian Army members to families, volunteers, and supporters, this event brings Canadians together in a shared demonstration of support to those who serve. Thank you to everyone who participated and helped make this year's event such a tremendous success.
quotes.speaker: Lieutenant-General Michael Wright
quotes.article_title: Canada Army Run 2026: Bringing Canadians Together in Support of the People Behind the Army

quotes.quote_text: Canada Army Run demonstrates the strong bond between Canadians and their Army. It is inspiring to see people of all ages and backgrounds come together to support military members and their families, learn more about our profession, and celebrate the Army we are building to meet current and future challenge.
quotes.speaker: Chief Warrant Officer Christopher Robin
quotes.article_title: Canada Army Run 2026: Bringing Canadians Together in Support of the People Behind the Army

quotes.quote_text: Canada is using every tool at its disposal, including targeted sanctions, to respond to the Iranian regime’s abhorrent conduct—from threatening international peace and security to committing pervasive human rights violations. My message to the Iranian people is clear: Canada stands firmly with you in your pursuit of human rights, dignity and a better future.
quotes.speaker: Anita Anand
quotes.article_title: Minister Anand announces additional sanctions against Iranian individuals and entities

quotes.quote_text: Today we are realizing, with this addition to our reserve, the results of over 36 years of discussions between the Crowns and the Pays Plat First Nation. Our community is sitting on the verge of an economic and housing boom. Many of our members have been waiting for this expansion to begin their return to our amazing community. The prosperity that is to come will engage our youth and protect our elders. Pays Plat will soon manage its own lands as part of the Lands Management First Nations Group. The control of our land code signals a growth in our self-government and self-determination. Miigwetch to all who made this day possible.
quotes.speaker: Chief David Mushquash
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Pays Plat First Nation marks milestone with new addition to reserve lands

quotes.quote_text: Reflecting years of work and a shared commitment to moving this agreement forward, we mark an important milestone, grounded in partnership. The addition to reserve for Pays Plat First Nation provides the clarity and certainty needed to continue their community's vision of economic growth and development, well into the future.
quotes.speaker: Greg Rickford
quotes.speaker_title: Ontario Minister of Indigenous Affairs and First Nations Economic Reconciliation
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Pays Plat First Nation marks milestone with new addition to reserve lands

quotes.quote_text: Today, we reaffirmed our strong partnership with Pays Plat First Nation and our shared commitment to advancing reconciliation through meaningful action. Completing this major addition to Pays Plat's land base is a testament to the value of collaboration and to what can be achieved when First Nations and governments work together. I am proud to mark this important milestone with the community and look forward to continuing our work together in the spirit of partnership and respect.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Alty
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Pays Plat First Nation marks milestone with new addition to reserve lands

quotes.quote_text: For Pays Plat First Nation, these 4,203 acres mean room to build homes, create new economic opportunities and welcome more members home. After decades of work to reach this point, I congratulate the Nation on this achievement and am proud to see it gain more land to pursue its own priorities and build the future it sees for its community. This is self-determination in action, and I'm excited to see what Pays Plat builds from here.
quotes.speaker: Mandy Gull-Masty
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Pays Plat First Nation marks milestone with new addition to reserve lands

quotes.quote_text: The addition of these lands marks an important milestone for Pays Plat First Nation. A larger land base will support the community's vision for more housing, stronger families, and new opportunities for future growth. Canada remains committed to working in partnership with First Nations to help build healthy, resilient communities where families can thrive.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, and Member of Parliament for Thunder Bay—Superior North
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Pays Plat First Nation marks milestone with new addition to reserve lands

quotes.quote_text: Every Canadian deserves a place to call home. That is why our new government is taking decisive action to protect affordable rental housing through the Canada Rental Protection Fund, helping preserve affordable homes and ensuring more Canadians can remain in their communities.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces the launch of the Canada Rental Protection Fund

quotes.quote_text: The Canada Rental Protection Fund reflects the Government’s commitment to safeguarding affordable housing while ensuring strong stewardship of public funds. By investing in a sector-led model, we are supporting an independent organization with the expertise and capacity needed to act quickly in competitive markets. We are confident the Canadian Housing Acquisition Fund will generate meaningful and lasting results for Canadians by protecting the homes they rely on.
quotes.speaker: Ana Bailão
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces the launch of the Canada Rental Protection Fund

quotes.quote_text: This is about more than protecting the affordability we have today, it’s about growing the community housing sector for the future. Every home acquired becomes part of Canada’s community housing stock for the long term, creating lasting affordability and a stronger foundation for communities across the country.
quotes.speaker: Ray Sullivan
quotes.speaker_title: Board Chair, Canadian Housing Acquisition Fund
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces the launch of the Canada Rental Protection Fund

quotes.quote_text: At the ASEAN Economic Ministers’ Meeting, we have advanced our negotiations towards Free Trade Agreements with ASEAN and the Philippines. Agreements with both will expand opportunities for our exporters in this key region and create more well-paying jobs at home. Securing greater access to these key markets is how we will double our non-U.S. exports over the next decade. That is $300 billion in more trade and new orders for Canadian resources, industries, and talent, to build a more diversified, resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Minister Sidhu strengthens Canada’s trade and investment ties with Association of Southeast Asian Nations

quotes.quote_text: The rising price of gas is a major concern for Canadians and even a small increase at the pump can have a significant impact on the daily costs we all pay. That's why it is essential that fuel retailers compete independently and vigorously. Protecting healthier competition in the retail gasoline industry benefits Canadians through lower prices and greater choice.
quotes.speaker: Jeanne Pratt
quotes.article_title: Competition Bureau secures agreement with Kalibrate to protect competition in the retail gas industry

quotes.quote_text: Terry Fox's legacy reminds us that Canadian discoveries can achieve extraordinary global impact. Today, on World Cancer Research Day, we honour that legacy through new investment and bold ambition. This funding will support the Institute's work on precision oncology research. Most importantly, this funding is providing hope to everyone affected by the disease.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.article_title: Investing in precision oncology research to enhance equitable access across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Many of us have been impacted by cancer in our lives. Cancer research, such as the work being done by the Terry Fox Research Institute and the Marathon of Hope Cancer Centres Network, is a crucial part of our efforts to find better, more effective treatments for patients. Together with the TFRI and the Network, we are working toward better treatment and improved survival rates for people with cancer. Let’s Finish It.
quotes.speaker: Mona Fortier
quotes.article_title: Investing in precision oncology research to enhance equitable access across Canada

quotes.quote_text: We are deeply grateful to the Government of Canada and fellow Canadians for continuing to trust and invest in Terry Fox's bold vision. This new funding is designed to build upon our national strategy to accelerate discoveries and bring more personalized cancer care to patients across the country—no matter who they are or where they live.
quotes.speaker: Jim Woodgett
quotes.article_title: Investing in precision oncology research to enhance equitable access across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Back in 2019, we said the Marathon of Hope Cancer Centres Network represented an opportunity worthy of Terry's name. Today, this renewed investment is a powerful affirmation of what has been built: researchers, clinicians, patients, and institutions across Canada working together toward a shared goal. Terry said the Marathon of Hope must continue without him. He would be incredibly proud to see Canadians continuing his marathon in this collaborative and determined way, and to see the progress being made toward better outcomes for people with cancer.
quotes.speaker: Darrell Fox
quotes.speaker_title: on behalf of the Fox family, Senior Advisor
quotes.article_title: Investing in precision oncology research to enhance equitable access across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Building a more equal Canada means making sure everyone has the opportunity to contribute, lead and succeed. Civil Society Organizations bring valuable experience and perspectives to this work. By joining Canada’s delegation to UNCSW 71, representatives can help bring Canadian voices to the global stage, share ideas and best practices, and advance solutions that break down barriers and create more opportunities for women and girls. Together, we can help build a stronger, more inclusive Canada where everyone has the opportunity to reach their full potential.
quotes.speaker: Rechie Valdez
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez launches call for Civil Society Organization Representatives to join the Canadian Delegation to the 71st Session of the United Nations Commission on the Status of Women

quotes.quote_text: Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity is a cornerstone of Alberta’s cultural landscape. For generations, it has inspired artists, welcomed visitors from around the world, and contributed to the vitality of communities and local economies. Through this investment, our government is helping the Banff Centre modernize its operations and enhance the visitor experience, ensuring it can continue to showcase Alberta’s creativity, attract talent, and create opportunities for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Eleanor Olszewski
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity to optimize operations

quotes.quote_text: As Banff Centre looks toward its 100th anniversary in 2033, strong foundational systems are essential to our long-term success. We are deeply grateful to the Government of Canada and PrairiesCan for this investment, which will modernize our operations, enhance the experience of our audiences and participants, and help ensure Banff Centre continues to thrive for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Chris Lorway
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports Banff Centre for Arts and Creativity to optimize operations

quotes.quote_text: As Minister of Justice, I have the authority under the Criminal Code to order a new trial or appeal when new evidence shows a miscarriage of justice likely occurred. My decision does not decide guilt or innocence, as that will rest with the courts. Our responsibility is to make sure Canadians can trust their justice system, and that means, in rare cases, returning cases to the courts for new information to be considered.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Minister of Justice orders new appeal in Saskatchewan case following conviction review

quotes.quote_text: I have seen first-hand how the CBSA works to keep illegal firearms from entering Canada and threatening the safety of our communities. Through active border enforcement, CBSA officers are disrupting criminal activity and protecting Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: CBSA investigation leads to firearm seizures and conspiracy charges in Essex County, Ontario

quotes.quote_text: This arrest and criminal charges are the result of a lengthy investigation by investigators with CBSA’s Ontario Firearms Smuggling Enforcement Team, following the initial seizure by border services officers. This dedicated team is disrupting the inventory of illegal firearms in Canada.
quotes.speaker: Trishann Pascal
quotes.article_title: CBSA investigation leads to firearm seizures and conspiracy charges in Essex County, Ontario

quotes.quote_text: In a more uncertain world, Canada is diversifying its trade and building stronger relationships with trusted and reliable partners, like Europe. The world needs energy, and Atlantic Canada has the natural power, expertise, and technology to help deliver it. By connecting our companies with new customers across the Atlantic, we’re building a stronger clean energy sector, opening new markets abroad, and creating more opportunities for Atlantic Canadians here at home.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Canadian companies tap into Europe’s growing wind energy market

quotes.quote_text: Atlantic Canada has the expertise to play a leading role in the global clean energy economy. WindEnergy Hamburg provides a valuable platform for Atlantic Canadian companies to showcase their capabilities, products and services, while taking part in important conversations and building relationships with international partners. econext is proud to lead this mission in partnership with Marine Renewables Canada (MRC) to help support the growth of Canada's clean energy sector and economy.
quotes.speaker: Laura Barron
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Canadian companies tap into Europe’s growing wind energy market

quotes.quote_text: WindEnergy Hamburg provides an important opportunity for Canadian companies to connect with the global wind industry, showcase the expertise they’ve developed across marine and offshore sectors, and build relationships in international markets. Our partnership with econext allows us to bring companies from across Atlantic Canada to WindEnergy Hamburg to build international relationships, share knowledge and explore new business opportunities. These connections will be valuable as Canada develops its own offshore wind market.
quotes.speaker: Amanda White
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Canadian companies tap into Europe’s growing wind energy market

quotes.quote_text: The trading of ITMOs under the Paris Agreement can unlock greater global climate action by making it easier to transfer emission reductions and removals between countries. This is about turning our natural advantages and homegrown climate innovation into investment, good jobs, and new export opportunities. A clear framework for international carbon credit transfers can help Canadian companies scale, attract capital, and bring more innovative technologies to market, strengthening our position as a leader in the global clean economy.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Federal Government developing framework for greater international cooperation on carbon markets

quotes.quote_text: Women entrepreneurs are essential to building the strongest economy in the G7. When women have the financing, networks and support they need to grow their businesses, they create jobs, strengthen communities and help grow Canada’s economy. Through the Women Entrepreneurship Strategy, we are helping more women turn their ideas into successful businesses and ensuring they have the opportunity to contribute fully to Canada’s economic strength.
quotes.speaker: Rechie Valdez
quotes.dept_en: Innovation, Science and Economic Development Canada
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez launches call for proposals for the Women Entrepreneurship Strategy Ecosystem Fund

quotes.quote_text: With every new or expanded air transport agreement we are paving the way for more convenient travel and exciting new opportunities for investment, trade, and international collaboration. I’m so pleased to see this enhanced cooperation between Canada and Vietnam, a growing market with a rich culture and history.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: The federal government announces the beginning of direct flights between Canada and Vietnam

quotes.quote_text: Vietnam is one of Canada's most dynamic trading partners in Southeast Asia. Our merchandise exports to Vietnam reached over $1.3 billion in 2025, up 30% from the year before. By expanding our air transport agreement, we're making it easier for people and goods to move between our countries, opening new doors for businesses and diversifying Canada’s trade.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: The federal government announces the beginning of direct flights between Canada and Vietnam

quotes.quote_text: Investing in rail safety is one way we are helping keep Canada’s communities safe. By supporting these projects, we are advancing practical initiatives that raise awareness, encourage safe behaviour, and help reduce the risks of fatalities and injuries while keeping our supply chains moving.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in keeping Canadians safe near railway crossings

quotes.quote_text: “Canada’s approach to defence procurement must deliver more than military equipment. It must defend Canadians while strengthening our economy, growing Canadian industrial capacity, and opening new opportunities for Canadian companies to compete globally. The term sheet agreement reflects the principles of the DIS by pursuing partnerships that support Canadian jobs, innovation, and long-term economic growth while ensuring we acquire capabilities from trusted partners when they are needed”.
quotes.speaker: Stephen Fuhr
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada takes next step to defend Canadians by delivering mission-critical capability to the Royal Canadian Air Force

quotes.quote_text: Entering into this agreement is an important and tangible step forward in our ongoing efforts to equip the Royal Canadian Air Force with the modern capabilities it needs to support operations. By engaging early with industry we can tap into their expertise, innovation, and experience, while supporting key pillars of the Defence Industrial Strategy. Together, we are advancing a capability that will strengthen our security and deliver value for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada takes next step to defend Canadians by delivering mission-critical capability to the Royal Canadian Air Force

quotes.quote_text: An Airborne Early Warning and Control capability will significantly strengthen Canada’s ability to detect, track, and respond to threats to our territory and approaches. Beyond the capability itself, AEWC is about building the future Air and Space Force that Canada requires in an increasingly complex security environment. It will be a key enabler of integration across our modernized force, connecting platforms, sensors, and decision-makers to provide a more complete operational picture and improve our ability to act with speed and confidence. We value the collaborative work underway with Saab as we continue to examine solutions to help meet Canada’s evolving defence needs and support the future readiness of the RCAF.
quotes.speaker: Lieutenant-General Jamie Speiser-Blanchet
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada takes next step to defend Canadians by delivering mission-critical capability to the Royal Canadian Air Force

quotes.quote_text: Last year, I asked seven Atlantic Canadian leaders to take an honest look at our economy and tell us the hard truths, not simply what we wanted to hear. This report is their answer. Atlantic Canada has real momentum, but momentum alone will not deliver the prosperity we want for the region. The next step is to identify where we can move quickly, where we need to act together as a region, and where businesses and other partners need to lead. This report should not sit on a shelf. It should challenge all of us to raise our ambition for Atlantic Canada.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Economic Panel unveils blueprint for Atlantic Canada’s future

quotes.quote_text: A strong country is built on strong communities. This report shows that we need to do more to strengthen the Atlantic Canada economic region and unlock growth and investment. Now is the time to build on this momentum and work together to help businesses in the Atlantic region forge connections, grow, and build a more competitive regional economy.
quotes.speaker: Dominic LeBlanc
quotes.speaker_title: President, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Economic Panel unveils blueprint for Atlantic Canada’s future

quotes.quote_text: Atlantic Canada is rich in resources, talent, and creativity. What’s needed in this moment, to match our growth with our ambition, is bold thinking. That thinking is reflected in the Atlantic Economic Panel’s report and recommendations, and aligns with the Government of Canada’s goal to unlock more private investment, improve cooperation between governments and partners, and boost productivity across sectors. I’m grateful for those who added their insight and expertise to the development of this report and trust it will serve as a springboard towards greater prosperity for our region.
quotes.speaker: Lena Metlege Diab
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Economic Panel unveils blueprint for Atlantic Canada’s future

quotes.quote_text: Fish and seafood from Atlantic Canada is on tables around the world, and it supports coastal communities in all four of our provinces. Our harvesters and processors are strongest when the region works together. The Panel has given us a clear path to build on that. I will be working with my colleagues and partners to make sure harvesters, families, and communities across Atlantic Canada share in the growth ahead.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Economic Panel unveils blueprint for Atlantic Canada’s future

quotes.quote_text: The Atlantic Economic Panel has done important work to identify opportunities for economic growth in the region. Together, with Atlantic provinces and industry, our government is committed to leading the charge and ensuring Atlantic Canada makes its mark across the country and beyond.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Economic Panel unveils blueprint for Atlantic Canada’s future

quotes.quote_text: We are grateful to Minister Fraser for giving this Panel the independence to take an honest, unvarnished look at Atlantic Canada's economy. What we found is a region with the people, resources and entrepreneurial spirit to compete with anyone in the world – and a once-in-a-generation opportunity to bring prosperity to every part of it, rural and urban alike. Bolder Ambitions sets out a bold vision for what Atlantic Canada could become. Delivering on it will take governments, businesses and communities acting together as one region. The question now is simple: do we have the ambition, and the will, to seize the moment?
quotes.speaker: Don Mills
quotes.article_title: Atlantic Economic Panel unveils blueprint for Atlantic Canada’s future

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is proud to work alongside Indigenous partners as we strengthen and deliver services that reflect the needs and priorities of their communities. Today’s investment in the new treatment centre in Sheshatshiu Innu First Nation will help expand access to mental health and addiction services, while creating a culturally grounded space for healing, and recovery. This investment is about building stronger communities with better access to the care and the supports people need.
quotes.speaker: Caroline Desrochers
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports health and wellbeing with a new treatment centre in Sheshatshiu Innu First Nation

quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today’s investment in a new treatment centre in Sheshatshiu Innu First Nation will support community members in need and provide the tools to build a brighter future together.
quotes.speaker: Philip Earle
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports health and wellbeing with a new treatment centre in Sheshatshiu Innu First Nation

quotes.quote_text: Healing is strongest when our people can remain connected to who they are. This new treatment centre will provide access to much-needed services here at home, in an environment that incorporates Innu aitun – our culture and our values. We are proud to see an investment that recognizes the needs of our community and the importance of culturally appropriate care. This is an important step forward for Sheshatshiu and one that will benefit our people for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Chief Eugene Hart
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada supports health and wellbeing with a new treatment centre in Sheshatshiu Innu First Nation

quotes.quote_text: Canada and Germany are strengthening a trusted partnership that delivers real and tangible benefits for Canadians. This agreement will make Canada safer by improving the protection of sensitive information, strengthening cooperation with one of our closest NATO allies, and enabling more effective coordination on shared security priorities. It reinforces Canada’s ability to respond to emerging threats, support our defence and security objectives, and work seamlessly with like-minded partners to protect Canadians and advance our shared interests in an increasingly complex world.
quotes.speaker: Joël Lightbound
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Public Works and Procurement and Quebec Lieutenant
quotes.article_title: Canada and Germany sign General Security of Information Agreement

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s relationship with Germany is rooted in a shared commitment to international security, democratic values, and the rules-based international order. This agreement strengthens Canada’s ability to work closely with a key European ally on common defence and security priorities, while underscoring Canada’s role as a reliable and engaged partner in addressing regional and global challenges.
quotes.speaker: Anita Anand
quotes.article_title: Canada and Germany sign General Security of Information Agreement

quotes.quote_text: As longstanding allies and partners, Canada and Germany have a strong history of working together to advance international peace and security. At a time of heightened global uncertainty, trusted cooperation between allies is more important than ever. The General Security of Information Agreement signed today strengthens our ability to share and protect sensitive information, enhances defence cooperation and interoperability, and supports more effective collaboration on shared security priorities.
