quotes.quote_text: The Build Communities Strong Fund is building the infrastructure that Canadians rely on every day. Today’s investment in drainage infrastructure in Winnipeg will help reduce the risk of basement flooding, support sewer separation, and protect the Red River and Assiniboine River by reducing combined sewer overflows.
quotes.speaker: Doug Eyolfson
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in wastewater infrastructure in Winnipeg

quotes.quote_text: This investment is another great example of what we can accomplish when governments work together to build the infrastructure our communities need. The Rutland Trunk Sewer project will strengthen Winnipeg’s drainage system, reduce the risk of basement flooding, and help protect our rivers. When governments collaborate, we can make the investments needed today to support a growing Winnipeg.
quotes.speaker: Scott Gillingam
quotes.article_title: Building Canada strong by investing in wastewater infrastructure in Winnipeg

quotes.quote_text: Affordable child care is an investment in Canada’s future. It helps give children the best start in life, while giving parents the support they need to work, go to school, or build a business. That helps families earn more and helps the whole province stay competitive. Through this extension, we are protecting the progress we have made and ensuring more families can continue to access affordable, high-quality and inclusive child care. We will keep working with partners to protect and expand spaces so every child can learn, and every family can plan for a strong future.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario agree to four-year extension of Canada–Ontario Canada-wide Early Learning and Child Care Agreement

quotes.quote_text: We are pleased the federal government has recognized the need for additional funding to address the shortfall Ontario has identified. This funding will help maintain current fees at an average of $19 a day for families and provide greater stability for the child care sector. This agreement represents progress, and we will continue discussions with the federal government to provide Ontario families and the child care sector with the stability they need over the long term.
quotes.speaker: Paul Calandra
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario agree to four-year extension of Canada–Ontario Canada-wide Early Learning and Child Care Agreement

quotes.quote_text: The Canada-wide early learning and child care agreement has been delivering generational benefits to Ontario families since it was announced by the federal and provincial governments almost five years ago. Every day, our charity sees how this investment in child care allows parents to contribute to our economy, grow in their careers, and improve their family’s financial well-being knowing that their children are receiving high-quality, affordable care. Extending this agreement today is an important milestone that provides stability for a program that is making an incredible difference in the lives of so many families at YMCAs and other participating child care centres.
quotes.speaker: Lesley Davidson
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario agree to four-year extension of Canada–Ontario Canada-wide Early Learning and Child Care Agreement

quotes.quote_text: In this period of global uncertainty, Canada is turning our strengths including talented workers, innovative businesses, and strong finances, into a competitive advantage. With the lowest tax rate on new business investment in the G7, we’re attracting investment, driving growth, and creating good jobs for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: John Zerucelli
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada introduces new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: This is one of the most significant changes to Canada’s business tax system in half a century, and a game changer for investment in this country. With the Productivity Mega Deduction, we are reinforcing Canada’s position as the most competitive country in the G7 for new business investment and setting the conditions for an investment supercycle. This is about unlocking investment at a scale we have not seen in generations, so businesses can build, expand, and grow in Canada – creating high-paying careers and building a stronger, more productive and more resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada introduces new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: Canadian philanthropy is coming together to meet the unique challenges and threats to our water security in Canada. Working together with the Canada Water Agency, we look forward to catalyzing change at scale and increasing our collective impact throughout Canada. At a time when freshwater is becoming one of our most defining strategic resources, this partnership reflects a shared commitment to ensuring that Canada remains water-secure, resilient and prosperous for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Marie-Paule Jeansonne
quotes.article_title: Canada Water Agency and Philanthropic Partners Sign Agreement to Advance Water Security

quotes.quote_text: Water is life, and it is one Canada's greatest natural advantages. How we work together to protect and sustainably use fresh water is one of our greatest responsibilities. This partnership with the new Canada Water Security Funders Group, which brings together a number of leading funders from coast-to-coast-to-coast, presents an opportunity to share knowledge and effective stewardship solutions and to discuss collaborative approaches to financing initiatives that respond to one of the most pressing challenges of our time - ensuring the long-term health and resilience of freshwater ecosystems in Canada, which is necessary for building a strong, thriving, and prosperous Canada for future generations.
quotes.speaker: Mark Fisher
quotes.article_title: Canada Water Agency and Philanthropic Partners Sign Agreement to Advance Water Security

quotes.quote_text: The Little Lake Loop is part of a long-term vision that will help make Peterborough a more connected, active, and beautiful place to live. I am grateful for the federal government’s support for multi-use trails across the country, which strengthens communities and improves people’s lives. I’m pleased to see funding support this important project for Peterborough – a project residents have long advocated for and care deeply about.
quotes.speaker: Emma Harrison
quotes.article_title: Canada and Peterborough invest in Little Lake Loop

quotes.quote_text: Completing another segment of the Little Lake Loop is an important step toward creating a more connected and accessible trail network in Peterborough. This investment will provide more opportunities for residents and visitors to walk, cycle and enjoy the natural beauty of Little Lake, while connecting people to our parks, businesses and tourism destinations. We’re pleased to see this vision continue to take shape and to invest in infrastructure that will serve our community for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Jeff Leal
quotes.article_title: Canada and Peterborough invest in Little Lake Loop

quotes.quote_text: The selection of a proponent to design and build the new Health Centre of Excellence marks a key step toward the construction of a safe, modern and bilingual correctional facility in Dorchester that will keep communities safe in Atlantic Canada and across the country. This new infrastructure will ensure that CSC staff have a safe and secure workspace to meet the growing needs of a complex offender population in federal custody.
quotes.article_title: Federal government announces next step in delivering the Correctional Service of Canada’s new Health Centre of Excellence

quotes.quote_text: CSC employees carry out demanding and important work every day. They deserve a modern workplace that supports them in doing that work safely and effectively. Reaching this important milestone brings us closer to providing staff with a purpose-built Centre of Excellence that will improve the way they work and strengthen public safety outcomes for years to come.
quotes.article_title: Federal government announces next step in delivering the Correctional Service of Canada’s new Health Centre of Excellence

quotes.quote_text: Canadians expect public investments to deliver real results. With this contract, we are taking a concrete step toward better health care within Correctional Service of Canada and a modern facility built for the future. By bringing Canadian workers, local businesses, and Indigenous partners into the project, we can create opportunities as we build infrastructure that will serve communities for generations.
quotes.article_title: Federal government announces next step in delivering the Correctional Service of Canada’s new Health Centre of Excellence

quotes.quote_text: The courage and sacrifice of Canada's Veterans helped shape the nation we know today. Through these projects, communities across Saskatchewan are preserving stories that might otherwise be lost and are ensuring future generations can learn from those who served. When we remember our Veterans, we do more than honour the past. We strengthen our understanding of who we are, the freedoms we enjoy, and the responsibility we share to carry their legacy forward.
quotes.speaker: Jill McKnight
quotes.article_title: Honouring Veterans’ service and preserving their legacy across Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: The support from Veterans Affairs Canada has given us the confidence in our project to bring new life to the RCAF exhibit and will allow us to create more meaningful, interactive ways for visitors to connect with the stories and lives of those who served. Their funding will help ensure these stories, including the experiences of Saskatchewan and Indigenous air force personnel, continue to be remembered and shared with future generations.
quotes.speaker: Kevin Hicks
quotes.speaker_title: Project Manager, Saskatoon Museum of Military Artifacts
quotes.article_title: Honouring Veterans’ service and preserving their legacy across Saskatchewan

quotes.quote_text: The Canadian Cyber Defence Collective Strategic Forum Advisory Council brings together the best of our public and private-sector cyber expertise to strengthen our national resilience. By working together, we can better secure our cyber systems and protect our critical infrastructure from malicious cyber activity.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada advances cyber resilience through public-private partnerships

quotes.quote_text: As cyber threats continue to evolve, so must the way we work together to address them. Today, I attended the first in-person meeting of the Canadian Cyber Defence Collective Strategic Forum Advisory Council, bringing together leaders from across Canada’s cyber community to discuss how we can deepen collaboration and advance policy solutions to better protect the critical infrastructure Canadians rely on every day.
quotes.speaker: Ruby Sahota
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada advances cyber resilience through public-private partnerships

quotes.quote_text: Cyber threats are evolving rapidly, and protecting Canada’s critical infrastructure is essential to our national security and sovereignty. The Canadian Cyber Defence Collective Strategic Forum brings government and industry together to turn shared expertise into coordinated action. By improving how we anticipate emerging risks and prevent, withstand and recover from cyber incidents, we are strengthening Canada’s cyber resilience, safeguarding our sovereignty and helping keep the essential systems and services Canadians rely on secure.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada advances cyber resilience through public-private partnerships

quotes.quote_text: The Survivors' Flag stands as a testament to the courage and strength of those who have carried the weight of the past while continuing to move forward with hope. Its presence reminds us that reconciliation requires action, understanding, and a collective commitment to honour Survivors, learn from history, and create lasting change for future generations.
quotes.speaker: Elder Claudette Commanda
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Survivors' Flag raised on Parliament Hill to honour Residential School Survivors and the children who never came home

quotes.quote_text: Having spent 12 years in Residential Schools, I know the importance of remembering our shared history. The Survivors' Flag is more than a symbol. It is a recognition of the experiences of Survivors, a tribute to our power, and a reminder that reconciliation requires truth, understanding, and action.
quotes.speaker: Antoine Mountain
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Survivors' Flag raised on Parliament Hill to honour Residential School Survivors and the children who never came home

quotes.quote_text: The experiences I endured as an Inuit child in Residential School followed me into adulthood, shaping my journey in profound ways. While the path has not always been easy, it has shown me that healing, belonging, and love are possible. Being here today at the raising of the Survivors' Flag is a powerful reminder that our stories matter, that our courage is honoured, and that hope continues to guide us forward.
quotes.speaker: Bernard Andreason
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Survivors' Flag raised on Parliament Hill to honour Residential School Survivors and the children who never came home

quotes.quote_text: As a Survivor of the Île-à-la-Crosse Boarding School, I am proud to see the Flag raised and to see Métis people represented in this way. The past has given us a lot of hurt, but now is the time to honour our journey, reclaim our future, and move forward together with strength and pride.
quotes.speaker: Ann Lafleur
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Survivors' Flag raised on Parliament Hill to honour Residential School Survivors and the children who never came home

quotes.quote_text: Survivors have shown immense courage in sharing their truths and helping future generations understand our history. We raise this Flag in honour of their strength. The Residential School system spanned generations, leaving impacts that continue to be felt today. Truth and reconciliation cannot undo that history. We have a long walk ahead of us, one that calls for humility, perseverance, and meaningful action. May the Survivors' Flag serve as a lasting reminder that reconciliation requires all Canadians to walk that path together.
quotes.speaker: Stephanie Scott
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Survivors' Flag raised on Parliament Hill to honour Residential School Survivors and the children who never came home

quotes.quote_text: Raising the Survivors' Flag on Parliament Hill is an opportunity to honour Survivors, remember the children who never came home, and reflect on the truths that have been shared with Canadians about Residential Schools. We are reminded that reconciliation is an ongoing responsibility that belongs to all of us. By listening to Survivors, confronting attempts to deny or diminish this history, and advancing the rights and self-determination of First Nations, Inuit, and Métis, we can continue the work of building a stronger, more just country together.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Alty
quotes.dept_en: Crown-Indigenous Relations and Northern Affairs Canada
quotes.article_title: Survivors' Flag raised on Parliament Hill to honour Residential School Survivors and the children who never came home

quotes.quote_text: Communities across Atlantic Canada need infrastructure that works, today and for the future. This targeted investment will help get federal dollars directly into Moncton to build and upgrade the places people rely on every day. Practical investments, like support for Curl Moncton’s roof replacement project will help maintain an important community gathering space, support local economic activity, and ensure residents can continue to enjoy recreational opportunities for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
quotes.article_title: $160,644 in federal funding will support roof replacement at Curl Moncton

quotes.quote_text: Curl Moncton is a vital piece of our community’s recreational infrastructure, and this important federal investment will help strengthen and support the club's continued contribution to our community and local economy by helping ensure the facility remains safe, accessible, and available for all of our residents to use for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Ginette Petitpas Taylor
quotes.article_title: $160,644 in federal funding will support roof replacement at Curl Moncton

quotes.quote_text: Curl Moncton is thrilled that, with support from the Atlantic Canada Opportunities Agency and the Building Communities Strong Fund, we will finally be able to repair our roof. While our name highlights a single sport, Curl Moncton is far more than just a curling rink. We operate as a bustling, multi-generational community hub, serving residents from youth to seniors. Thanks to support from the Atlantic Canada Opportunities Agency, we are ensuring that Curl Moncton remains dry, safe and operational, while helping guarantee that Moncton residents will continue to have a place to gather, exercise and build a stronger community for decades to come.
quotes.speaker: Shannon Tatlock
quotes.article_title: $160,644 in federal funding will support roof replacement at Curl Moncton

quotes.quote_text: Communities across Atlantic Canada need infrastructure that works, today and for the future. This targeted investment will help get federal dollars directly into Bathurst to build and upgrade the places people rely on every day. Practical investments, like support for the Bathurst Curling Club will bring people together and help communities adapt to a changing climate.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Governments invest in sport and community infrastructure in Bathurst

quotes.quote_text: Investing in the Bathurst Curling Club is really about investing in people and in our community. For generations, this club has been a place where people come together — to curl, to volunteer, to socialize and simply to enjoy being part of their community. This investment of $505,382 will give the Club the modern infrastructure it needs to continue playing that important role for many years to come. These are the kinds of investments that make our communities stronger and make Bathurst an even better place to live.
quotes.speaker: Serge Cormier
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Governments invest in sport and community infrastructure in Bathurst

quotes.quote_text: Community facilities like the Bathurst Curling Club provide important spaces for people to come together, stay active and participate in activities they enjoy. Supporting the modernization of this facility will help ensure it remains a welcoming and reliable place for curlers, volunteers and the broader Bathurst community for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Gilles LePage
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Governments invest in sport and community infrastructure in Bathurst

quotes.quote_text: We are incredibly grateful to our financial partners for investing in the future of the Bathurst Curling Club and our community. These important upgrades, including a new energy-efficient ice plant and improved building insulation, will help us reduce energy use, operate more sustainably and better withstand changing weather conditions. Most importantly, this support will help ensure that the Curling Club remains a welcoming and vibrant place for our members and the Bathurst community for many years to come.
quotes.speaker: Kathy Grebenc
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Governments invest in sport and community infrastructure in Bathurst

quotes.quote_text: No one should have to face gender-based violence alone. By supporting new approaches shaped by the experiences of victims and survivors, community organizations, service providers and partners, we are helping build a safer Canada where everyone can feel heard, supported, and able to access the services they need, no matter where they live.
quotes.speaker: Rechie Valdez
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez announces funding to support victims and survivors of gender-based violence in rural, remote and underserved communities

quotes.quote_text: Ensuring survivors have access to the care and support they need is so important. She Matters is doing the work, making support services accessible in rural, remote and underserved communities. This funding is important to survivors and communities everywhere.
quotes.speaker: Viviane Lapointe
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez announces funding to support victims and survivors of gender-based violence in rural, remote and underserved communities

quotes.quote_text: Too many survivors cannot access care after sexual violence. Support may be hours or a flight away, and racism, discrimination, stigma and past harms can make hospitals feel unsafe. Together, these barriers delay or prevent care and the preservation of time-sensitive evidence. For children and youth, they are amplified further. We are deeply honoured to continue advancing research and exploring viable solutions: enhanced care pathways that strengthen access to care, evidence preservation and justice for survivors of all backgrounds, no matter where they live or whether the nearest hospital feels safe to them.
quotes.speaker: Victoria Donkin
quotes.speaker_title: Health Equity Researcher and Project Lead for Bridging the Gaps at She Matters
quotes.article_title: Minister Valdez announces funding to support victims and survivors of gender-based violence in rural, remote and underserved communities

quotes.quote_text: In this period of global uncertainty, Canada has exceptional advantages: vast energy potential, unmatched human capital, and a strong fiscal outlook. We are turning those strengths into a competitive edge, creating the best environment in the world for businesses—Canadian firms and those from abroad—to invest and grow. With a marginal effective tax rate far below that of our G7 peers, we are demonstrating our commitment to ambitious economic growth.
quotes.speaker: Wayne Long
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada introduces new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: This is one of the most significant changes to Canada’s business tax system in half a century, and a game changer for investment in this country. With the Productivity Mega Deduction, we are reinforcing Canada’s position as the most competitive country in the G7 for new business investment and setting the conditions for an investment supercycle. This is about unlocking investment at a scale we have not seen in generations, so businesses can build, expand, and grow in Canada – creating high-paying careers and building a stronger, more productive and more resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada introduces new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: Cyber security is a shared responsibility. Governments and organizations have an important role to play, and each of us also contributes to Canada’s collective resilience through the choices we make online. By working together and building strong cyber security habits, we can help create a safer and more secure digital Canada.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Cyber Security Awareness Month 2026

quotes.quote_text: AI is making some online threats and scams more convincing than ever, but the fundamentals of cyber security have not changed. Taking a moment to verify a suspicious message, using strong and unique passwords, and enabling MFA remain some of the most effective ways to protect yourself online. By building strong cyber security habits, Canadians can help protect themselves, their families and their communities.
quotes.speaker: Rajiv Gupta
quotes.speaker_title: Head of the Canadian Centre for Cyber Security (Cyber Centre)
quotes.article_title: Cyber Security Awareness Month 2026

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is proud to support these projects that will improve transit services for people in Colchester and Cumberland counties. Investment in rural transit contributes to more inclusive and supportive communities, connecting residents to employment, healthcare, education, social services, and more.
quotes.speaker: Alana Hirtle
quotes.article_title: Federal government and Nova Scotia give rural transit a boost in Colchester and Cumberland counties

quotes.quote_text: Our government is helping to build up transit in Cumberland and Colchester so people have more options to get to appointments, to run errands, or just to visit friends. By supporting our local community transportation providers, we ensure that people have a safe and accessible way to travel.
quotes.speaker: Dave Ritcey
quotes.speaker_title: Nova Scotia Minister of Communities, Culture, Tourism and Heritage and Member of the Legislative Assembly for Truro–Bible Hill–Millbrook–Salmon River, on behalf of the Honourable Fred Tilley, Nova Scotia Minister of Public Works
quotes.article_title: Federal government and Nova Scotia give rural transit a boost in Colchester and Cumberland counties

quotes.quote_text: Funding from the Government of Canada through the Rural Transit Solutions Fund will make a meaningful difference in our ability to provide safe, reliable and accessible transportation. This investment will help us strengthen our service, reduce transportation barriers and keep rural residents connected to essential services and their communities. We sincerely thank the governments of Canada and Nova Scotia for their continued investment in rural community transportation.
quotes.speaker: Sue Taylor
quotes.article_title: Federal government and Nova Scotia give rural transit a boost in Colchester and Cumberland counties

quotes.quote_text: The financial assistance from the Rural Transit Solutions Fund will enable CCTS to expand their existing service throughout Cumberland County with the addition of a 14-passenger bus and hybrid van. By developing a fixed flex route around the county, this will help to improve the quality of life and safety of equity seeking groups, wishing to use transit to access employment, education and health services. CCTS would like to acknowledge the continued financial support from the governments of Canada and Nova Scotia to rural transportation in Nova Scotia.
quotes.speaker: Peter Lewis
quotes.speaker_title: Chairperson of Cumberland County Transportation Services
quotes.article_title: Federal government and Nova Scotia give rural transit a boost in Colchester and Cumberland counties

quotes.quote_text: Investing in cutting‑edge technologies is essential to Canada’s future. Today’s support for H2 Analytics Inc. demonstrates our commitment to advancing digital innovation that strengthens defence and security training, protects communities, drives sustainable growth, and ensures Canada remains a leader in secure, next‑generation solutions.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment powers Ottawa’s next-generation security training technology

quotes.quote_text: Today’s investment highlights how Ottawa companies like H2 Analytics Inc. are driving innovation and strengthening Canada’s digital capabilities. By supporting the growth of the EASE® platform, we are helping a Canadian company expand its reach, create good jobs here at home, contribute to regional prosperity, and continue building strong Canadian solutions that serve defence and security organizations around the world.
quotes.speaker: Mona Fortier
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment powers Ottawa’s next-generation security training technology

quotes.quote_text: This funding will help us hire highly skilled Canadians while accelerating the next phase of EASE® development. It’s an important step in scaling Canadian-built software that supports operational readiness.
quotes.speaker: Hugo Hodgett
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada investment powers Ottawa’s next-generation security training technology

quotes.quote_text: In this period of global uncertainty, Canada has exceptional advantages: vast energy potential, unmatched human capital, and a strong fiscal outlook. We are turning those strengths into a competitive edge, creating the best environment in the world for businesses—Canadian firms and those from abroad—to invest and grow. With a marginal effective tax rate far below that of our G7 peers, and less than half the U.S. rate, we are demonstrating our commitment to ambitious economic growth.
quotes.speaker: Ruby Sahota
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Sahota highlights new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: This is one of the most significant changes to Canada’s business tax system in half a century, and a game changer for investment in this country. With the Productivity Mega Deduction, we are reinforcing Canada’s position as the most competitive country in the G7 for new business investment and setting the conditions for an investment supercycle. This is about unlocking investment at a scale we have not seen in generations, so businesses can build, expand, and grow in Canada – creating high-paying careers and building a stronger, more productive and more resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Sahota highlights new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: Businesses in Niagara are ready to invest, grow, and create good jobs, and they need the right conditions to do it. The Productivity Mega Deduction will help businesses make those investments here in Canada, strengthening our local economy and ensuring Niagara businesses can compete and succeed at home and around the world.
quotes.speaker: Chris Bittle
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State Sahota highlights new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: In this period of global uncertainty, Canada has exceptional advantages: vast energy potential, unmatched human capital, and a strong fiscal outlook. We are turning those strengths into a competitive edge, creating the best environment in the world for businesses—Canadian firms and those from abroad—to invest and grow. With a marginal effective tax rate far below that of our G7 peers, we are demonstrating our commitment to ambitious economic growth.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada introduces new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: This is one of the most significant changes to Canada’s business tax system in half a century, and a game changer for investment in this country. With the Productivity Mega Deduction, we are reinforcing Canada’s position as the most competitive country in the G7 for new business investment and setting the conditions for an investment supercycle. This is about unlocking investment at a scale we have not seen in generations, so businesses can build, expand, and grow in Canada – creating high-paying careers and building a stronger, more productive and more resilient economy.
quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada introduces new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: Canada is the best sport-hosting nation in the world. As we celebrate 2026 as Canada’s Year of Sport, we continue to welcome the world, highlighting the very best of Canada, boosting local tourism, strengthening our economy, and cheering on Canadian athletes, right here at home. It builds on our legacy, brings communities together, and supports the next generation, from playground to podium.
quotes.speaker: Adam van Koeverden
quotes.article_title: Secretary of State van Koeverden announces support to strengthen sport hosting in Canada

quotes.quote_text: By partnering with the province, we’re delivering the essential infrastructure upgrades that will create future housing opportunities in Labrador. These wastewater upgrades in Nain will ensure the community will have reliable sewer service, while protecting the environment and creating capacity for the construction of more homes.
quotes.speaker: Philip Earle
quotes.article_title: Canada and Newfoundland and Labrador invest in wastewater infrastructure in Nain

quotes.quote_text: These sanitary sewer system upgrades are a vital investment in Nain’s future. By improving reliability and climate resilience, this project will reduce the risk of sewer backups, protect local marine ecosystems, and ensure dependable wastewater service for residents. It also lays the groundwork for future housing and community growth, supporting the broader goal of building safe, affordable homes and strengthening local infrastructure for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Lela Evans
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Minister, Minister, and Member of the House of Assembly for Torngat Mountains
quotes.article_title: Canada and Newfoundland and Labrador invest in wastewater infrastructure in Nain

quotes.quote_text: This project is something our community has needed for a long time. Our wastewater system has been under a lot of pressure, and these upgrades will make a real difference for our community. It means fewer problems for families, better protection for our land and water, and a system we can count on. This work also helps us move forward with new housing. We know how important that is for Nain. Having the right infrastructure in place makes it possible for us to grow in a safe and steady way.
quotes.speaker: Anthony Andersen
quotes.article_title: Canada and Newfoundland and Labrador invest in wastewater infrastructure in Nain

quotes.quote_text: In this period of global uncertainty, Canada has exceptional advantages: vast energy potential, unmatched human capital, and a strong fiscal outlook. We are turning those strengths into a competitive edge, creating the best environment in the world for businesses—Canadian firms and those from abroad—to invest and grow. With a marginal effective tax rate far below that of our G7 peers, we are demonstrating our commitment to ambitious economic growth.
quotes.speaker: Gary Anandasangaree
quotes.article_title: Minister Anandasangaree highlights new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: Canada is a global leader in space science, technology, and innovation. Colonel Joshua Kutryk's mission to the International Space Station will showcase Canadian expertise on the world stage, inspire the next generation of innovators, and strengthen a sector that is strategic to our economy and national interests. As we look to the future of deep space exploration, the Station is an important platform for research and discovery, advancing cutting-edge technologies, creating new opportunities for Canadians, and preparing for the next generation of missions that will push the boundaries of human knowledge.
quotes.speaker: The Honourable
quotes.article_title: Canadian Space Agency astronaut Joshua Kutryk begins his first space mission

quotes.quote_text: My love of flight and interest in science has offered me incredible opportunities through my career and has brought me to where I am now. I am deeply humbled. This is an exciting time in space history. There are so many new opportunities. Now is the perfect time to dream big, study hard and shoot for the stars, just like I did. It is an honour to represent Canada in space and to share my journey with everyone back home.
quotes.speaker: Joshua Kutryk
quotes.article_title: Canadian Space Agency astronaut Joshua Kutryk begins his first space mission

quotes.quote_text: These investments will have a very real impact right here in Shippagan. By providing the municipality with the infrastructure needed to support the construction of approximately 69 new homes, we are helping families, young people and workers find a place to call home here in our region. These investments will also benefit our local contractors and businesses, generate economic activity, and help Shippagan continue to grow. This is exactly the kind of investment we want to make: concrete projects that respond to the needs of our people, support our local economy, and help build a stronger future for our communities.
quotes.speaker: Serge Cormier
quotes.article_title: Canada and New Brunswick invest in water and wastewater infrastructure to support more housing in Shippagan

quotes.quote_text: Infrastructure like wastewater systems may not always be visible, but it is fundamental to the growth of our communities. The province has provided funding for municipal infrastructure to support housing right across the province. This ensures municipalities have the capacity to provide reliable services and creates the conditions needed for new development.
quotes.speaker: Gilles LePage
quotes.article_title: Canada and New Brunswick invest in water and wastewater infrastructure to support more housing in Shippagan

quotes.quote_text: The City Council welcomes the announcements made by both levels of government. A strong Canada is built first and foremost at the local level, like ours. These investments in our infrastructure are a key driver for supporting our growth, enhancing our community’s appeal, improving our residents’ quality of life, and ensuring Shippagan’s long-term prosperity.
quotes.speaker: Kassim Doumbia
quotes.article_title: Canada and New Brunswick invest in water and wastewater infrastructure to support more housing in Shippagan

quotes.quote_text: We’re helping businesses here in Prince Edward Island adapt to unjustified U.S. tariffs. For PEI Bag Co., that means new equipment to produce bags for everyday products like potatoes, flour, and sugar more efficiently, compete for customers here at home, and reach new global markets. This investment will help support jobs for 65 Islanders and keep Canadian food packaging production in Canada. The $6.9 million in direct support we’re announcing today will help PEI Bag Co. and 16 other businesses and organizations across the Island, with more to come across Atlantic Canada. Our government will continue to act quickly so workers and businesses affected by these tariffs get the support they need.
quotes.speaker: Sean Fraser
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Canada invests $6.9M to help Prince Edward Island businesses respond to tariffs

quotes.quote_text: As global markets continue to evolve, Prince Edward Island businesses need the right mix of innovation and capacity to stay competitive and pursue new opportunities. Of the $6.9 million our federal government is investing across PEI, more than $260,000 is staying right here at PEI Bag Co. to keep operations and tools modern, boost efficiencies, and seek new market opportunities. This is the kind of immediate and intentional support Canada’s new government is delivering to help local businesses adapt to tariffs, grow and succeed in a changing global economy.
quotes.speaker: Bobby Morrissey
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Canada invests $6.9M to help Prince Edward Island businesses respond to tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Support through the Regional Tariff Response Initiative will help us build on the significant growth and modernization efforts we have made in recent years. By investing in new equipment and digital technologies, the PEI Bag Co. can operate more efficiently, explore new market opportunities, and strengthen our ability to adapt to changing trade conditions while continuing to provide high-quality products to our customers.
quotes.speaker: Thane Smallwood
topic_en: Maintain, grow and improve your business
quotes.article_title: Canada invests $6.9M to help Prince Edward Island businesses respond to tariffs

quotes.quote_text: Being able to get around your community safely matters, whether you’re going to school, visiting family or simply getting where you need to go. This investment supports Roseau River Anishinabe First Nation in creating safer, more accessible routes for young people, families and community members. By investing in priorities identified by the community, we’re supporting stronger connections and a healthier community.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Chartrand
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in safer active transportation in Roseau River Anishinabe First Nation

quotes.quote_text: This investment will help make our community safer and more accessible for everyone. These pathways will provide better connections for our children, youth, Elders, families and people with disabilities to the places and services they use every day. This is an important investment in the health and well-being of our community and in infrastructure that will continue to benefit Roseau River Anishinabe First Nation for generations to come.
quotes.speaker: Councillor Evan Roberts
quotes.article_title: Federal government invests in safer active transportation in Roseau River Anishinabe First Nation

quotes.quote_text: Investing in the Dunn House model is critical to solving the housing crisis across the continuum. This investment will deliver urgently needed supportive housing for those who need it most. When we pair innovation with compassion, we create homes that strengthen communities and provide vulnerable Canadians with the stability and care they deserve.
quotes.speaker: Gregor Robertson
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces expanded partnership to advance supportive and transitional housing in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Dunn House is one of the most inspiring projects in Canada today. Dr. Andrew Boozary and his team have shown what is possible when we stop treating housing and healthcare as separate challenges. The results are extraordinary. People gain stability, dignity, and support. Health outcomes improve. Pressure on hospitals falls. This is exactly the kind of bold, practical innovation that changes lives and strengthens communities.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces expanded partnership to advance supportive and transitional housing in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Supportive housing at Dunn House creates safe and dignified homes and has made our community in Taiaiako’n-Parkdale-High Park better. I've seen it and heard it from residents, neighbours and frontline workers. This new phase of Dunn House will change the lives of 80 people and their families.
quotes.speaker: Karim Bardeesy
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces expanded partnership to advance supportive and transitional housing in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: The Dunn House model is working. It’s helping people build stable lives, access vital resources, and stay off the street and out of the emergency room. The City of Toronto is proud to partner with the federal government and University Health Network to advance Dunn House Phase 3, so more people can benefit from social medicine supportive housing. This is a very Canadian solution: one that is compassionate, coordinated and comprehensive.
quotes.speaker: Olivia Chow
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces expanded partnership to advance supportive and transitional housing in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Dunn House has shown what is possible when housing and healthcare work together. Through this investment, Build Canada Homes is helping scale a proven model that creates supportive homes, improves outcomes for residents, and delivers lasting impact for communities.
quotes.speaker: Ana Bailão
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces expanded partnership to advance supportive and transitional housing in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: At UHN's Gattuso Centre for Social Medicine, we have demonstrated what is possible when housing, health care and social supports come together around the needs of patients. What began as Canada's first hospital-led supportive housing initiative has evolved into a proven model of care, made possible through the commitment of our government and community partners and the generosity of our Foundation. This investment will extend that model to 200 more patients with complex health and social needs and help scale a made-in-Canada approach to prescribable housing that can strengthen health systems and communities across the country.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Kevin Smith
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces expanded partnership to advance supportive and transitional housing in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Dunn House proved something simple: housing is health care. When people moved into housing from the street and the shelter system, emergency department visits fell by more than half and hospital bed days dropped by nearly 80 per cent. That’s what happens when you treat the conditions that make people sick, not just the symptoms. This investment takes the Social Medicine Housing Initiative and scales it to more than 200 new homes — the largest advancement in housing and health care in the country.
quotes.speaker: Dr. Andrew Boozary
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces expanded partnership to advance supportive and transitional housing in Toronto

quotes.speaker: Today’s announcement is a powerful reminder of what can happen when a community comes together around a shared purpose. Our donors believed in this vision from the beginning
quotes.speaker_title: helping UHN test and prove a new model of care that has dramatically improved the lives of our city's most vulnerable patients, and thanks to this expansion, partner and advocate who has helped make this milestone possible, — Julie Quenneville, CEO
quotes.article_title: Build Canada Homes announces expanded partnership to advance supportive and transitional housing in Toronto

quotes.quote_text: Strong businesses, municipalities and First Nation communities are key to a thriving regional economy. By providing critical support to Canadians across the country, we are helping business and community partners adapt to rapidly evolving social and economic realities. Here at home, this means making life better for entrepreneurs, business, families and individuals living and working in our region.
quotes.speaker: Patty Hajdu
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests more than $20 million to accelerate community and business growth across Northern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: “This strong show of support highlights the importance of the Community Futures Program and demonstrates confidence in the work we do to accelerate growth, support communities and fuel the regional economy. I am thrilled that FedNor recognizes our record of success in fostering community, business and economic growth, while helping businesses start up and scale up here at home in Thunder Bay and across Northern Ontario. Today’s announcement will ensure Northern Ontario’s CFDCs can continue to do what we do best, maximize community, business and economic growth.
quotes.speaker: Carole Long
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Northern Ontario - FedNor
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests more than $20 million to accelerate community and business growth across Northern Ontario

quotes.quote_text: For more than 30 years, Canada and China have worked together to protect the environment. No country can tackle climate change or protect nature alone. By deepening our cooperation, we’re working to bring global emissions down, protect nature, and safeguard our environment.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Minister Dabrusin advances Canada–China cooperation on climate, clean growth, and the environment

quotes.quote_text: Canada is moving with speed and purpose to defend and build the North. That work depends on strong bases like 5 Wing Goose Bay. Today, we begin building the modern, reliable infrastructure the women and men who serve there rely on. This is what rebuilding, rearming and reinvesting in the Canadian Armed Forces looks like.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada begins construction on New Central Heating Plant at 5 Wing Goose Bay

quotes.quote_text: Labrador’s essential contribution to 5 Wing Goose Bay is also an essential contribution to Canada’s northern sovereignty. Our government is making the generational investments needed so Canada remains prepared, present, and resilient in the North.
quotes.speaker: Philip Earle
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada begins construction on New Central Heating Plant at 5 Wing Goose Bay

quotes.quote_text: This historic investment advances Canada's Net Zero goals while strengthening Arctic sovereignty and operational reach by leveraging Industry partners. Defence Construction Canada’s efficient procurement and contract management processes support the Department of National Defence as we find new and innovative ways to reduce energy use and emissions and improve long-term resilience of critical infrastructure across Canada and in the North.
quotes.speaker: Derrick Cheung
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada begins construction on New Central Heating Plant at 5 Wing Goose Bay

quotes.quote_text: We are working with PEI to make prescription drugs more affordable for Islanders. This renewed federal funding will help PEI maintain improvements to its public drug coverage and continue delivering savings for Islanders.
quotes.speaker: Marjorie Michel
quotes.article_title: Helping Islanders save millions on prescription drugs

quotes.quote_text: Whether it is making prescription drugs more affordable, supporting finding a home, or helping local businesses grow, our government is focused on making investments that deliver for Islanders and strengthen communities across Prince Edward Island. I’m proud to see Islanders benefit from programs like this, which are putting money back in people’s pockets and helping make life more affordable for families across our province.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Helping Islanders save millions on prescription drugs

quotes.quote_text: The renewal of this agreement reflects our commitment to making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for Islanders. By continuing this partnership, we are helping Islanders access the medications they need, strengthening our health-care system, and putting more money back into the pockets of Islanders.
quotes.speaker: Rob Lantz
quotes.article_title: Helping Islanders save millions on prescription drugs

quotes.quote_text: This program has made a real difference for Islanders, helping people access the medications they need to manage their health and well-being. For Islanders, this renewal means lower drug costs, access to more medications and fewer barriers to getting the treatment they need.
quotes.speaker: Cory Deagle
quotes.article_title: Helping Islanders save millions on prescription drugs

quotes.quote_text: First Nations, Inuit and Métis artists are keepers of the stories, voices and traditions that shape our cultural heritage. We are proud to support the Indigenous Performing Arts Alliance in empowering artists to share their work, build connections and create new opportunities for Indigenous performing arts across Canada. This support will help strengthen the sector and ensure Indigenous artists have more opportunities to bring their stories and artistic practices to audiences across the country.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in Indigenous Performing Arts Alliance

quotes.quote_text: Indigenous arts are a beautiful source of inspiration and a driving force for Canada’s artistic growth at home and abroad. Through a strategic and focused investment in the Indigenous Performing Arts Alliance, we are helping Indigenous arts presenters expand their reach and programming, empowering contemporary Indigenous artistic voices, and strengthening connections to the cultures and traditions of their ancestors. This work is fundamental to reconciliation and building the inclusive, diverse, resilient, strong Canada we all want.
quotes.speaker: Lisa Hepfner
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in Indigenous Performing Arts Alliance

quotes.quote_text: The Indigenous Performing Arts Alliance is excited to continue supporting the Indigenous performing arts sector with the financial support of the Department of Canadian Heritage. Our programming speaks to the needs of our community, and this funding is pivotal in ensuring we have the resources necessary to build the sector. Creating opportunities for Indigenous performing arts creatives to network and be programmed by presenting networks across Canada is not a simple task. We are truly honoured Canadian Heritage believes in our vision and continues to support us through funding awards like this.
quotes.speaker: Cynthia Lickers-Sage
quotes.speaker_title: Executive Director, Indigenous Performing Arts Alliance
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in Indigenous Performing Arts Alliance

quotes.quote_text: Virtual Marine got its start keeping people safe at sea, and today its simulators are used around the world. We want more companies like this growing in Newfoundland and Labrador, which is why we’re bringing in the Productivity Mega Deduction. Businesses will be able to write off the full cost of new equipment and technology in the first year and put more of that money into hiring and expanding here at home.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Minister Thompson highlights how the new Productivity Mega Deduction will help Newfoundland and Labrador businesses invest and grow

quotes.quote_text: This is one of the most significant changes to Canada’s business tax system in half a century, and a game changer for investment in this country. With the Productivity Mega Deduction, we are reinforcing Canada’s position as the most competitive country in the G7 for new business investment and setting the conditions for an investment supercycle. quotes.speaker: François-Philippe Champagne
quotes.article_title: Minister Thompson highlights how the new Productivity Mega Deduction will help Newfoundland and Labrador businesses invest and grow

quotes.quote_text: In this period of global uncertainty, Canada’s agriculture sector has exceptional advantages: vast productive land, world-class agricultural expertise, and a strong foundation for long-term economic growth. From farming and farm equipment to food processing and ag-tech, we are turning these strengths into a competitive edge, creating an environment where Canadian businesses expand, innovate, and build for the future. With a marginal effective tax rate far below that of our G7 peers, we are demonstrating our commitment to compete on the global stage.
quotes.speaker: The
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada introduces new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada introduces new Productivity Mega Deduction to help businesses invest, grow and create jobs in Canada

quotes.quote_text: Investing in the training and professional development of Canadian Armed Forces members is essential to maintaining a modern and ready military. This partnership between the Canadian Forces School of Aerospace Technology and Engineering and Fanshawe College will provide Royal Canadian Air Force Aviation Systems Technicians, Avionics Systems Technicians, and Aircraft Structures Technicians with valuable credentials while strengthening the skills needed to support air operations across Canada and around the world. It is an innovative collaboration that benefits our personnel, the aerospace sector and Canada's defence capabilities.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: The Royal Canadian Air Force partners with Fanshawe College to deliver training

quotes.quote_text: This contract demonstrates how strategic federal procurement can connect government needs with Canadian expertise. Through this partnership between Fanshawe College and the Department of National Defence, we are strengthening Canada’s Defence Industrial Strategy and creating new training opportunities. Our government will continue to forge new defence partnerships and support Canadian talent, innovation, and long-term value for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Stephen Fuhr
quotes.article_title: The Royal Canadian Air Force partners with Fanshawe College to deliver training

quotes.quote_text: This partnership is a great example of the impact Fanshawe College has across London and beyond. By bringing Fanshawe’s expertise in aerospace and technical education into Royal Canadian Air Force training, we are creating new opportunities for skilled Canadians while ensuring our military has the highly trained technicians it needs. It strengthens opportunities for our students, supports London’s aerospace community, and contributes to Canada’s national defence.
quotes.speaker: Arielle Kayabaga
quotes.speaker_title: Deputy House Leader of the Government and Member of Parliament for London West
quotes.article_title: The Royal Canadian Air Force partners with Fanshawe College to deliver training

quotes.quote_text: Fanshawe College has built a strong reputation here in London for preparing Canadians for careers in advanced industries, and this partnership puts that expertise to work in support of the Royal Canadian Air Force. Providing RCAF personnel with recognized civilian credentials will strengthen career opportunities while showcasing London’s role as a centre of aerospace education, innovation and skilled talent.
quotes.speaker: Peter Fragiskatos
quotes.article_title: The Royal Canadian Air Force partners with Fanshawe College to deliver training

quotes.quote_text: Today's announcement marks an important partnership between Fanshawe College and 16 Wing and highlights the strong relationship between the Royal Canadian Air Force, Canadian post-secondary institutions, and Canada's aerospace sector. This partnership will enable our Air Technicians to earn recognized college credentials while continuing to meet the military training requirements essential to operational effectiveness. By aligning aspects of our training with Canadian civil aerospace standards, we are strengthening the resilience of our training system and helping to develop the skilled, adaptable technicians needed to support the Royal Canadian Air Force's evolving operational requirements.
quotes.speaker: Colonel Wes Cunningham
quotes.article_title: The Royal Canadian Air Force partners with Fanshawe College to deliver training

quotes.quote_text: This agreement builds on Fanshawe's long-standing relationship with the Canadian Armed Forces and reflects the College's commitment to supporting military-connected learners. Together, we are helping develop the highly skilled aerospace and defence workforce that Canada needs today and in the future.
quotes.speaker: Peter J. Devlin
quotes.article_title: The Royal Canadian Air Force partners with Fanshawe College to deliver training

quotes.quote_text: More energy-efficient homes mean lower energy bills for Canadians and fewer emissions for our environment. Our government is helping people make energy-saving upgrades, advancing affordable housing solutions, and building a cleaner, more sustainable future for our country.
quotes.speaker: Julie Dabrusin
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and Federation of Canadian Municipalities support home energy retrofit financing projects across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Energy efficiency means lower costs, greater comfort, and reduced emissions. Innovative programs like this one will allow Canadians to live more affordably and sustainably. Energy efficient homes are more important than ever and are a key part of our government’s ambitious goals. We remain committed building a cleaner, greener future for communities from coast to coast to coast.
quotes.speaker: Jennifer McKelvie
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada and Federation of Canadian Municipalities support home energy retrofit financing projects across Canada

quotes.quote_text: Tariffs are putting real pressure on businesses and workers across the Greater Toronto Area. We are helping 31 local companies and organizations invest in Canadian production, become more competitive and reach new customers. This is about protecting good jobs today, while building businesses that can compete and win in a changing global economy.
quotes.speaker: Evan Solomon
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada to help Greater Toronto Area businesses and organizations build resilience

quotes.quote_text: Strong local businesses are at the heart of building strong communities. This investment will help businesses in Brampton and across the Greater Toronto Area grow, create good-paying jobs, and open up more opportunities for people and families. By supporting our local businesses and organizations, we are investing in the continued strength and prosperity of our communities.
quotes.speaker: Shafqat Ali
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada to help Greater Toronto Area businesses and organizations build resilience

quotes.quote_text: Funding through RTRI is essential to keeping Canadian manufacturers competitive. It helps businesses like Daybar to continue delivering high-quality products and services while creating opportunities for growth and long-term success for employees and their families. We are extremely grateful to the Government of Canada and FedDev Ontario for their support.
quotes.speaker: Mark Dodson
quotes.dept_en: Federal Economic Development Agency for Southern Ontario
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada to help Greater Toronto Area businesses and organizations build resilience

quotes.quote_text: Better information leads to better decisions. By improving how cellphone coverage is reported and giving Canadians a way to flag gaps, we can build a clearer picture of connectivity across the country and help support better investment where it is needed.
quotes.speaker: Vicky Eatrides
quotes.speaker_title: Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer CRTC
quotes.article_title: CRTC takes action to improve information about cellphone coverage

quotes.quote_text: The world is evolving rapidly, and we are focused on deepening our relationships with our international partners to unlock new opportunities for Canadian businesses and workers across the country. We already have preferential access to 1.5 billion consumers and are on track to double that in the coming months. Canada has what the world wants, and we're making sure our businesses are positioned to reach new heights and new markets.
quotes.speaker: Maninder Sidhu
quotes.article_title: Minister Sidhu strengthens partnerships and advances Canada’s trade priorities at G20 Trade Ministers’ Meeting

quotes.quote_text: Harvesters and hunters in Arctic Bay will have a safe place to launch and tie up, with shelter, a safe area to unload, electricity and better access to the water. In a northern community, a harbour is how people reach the water they live on. This will support fishing, hunting and the movement of goods and people for years to come.
quotes.speaker: Joanne Thompson
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in new small craft harbour in Arctic Bay, Nunavut, enhancing marine access and local opportunities

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is firmly committed to working in partnership with Indigenous communities to create real economic opportunities. Today’s announcement of the contract and construction of the small craft harbour in Arctic Bay shows we’re acting on that commitment. Inuit-owned firm, Pilitak Enterprises Limited is bringing its expertise to the project that will help to develop Nunavummiut workers, grow the Nunavut economy and strengthen Canada’s north.
quotes.speaker: Joël Lightbound
quotes.speaker_title: Minister, Public Works and Procurement and Quebec Lieutenant
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in new small craft harbour in Arctic Bay, Nunavut, enhancing marine access and local opportunities

quotes.quote_text: Safe access to the water is critically important to Arctic Bay and Nunavut communities. This harbour will create opportunities for hunters, fishers and families to be more independent. Food sovereignty and economic prosperity will follow. These small craft harbours help support hunters and fishers to sustain our Inuit practices and traditions and move towards economic prosperity for all.
quotes.speaker: Lori Idlout
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in new small craft harbour in Arctic Bay, Nunavut, enhancing marine access and local opportunities

quotes.quote_text: The development of the Arctic Bay Small Craft Harbour is a significant achievement for Inuit in the Qikiqtani Region and for the future of our waters. Supporting our communities by investing in small craft harbours provides safe havens for boats and marine safety for Inuit. The commitment to Arctic Bay is a key role of SINAA’s stewardship program, ensuring our guardians have access to marine resources that mitigate food insecurity while enabling country food sovereignty and security. We are helping ensure that conservation is shaped by Inuit priorities, Inuit knowledge, and Inuit stewardship, while creating lasting benefits for our communities.
quotes.speaker: Olayuk Akesuk
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in new small craft harbour in Arctic Bay, Nunavut, enhancing marine access and local opportunities

quotes.quote_text: This new small craft harbour will benefit all of Arctic Bay, especially our local fishers, hunters and harvesters who depend on safe, functioning harbours for their livelihoods. We are pleased to see a Nunavut-based company leading the construction of this critical piece of community infrastructure, which will support commercial fishing in the region, as well as economic opportunities, cultural activities, marine transportation, and tourism.
quotes.speaker: Hamlet of Arctic Bay
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada invests in new small craft harbour in Arctic Bay, Nunavut, enhancing marine access and local opportunities

quotes.quote_text: I’m happy that Dr. Carr is putting his vast experience and expertise to good use in service of the Canadian Museum of History and the Canadian War Museum, which are vital institutions in preserving and promoting our history and in helping us better understand who we are and what unites as a country.
quotes.speaker: Marc Miller
quotes.article_title: Minister Miller announces appointment of Graham Carr as the next Chairperson of the Board of Trustees of the Canadian Museum of History

quotes.quote_text: It’s always rewarding to see firsthand the resilience and innovation of Atlantic Canadian farmers, and the hard work and care they put into their businesses every day. Our government is committed to supporting that work by investing in research and new technologies and opening doors to international markets. We’ll continue working alongside farmers and processors to help their businesses grow and reach their full potential.
quotes.speaker: The
quotes.article_title: Minister MacDonald concludes tour in New Brunswick and Prince Edward

quotes.quote_text: The Government of Canada is continually looking for ways to better collaborate and enhance the country’s research and innovation activities. AAFC understands the economic value of the Canadian seed sector and remains committed to ensuring the Seed Increase Unit meets the high standards of pedigree seed production.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada to implement a transition year before full seed increase unit transfer to Saskatoon Research and Development Centre

quotes.quote_text: We all share a responsibility to protect the waters, ecosystems and communities that make British Columbia so special. That’s why it was important for me to see first-hand the work being done at Westridge to protect the environment and maintain the highest safety standards. This facility reflects years of planning, oversight and meaningful consultation with Indigenous communities — rigour Canadians can be proud of. Westridge shows that when we work together, we can build major infrastructure responsibly. As we look to new opportunities like Pacific Link, that’s the standard Canadians rightfully expect us to uphold and we are wholly committed to delivering on.
quotes.speaker: Jill McKnight
quotes.article_title: Minister McKnight tours Westridge Marine Terminal, showcasing Canada’s ability to build major energy infrastructure responsibly

quotes.quote_text: Canada has what the world wants, and we know how to get our energy to those global markets responsibly. The Trans Mountain Expansion and the world-class Westridge Terminal demonstrate what Canadians know well: we do not have to choose between economic growth and a healthy environment. As we move toward shovels in the ground on Pacific Link by September 2027, I look forward to showing Canadians and the world once again what British Columbia and Canada do best as a responsible energy superpower.
quotes.speaker: Tim Hodgson
quotes.article_title: Minister McKnight tours Westridge Marine Terminal, showcasing Canada’s ability to build major energy infrastructure responsibly

quotes.quote_text: Strong food supply chains help get more affordable high-quality food to Canadians, no matter where they live. The Food-Link Fund will help build the infrastructure we need to move food more efficiently, open new markets for producers, and give independent grocers more options. We are building a stronger, more competitive food system that helps keep food affordable and accessible for Canadians.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada invests in stronger, more resilient and affordable food distribution systems

quotes.quote_text: Canadians deserve a food system that is reliable, efficient and affordable. Through the Food Terminal Fund, we are investing in the facilities that help move food more efficiently across Canada, strengthening regional supply chains, and improve access to fresh, affordable food. By building modern food distribution infrastructure, we are helping create more resilient communities and supporting the goals of Canada’s National Food Security Strategy.
quotes.speaker: The
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada invests in stronger, more resilient and affordable food distribution systems

quotes.quote_text: Strong regional food systems are essential to ensuring producers have the connections and infrastructure they need to bring more Canadian food to market. The Food-Link Fund will help strengthen these connections, expand access to storage, processing and distribution, and create new opportunities for producers and food businesses across Quebec and Canada.
quotes.speaker: Daniel Gobeil
quotes.speaker_title: Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister, Quebec
quotes.article_title: The Government of Canada invests in stronger, more resilient and affordable food distribution systems

quotes.quote_text: The opening of this new Canadian North cargo facility is an important step in strengthening the supply chains that northern and remote communities depend on every day. This investment means greater cargo capacity, more reliable service and a more efficient connection between Canada’s North and the rest of the country. By investing in modern transportation infrastructure, we are helping ensure goods reach communities when they are needed, while supporting economic growth and opportunity across Canada's North.
quotes.speaker: Steven MacKinnon
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada celebrates the opening of Canadian North's new cargo facility at Ottawa International Airport

quotes.quote_text: Reliable transportation is essential to life in the North, delivering food, medicine, construction materials, and other goods while connecting communities to each other and the rest of Canada. This new facility strengthens our transportation networks and makes our supply chains more resilient. But more importantly, it’s an investment in the future of our country and the people who call the North home. That’s what it means to build Canada Strong.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Alty
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada celebrates the opening of Canadian North's new cargo facility at Ottawa International Airport

quotes.quote_text: Every day, essential cargo leaves the Ottawa International Airport for communities across the North. Strong, well-supplied communities are key to Arctic security and sovereignty. Canadian North's new facility moves that cargo faster, keeps it fresher, and supports well-paying jobs right here in Ottawa South.
quotes.speaker: David J. McGuinty
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada celebrates the opening of Canadian North's new cargo facility at Ottawa International Airport

quotes.quote_text: For Northern families and communities, cargo planes are lifelines carrying fresh food, medicine, and essentials. By cutting wait times and expanding cold storage, this new facility ensures those critical goods arrive faster, fresher, and more reliably. This investment in the Canadian North cargo facility reinforces the Government of Canada’s commitment to improving national supply chains and fostering domestic trade across Canada. It directly supports the health, well-being, and economic resilience of Northern communities.
quotes.speaker: Rebecca Chartrand
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada celebrates the opening of Canadian North's new cargo facility at Ottawa International Airport

quotes.quote_text: Our airline has been built to serve the North, and this new cargo facility is a direct reflection of our ongoing commitment to making life better in the communities we serve. With Transport Canada’s support, and as part of the Exchange Income Corporation family of companies, we are expanding capacity, improving reliability and enhancing the movement of essential goods, helping make a meaningful difference for the northern residents, families and businesses who depend on Canadian North every day.
quotes.speaker: Shelly De Caria
quotes.speaker_title: President and Chief Executive Officer, Canadian North
quotes.article_title: Government of Canada celebrates the opening of Canadian North's new cargo facility at Ottawa International Airport

quotes.quote_text: Helping lower-income Canadians access the benefits and credits they are entitled to is a worthy objective. However, any automatic tax filing system must be practical, effective, and designed to provide uninterrupted access to essential financial support.
quotes.speaker: Mr. François Boileau
quotes.article_title: Taxpayers’ Ombudsperson Calls on Standing Committee on Finance to Review Automatic Tax Filing Provisions in Bill C-31

quotes.quote_text: This new structure reflects the Canadian Army’s role as both an engine for growth across the Canadian Armed Forces and an action arm of Canada’s Defence Investment Strategy. By aligning our formations around their core responsibilities, we are strengthening our ability to generate forces, integrate capabilities, and convert investment into operational readiness and tangible results. The outcome is a more agile and effective Army, better able to contribute to the joint and all-arms defence of Canada, safeguard Canadian sovereignty, and deliver credible land power at home and abroad.
quotes.speaker: Lieutenant-General Michael Wright
quotes.article_title: Canadian Army Reorganizes to Strengthen Canada’s Defence

quotes.quote_text: Canada’s agri-food sector is driven by innovative small businesses that help feed our communities and strengthen local economies. This investment will help small businesses modernize their food safety systems, adopt new technologies, and meet evolving consumer and market demands while strengthening the resilience and competitiveness of Ontario’s agri-food supply chain.
quotes.speaker: Heath MacDonald
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario investing $2 million to protect the province’s agri-food industry

quotes.quote_text: The funding announced today is geared toward equipping small businesses in the agri-food sector with enhanced food safety systems and standards, as part of Ontario’s plan to build a secure, sovereign, and self-reliant agri-food sector. In the face of economic uncertainty this is another example of how we’re protecting workers and businesses by supporting good-paying jobs, strengthening our food supply, and boosting growth in the sector for decades to come.
quotes.speaker: Sam Oosterhoff
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario investing $2 million to protect the province’s agri-food industry

quotes.quote_text: Food and beverage processing is the largest manufacturing sector by employment in Ontario and over 90% of the over 4,000 companies in Ontario are small businesses. This announcement supports the sector by improving food safety systems, equipment, standards and training. This support is increasingly important against the backdrop of ongoing trade challenges and will help food and beverage operators adapt to market and consumer needs as well as grow their businesses.
quotes.speaker: Chris Conway
quotes.article_title: Canada and Ontario investing $2 million to protect the province’s agri-food industry

quotes.quote_text: We commend the federal and provincial governments for their continued partnership and investment in Ontario’s food system. Helping meat processors strengthen their food safety systems and adopt new technologies builds consumer confidence and creates opportunities for growth. This support will help businesses become more competitive while strengthening a safe, reliable and resilient food supply for everyone.
quotes.speaker: Gerhard Metger
